theorem kdv_well_posed_H_minus_one_torus
    (h_exists : ∀ q : CinfT, ∃ u : ℝ → CinfT, IsSmoothSolutionT u ∧ u 0 = q)
    (h_unique : ∀ u v : ℝ → CinfT,
      IsSmoothSolutionT u → IsSmoothSolutionT v → u 0 = v 0 → u = v) :
    ∃ Φ : ℝ × Hm1T → Hm1T,
      Continuous Φ ∧ ExtendsSmoothFlowT Φ ∧
      (∀ Ψ : ℝ × Hm1T → Hm1T, Continuous Ψ → ExtendsSmoothFlowT Ψ → Ψ = Φ) ∧
      (∀ q : Hm1T, Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range fun t : ℝ => Φ (t, q))) ∧
      (∀ q : Hm1T, EquicontinuousHm1T (Set.range fun t : ℝ => Φ (t, q)))

signature.statement:
theorem kdv_well_posed_H_minus_one_torus
    (h_exists : ∀ q : CinfT, ∃ u : ℝ → CinfT, IsSmoothSolutionT u ∧ u 0 = q)
    (h_unique : ∀ u v : ℝ → CinfT,
      IsSmoothSolutionT u → IsSmoothSolutionT v → u 0 = v 0 → u = v) :
    ∃ Φ : ℝ × Hm1T → Hm1T,
      Continuous Φ ∧ ExtendsSmoothFlowT Φ ∧
      (∀ Ψ : ℝ × Hm1T → Hm1T, Continuous Ψ → ExtendsSmoothFlowT Ψ → Ψ = Φ) ∧
      (∀ q : Hm1T, Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range fun t : ℝ => Φ (t, q))) ∧
      (∀ q : Hm1T, EquicontinuousHm1T (Set.range fun t : ℝ => Φ (t, q)))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hdext : ∀ (X A : Type) [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X]
      (e : A → X) (he : DenseRange e) (F : ℝ → A → X)
      (hF_cont : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t : ℝ => F t a)
      (hF_cauchy : ∀ a : ℕ → A, CauchySeq (fun n => e (a n)) →
        ∀ T > (0 : ℝ), ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T →
          dist (F t (a m)) (F t (a n)) < ε),
      ∃ Φ : ℝ × X → X, Continuous Φ ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (a : A), Φ (t, e a) = F t a) ∧
        ∀ (x : X) (a : ℕ → A), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => e (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
          ∀ t : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F t (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Φ (t, x))) := by
    intro X A _ _ e he F hF_cont hF_cauchy
    have hloc : ∀ x₀ : X, ∀ T > (0 : ℝ), ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ a b : A,
        dist (e a) x₀ < δ → dist (e b) x₀ < δ → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T →
          dist (F t a) (F t b) < ε := by
      intro x₀ T hT ε hε
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have h' : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : A, ∃ t : ℝ, dist (e a) x₀ < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ∧
          dist (e b) x₀ < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ∧ |t| ≤ T ∧ ε ≤ dist (F t a) (F t b) := by
        intro n
        obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, t, ht, hd⟩ := hcon (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat
        exact ⟨a, b, t, ha, hb, ht, hd⟩
      choose α β τ hα hβ hτ hd using h'
      let c : ℕ → A := fun k => if k % 2 = 0 then α (k / 2) else β (k / 2)
      have hc_bound : ∀ k, dist (e (c k)) x₀ < 1 / (((k / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) := by
        intro k
        simp only [c]
        split_ifs
        · exact hα _
        · exact hβ _
      have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => e (c k)) Filter.atTop (nhds x₀) := by
        rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
        refine squeeze_zero (fun k => dist_nonneg) (fun k => (hc_bound k).le) ?_
        exact tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.comp
          (Nat.tendsto_div_const_atTop two_ne_zero)
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hF_cauchy c hlim.cauchySeq T hT ε hε
      have h1 : c (2 * N) = α N := by
        simp only [c]
        rw [if_pos (by omega)]
        congr 1
        omega
      have h2 : c (2 * N + 1) = β N := by
        simp only [c]
        rw [if_neg (by omega)]
        congr 1
        omega
      have h3 := hN (2 * N) (by omega) (2 * N + 1) (by omega) (τ N) (hτ N)
      rw [h1, h2] at h3
      exact absurd h3 (not_lt.2 (hd N))
    have hseq : ∀ x : X, ∃ s : ℕ → A,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => e (s n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) := by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hbt⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.1 (he x)
      choose s hs using hb
      refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
      have hsb : (fun n => e (s n)) = b := funext hs
      rw [hsb]
      exact hbt
    choose s hs using hseq
    have hcauchy : ∀ (x : X) (a : ℕ → A),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => e (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
          ∀ t : ℝ, CauchySeq (fun n => F t (a n)) := by
      intro x a ha t
      rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hD⟩ := hloc x (|t| + 1) (by positivity) ε hε
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 ha δ hδ
      exact ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => hD _ _ (hN m hm) (hN n hn) t (by linarith)⟩
    have hex : ∀ p : ℝ × X, ∃ y : X,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F p.1 (s p.2 n)) Filter.atTop (nhds y) :=
      fun p => cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (hcauchy p.2 (s p.2) (hs p.2) p.1)
    choose Φ hΦ using hex
    have hlimit : ∀ (x : X) (a : ℕ → A),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => e (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
          ∀ t : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F t (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Φ (t, x))) := by
      intro x a ha t
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hD⟩ := hloc x (|t| + 1) (by positivity) (ε / 2) (by positivity)
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 ha δ hδ
      obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 (hs x) δ hδ
      obtain ⟨N₃, hN₃⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 (hΦ (t, x)) (ε / 2) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨max N₁ (max N₂ N₃), fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have g1 := hD (a n) (s x n) (hN₁ n (by omega)) (hN₂ n (by omega)) t (by linarith)
      have g3 : dist (F t (s x n)) (Φ (t, x)) < ε / 2 := hN₃ n (by omega)
      calc dist (F t (a n)) (Φ (t, x))
          ≤ dist (F t (a n)) (F t (s x n)) + dist (F t (s x n)) (Φ (t, x)) :=
            dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := add_lt_add g1 g3
        _ = ε := by ring
    have hcont : Continuous Φ := by
      rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
      rintro ⟨t₀, x₀⟩ ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hD⟩ := hloc x₀ (|t₀| + 1) (by positivity) (ε / 4) (by positivity)
      have claimC : ∀ x : X, dist x x₀ < δ₁ → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ |t₀| + 1 → ∀ a : A,
          dist (e a) x₀ < δ₁ → dist (Φ (t, x)) (F t a) ≤ ε / 4 := by
        intro x hx t ht a ha
        obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 (hs x) (δ₁ - dist x x₀) (by linarith)
        have hT := (hlimit x (s x) (hs x) t).dist
          (tendsto_const_nhds : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => F t a) Filter.atTop (nhds (F t a)))
        refine le_of_tendsto hT (Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩)
        have k1 := hN n hn
        have k2 : dist (e (s x n)) x₀ < δ₁ := by
          calc dist (e (s x n)) x₀ ≤ dist (e (s x n)) x + dist x x₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
            _ < δ₁ := by linarith
        exact (hD _ _ k2 ha t ht).le
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := he.exists_dist_lt x₀ hδ₁
      rw [dist_comm] at ha
      obtain ⟨η, hη, hηc⟩ := Metric.continuous_iff.1 (hF_cont a) t₀ (ε / 4) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨min (min δ₁ η) 1, by positivity, ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨t, x⟩ hp
      rw [Prod.dist_eq] at hp
      have ht' : dist t t₀ < min (min δ₁ η) 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hp
      have hx' : dist x x₀ < min (min δ₁ η) 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hp
      simp only [lt_min_iff] at ht' hx'
      have htT : |t| ≤ |t₀| + 1 := by
        have hh := ht'.2
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at hh
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub t t₀
        linarith
      have c1 := claimC x hx'.1.1 t htT a ha
      have c2 := hηc t ht'.1.2
      have hx0 : dist x₀ x₀ < δ₁ := by rw [dist_self]; exact hδ₁
      have c3 := claimC x₀ hx0 t₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg t₀]) a ha
      rw [dist_comm] at c3
      calc dist (Φ (t, x)) (Φ (t₀, x₀))
          ≤ dist (Φ (t, x)) (F t a) + dist (F t a) (F t₀ a) + dist (F t₀ a) (Φ (t₀, x₀)) :=
            dist_triangle4 _ _ _ _
        _ < ε := by linarith
    refine ⟨Φ, hcont, fun t a => ?_, hlimit⟩
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hlimit (e a) (fun _ => a) tendsto_const_nhds t) tendsto_const_nhds
  have H11 := kdv_orbit_control_T h_exists h_unique
  have H12 := kdv_Hm1T_uniform_cauchy h_exists h_unique
  obtain ⟨hlin, hbd⟩ := toHm1T_basic
  choose sol hsol hsol0 using h_exists
  
  have hcomb : ∀ (a b : CinfT) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ), ∃ r : CinfT,
      ∀ x, (r : ℝ → ℝ) x = c₁ * (a : ℝ → ℝ) x + c₂ * (b : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    intro a b c₁ c₂
    refine ⟨⟨fun x => c₁ * (a : ℝ → ℝ) x + c₂ * (b : ℝ → ℝ) x, ?_, ?_⟩, fun x => rfl⟩
    · exact (contDiff_const.mul a.2.1).add (contDiff_const.mul b.2.1)
    · intro x
      simp only [a.2.2 x, b.2.2 x]
  have hcombT : ∀ (a b : CinfT) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ), ∃ r : CinfT,
      toHm1T r = c₁ • toHm1T a + c₂ • toHm1T b := by
    intro a b c₁ c₂
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcomb a b c₁ c₂
    exact ⟨r, hlin a b r c₁ c₂ hr⟩
  let z : CinfT := ⟨fun _ => 0, contDiff_const, fun _ => rfl⟩
  let P : Submodule ℝ (lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) :=
    { carrier := Set.range toHm1T
      add_mem' := by
        rintro _ _ ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcombT a b 1 1
        exact ⟨r, by rw [hr, one_smul, one_smul]⟩
      zero_mem' := by
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcombT z z 0 0
        exact ⟨r, by rw [hr, zero_smul, add_zero]⟩
      smul_mem' := by
        rintro c _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcombT a a c 0
        exact ⟨r, by rw [hr, zero_smul, add_zero]⟩ }
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range toHm1T) = P := Submodule.span_eq P
  haveI : CompleteSpace Hm1T := by
    show CompleteSpace (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range toHm1T)).topologicalClosure
    infer_instance
  have hseq : ∀ x : Hm1T, ∃ a : ℕ → CinfT,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ιT (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) := by
    intro x
    have hmem : (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ∈
        (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range toHm1T)).topologicalClosure := x.2
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe, hspan] at hmem
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbt⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.1 hmem
    have hb' : ∀ n, ∃ c : CinfT, toHm1T c = b n := fun n => hb n
    choose a ha using hb'
    refine ⟨a, tendsto_subtype_rng.2 ?_⟩
    have hab : (fun n => ((ιT (a n) : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)) = b :=
      funext fun n => ha n
    rw [hab]
    exact hbt
  have hdense : DenseRange ιT := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hseq x
    exact mem_closure_of_tendsto ha (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ⟨a n, rfl⟩)
  
  have hF_cont : ∀ a : CinfT, Continuous fun t : ℝ => ιT (sol a t) := by
    intro a
    have hU : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (sol a p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2 := (hsol a).1.continuous
    have hper : ∀ t x : ℝ, (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (sol a p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2) (t, x + 1) =
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (sol a p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2) (t, x) := fun t x => (sol a t).2.2 x
    rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
    intro t₀ ε hε
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hU'⟩ := periodic_uniform_continuity _ hU hper t₀ (ε / 2) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨η, hη, fun t ht => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at ht
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcomb (sol a t) (sol a t₀) 1 (-1)
    have h1 : toHm1T r = toHm1T (sol a t) - toHm1T (sol a t₀) := by
      rw [hlin _ _ r 1 (-1) hr, one_smul, neg_one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]
    have h2 : ‖toHm1T r‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
      refine hbd r (ε / 2) (fun x => ?_)
      have h3 := hU' t ht x
      simp only at h3
      rw [hr x]
      have e : 1 * (sol a t : ℝ → ℝ) x + -1 * (sol a t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x =
          (sol a t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (sol a t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x := by ring
      rw [e]
      exact h3.le
    show dist (toHm1T (sol a t)) (toHm1T (sol a t₀)) < ε
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← h1]
    linarith
  have hF_cauchy : ∀ a : ℕ → CinfT, CauchySeq (fun n => ιT (a n)) →
      ∀ T > (0 : ℝ), ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T →
        dist (ιT (sol (a m) t)) (ιT (sol (a n) t)) < ε := by
    intro a ha
    have ha' : CauchySeq (fun n => ιT (sol (a n) 0)) := by
      simpa only [hsol0] using ha
    exact H12 (fun n => sol (a n)) (fun n => hsol (a n)) ha'
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦc, hΦe, hΦlim⟩ :=
    hdext Hm1T CinfT ιT hdense (fun t a => ιT (sol a t)) hF_cont hF_cauchy
  have hΦe' : ∀ (t : ℝ) (a : CinfT), Φ (t, ιT a) = ιT (sol a t) := hΦe
  have hΦlim' : ∀ (x : Hm1T) (a : ℕ → CinfT),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ιT (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
        ∀ t : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ιT (sol (a n) t)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Φ (t, x))) :=
    hΦlim
  have horbit : ∀ x : Hm1T, ∃ a : ℕ → CinfT,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ιT (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) ∧
      ∃ C ≥ (0 : ℝ), ∃ κ₀ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
        ‖ιT (sol (a n) t)‖ ≤ C ∧ ∀ κ ≥ κ₀,
          (∑' m : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * m) ^ 2) / ((2 * π * m) ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) *
              ‖((ιT (sol (a n) t) : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) m‖ ^ 2) ≤
            C * ∑' m : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * m) ^ 2) / ((2 * π * m) ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) *
              ‖((ιT (a n) : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) m‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hseq x
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.1 (Metric.isBounded_range_of_tendsto _ ha)
    obtain ⟨C, hC0, κ₀, hκ₀, hctrl⟩ := H11 (max R 0) (le_max_right _ _)
    refine ⟨a, ha, C, hC0, κ₀, hκ₀, fun n t => ?_⟩
    have h0 : ‖ιT (sol (a n) 0)‖ ≤ max R 0 := by
      rw [hsol0]
      exact le_trans (hR _ ⟨n, rfl⟩) (le_max_left _ _)
    have hc := hctrl (sol (a n)) (hsol _) h0 t
    rw [hsol0] at hc
    exact hc
  refine ⟨Φ, hΦc, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu t
    have heq : sol (u 0) = u := h_unique _ _ (hsol (u 0)) hu (hsol0 (u 0))
    rw [hΦe', heq]
  · intro Ψ hΨc hΨe
    have hagree : ∀ (t : ℝ) (a : CinfT), Ψ (t, ιT a) = Φ (t, ιT a) := by
      intro t a
      have h1 := hΨe (sol a) (hsol a) t
      rw [hsol0] at h1
      rw [h1, hΦe']
    have hd : DenseRange (Prod.map id ιT : ℝ × CinfT → ℝ × Hm1T) :=
      DenseRange.prodMap denseRange_id hdense
    refine Continuous.ext_on hd hΨc hΦc ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨t, a⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hagree t a
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨a, ha, C, hC0, κ₀, hκ₀, hctrl⟩ := horbit x
    have hbd' : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖Φ (t, x)‖ ≤ C := by
      intro t
      refine le_of_tendsto' ((continuous_norm.tendsto _).comp (hΦlim' x a ha t)) ?_
      intro n
      exact (hctrl n t).1
    exact isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.2 ⟨C, by rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩; exact hbd' t⟩
  · intro x ε hε
    obtain ⟨a, ha, C, hC0, κ₀, hκ₀, hctrl⟩ := horbit x
    have hf : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ((ιT (a n) : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)) := tendsto_subtype_rng.1 ha
    have hC1 : 0 < C + 1 := by linarith
    have hη : 0 < ε / (80 * (C + 1)) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁, hW⟩ := Hm1T_weight_uniform_decay _ _ hf (ε / (80 * (C + 1))) hη
    obtain ⟨K, hKK₁, hKκ⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K₁ ≤ K ∧ κ₀ ≤ K :=
      ⟨max K₁ κ₀, le_max_left _ _, le_max_right _ _⟩
    have hK1 : 1 ≤ K := le_trans hK₁ hKK₁
    have hD : 0 < K * (C + 1) := mul_pos (by linarith) hC1
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδsq⟩ : ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), δ ^ 2 * (K * (C + 1)) ^ 2 = ε / 4 := by
      refine ⟨Real.sqrt (ε / 4) / (K * (C + 1)),
        div_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)) hD, ?_⟩
      rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), div_mul_cancel₀ _ (pow_pos hD 2).ne']
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩ h hh
    show translateDiffSqT ((Φ (t, x) : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) h < ε
    have hh2 : h ^ 2 < δ ^ 2 := by
      have := abs_lt.1 hh
      exact sq_lt_sq' this.1 this.2
    have hCη : C * (ε / (80 * (C + 1))) ≤ ε / 80 := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc', div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
      nlinarith
    have hn : ∀ n : ℕ,
        translateDiffSqT ((ιT (sol (a n) t) : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) h ≤ ε / 2 := by
      intro n
      have hT := translateDiffSqT_bounds.1
        ((ιT (sol (a n) t) : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) K hK1 h
      have hgC : ‖((ιT (sol (a n) t) : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ ≤ C :=
        (hctrl n t).1
      have hWg := (hctrl n t).2 K hKκ
      have hWf : (∑' m : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * m) ^ 2) / ((2 * π * m) ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2)) *
          ‖((ιT (a n) : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) m‖ ^ 2) <
            ε / (80 * (C + 1)) := hW K hKK₁ n
      have hg2 : ‖((ιT (sol (a n) t) : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (C + 1) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith) 2
      have e1 : K ^ 2 * h ^ 2 *

    have hp : Function.Periodic (fun y => V (t, y)) 1 := fun y => hper t y
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hp.exists_mem_Ico₀ zero_lt_one x
    have h1 := hC (t, y) (Set.mk_mem_prod ht (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hy))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    have hxy' : V (t, x) = V (t, y) := hxy
    rw [hxy']
    exact h1.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  
  have mvt2 : ∀ (g g' g'' : ℝ → ℝ) (A B : ℝ), (∀ s, HasDerivAt g (g' s) s) →
      (∀ s, HasDerivAt g' (g'' s) s) →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), |g' s| ≤ A) →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), |g'' s| ≤ B) →
      ∀ h : ℝ, |h| ≤ 1 → |g (t₀ + h) - g t₀| ≤ A * |h| ∧
        |g (t₀ + h) - g t₀ - h * g' t₀| ≤ B * h ^ 2 := by
    intro g g' g'' A B hg hg' hA hB h hh
    have hh' := abs_le.1 hh
    have hsub : Set.uIcc t₀ (t₀ + h) ⊆ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1) := by
      intro σ hσ
      rcases Set.mem_uIcc.1 hσ with h1 | h1
      · exact ⟨by linarith [h1.1, h1.2], by linarith [h1.1, h1.2]⟩
      · exact ⟨by linarith [h1.1, h1.2], by linarith [h1.1, h1.2]⟩
    have hdist : ∀ σ ∈ Set.uIcc t₀ (t₀ + h), |σ - t₀| ≤ |h| := by
      intro σ hσ
      rcases Set.mem_uIcc.1 hσ with h1 | h1
      · exact abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [h1.1, h1.2, neg_abs_le h, abs_nonneg h],
          by linarith [h1.1, h1.2, le_abs_self h, abs_nonneg h]⟩
      · exact abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [h1.1, h1.2, neg_abs_le h, abs_nonneg h],
          by linarith [h1.1, h1.2, le_abs_self h, abs_nonneg h]⟩
    have hconv : Convex ℝ (Set.uIcc t₀ (t₀ + h)) := convex_uIcc _ _
    have ha : t₀ ∈ Set.uIcc t₀ (t₀ + h) := Set.left_mem_uIcc
    have hb : t₀ + h ∈ Set.uIcc t₀ (t₀ + h) := Set.right_mem_uIcc
    have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hB t₀ ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
    constructor
    · have h1 := hconv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le (f := g) (f' := g') (C := A)
        (fun σ _ => (hg σ).hasDerivWithinAt)
        (fun σ hσ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hA σ (hsub hσ)) ha hb
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, add_sub_cancel_left] at h1
      exact h1
    · have haux : ∀ σ ∈ Set.uIcc t₀ (t₀ + h), |g' σ - g' t₀| ≤ B * |h| := by
        intro σ hσ
        have h1 := hconv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le (f := g') (f' := g'')
          (C := B) (fun τ _ => (hg' τ).hasDerivWithinAt)
          (fun τ hτ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hB τ (hsub hτ)) ha hσ
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
        exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdist σ hσ) hB0)
      have hψ : ∀ σ, HasDerivAt (fun τ => g τ - g t₀ - (τ - t₀) * g' t₀) (g' σ - g' t₀) σ := by
        intro σ
        have h1 := ((hg σ).sub_const (g t₀)).sub
          (((hasDerivAt_id' σ).sub_const t₀).mul_const (g' t₀))
        convert h1 using 1
        ring
      have h1 := hconv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
        (f := fun τ => g τ - g t₀ - (τ - t₀) * g' t₀) (f' := fun σ => g' σ - g' t₀)
        (C := B * |h|) (fun σ _ => (hψ σ).hasDerivWithinAt)
        (fun σ hσ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact haux σ hσ) ha hb
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, add_sub_cancel_left] at h1
      have e : (g (t₀ + h) - g t₀ - (t₀ + h - t₀) * g' t₀) - (g t₀ - g t₀ - (t₀ - t₀) * g' t₀) =
          g (t₀ + h) - g t₀ - h * g' t₀ := by ring
      have h2 : |g (t₀ + h) - g t₀ - h * g' t₀| ≤ B * |h| * |h| := by
        rw [← e]; exact h1
      calc |g (t₀ + h) - g t₀ - h * g' t₀| ≤ B * |h| * |h| := h2
        _ = B * h ^ 2 := by rw [mul_assoc, abs_mul_abs_self, sq]
  
  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, U = fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (u p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUeval : ∀ σ x : ℝ, U (σ, x) = (u σ : ℝ → ℝ) x := fun σ x => by rw [hUdef]
  have hU3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 U := by rw [hUdef]; exact contDiff_infty.1 hU 3
  have hUd : Differentiable ℝ U := hU3.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hU' : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fderiv ℝ U) := hU3.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, D = fun p => fderiv ℝ U p ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 D := by rw [hDdef]; exact hU'.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hDd : Differentiable ℝ D := hD2.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hDc : Continuous D := hD2.continuous
  obtain ⟨D₂, hD₂def⟩ : ∃ D₂ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, D₂ = fun p => fderiv ℝ D p ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD₂c : Continuous D₂ := by
    rw [hD₂def]; exact (hD2.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hγ : ∀ s x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => (σ, x)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) s := fun s x =>
    (hasDerivAt_id' s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const s x)
  have hder1 : ∀ s x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => (u σ : ℝ → ℝ) x) (D (s, x)) s := by
    intro s x
    have h1 := (hUd (s, x)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hγ s x)
    have e : (U ∘ fun σ : ℝ => (σ, x)) = fun σ : ℝ => (u σ : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
      funext fun σ => hUeval σ x
    rw [e] at h1
    rw [hDdef]
    exact h1
  have hder2 : ∀ s x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => D (σ, x)) (D₂ (s, x)) s := by
    intro s x
    have h1 := (hDd (s, x)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hγ s x)
    rw [hD₂def]
    exact h1
  
  have hDper : ∀ s x : ℝ, D (s, x + 1) = D (s, x) := by
    intro s x
    have h1 := hder1 s (x + 1)
    have hfun : (fun σ : ℝ => (u σ : ℝ → ℝ) (x + 1)) = fun σ : ℝ => (u σ : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
      funext fun σ => (u σ).2.2 x
    rw [hfun] at h1
    exact h1.unique (hder1 s x)
  have hD₂per : ∀ s x : ℝ, D₂ (s, x + 1) = D₂ (s, x) := by
    intro s x
    have h1 := hder2 s (x + 1)
    have hfun : (fun σ : ℝ => D (σ, x + 1)) = fun σ : ℝ => D (σ, x) :=
      funext fun σ => hDper σ x
    rw [hfun] at h1
    exact h1.unique (hder2 s x)
  obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁0, hM₁⟩ := bound D hDc hDper
  obtain ⟨M₂, hM₂0, hM₂⟩ := bound D₂ hD₂c hD₂per
  refine ⟨max M₁ M₂, le_max_of_le_left hM₁0, fun h hh x => ?_⟩
  have hid : D (t₀, x) = kdvRHS (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x := (hder1 t₀ x).unique (hkdv t₀ x)
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mvt2 (fun σ => (u σ : ℝ → ℝ) x) (fun σ => D (σ, x)) (fun σ => D₂ (σ, x))
    (max M₁ M₂) (max M₁ M₂) (fun s => hder1 s x) (fun s => hder2 s x)
    (fun s hs => (hM₁ s hs x).trans (le_max_left _ _))
    (fun s hs => (hM₂ s hs x).trans (le_max_right _ _)) h hh
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  rw [← hid]
  exact h2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ u : ℝ → CinfT, IsSmoothSolutionT u → ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (W : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ), (∀ᶠ s in nhds t₀, Function.Periodic (W s) 1 ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt (W s) ((u s : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * W s x - W s x ^ 2) x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W s x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 256) → HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W s x ^ 2) 0 t₀

signature.name: riccati_conservation_T
signature.statement: ∀ u : ℝ → CinfT, IsSmoothSolutionT u → ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (W : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ), (∀ᶠ s in nhds t₀, Function.Periodic (W s) 1 ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt (W s) ((u s : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * W s x - W s x ^ 2) x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W s x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 256) → HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W s x ^ 2) 0 t₀

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have P : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 0 < κ → ∀ (a g f : ℝ → ℝ) (G : ℝ), Continuous a → Function.Periodic a 1 →
      Continuous g → Function.Periodic f 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt f ((2 * κ - a x) * f x + g x) x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |a x|) ≤ κ → (∀ y, |g y| ≤ G) →
      ∀ x, |f x| ≤ Real.exp κ / (1 - Real.exp (-κ)) * G := by
    intro κ hκ a g f G ha hap hg hfp hf hint hG x
    have hb : Continuous (fun t => 2 * κ - a t) := continuous_const.sub ha
    have habs : Continuous (fun t => |a t|) := ha.abs
    have hI : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => ∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t)) (2 * κ - a y) y :=
      fun y => (hb.integral_hasStrictDerivAt x y).hasDerivAt
    have hE : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.exp (-(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t))))
        (Real.exp (-(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t))) * (-(2 * κ - a y))) y :=
      fun y => (hI y).neg.exp
    have hF : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.exp (-(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t))) * f y)
        (Real.exp (-(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t))) * g y) y := by
      intro y
      have := (hE y).mul (hf y)
      convert this using 1
      ring
    have hEc : Continuous (fun y => Real.exp (-(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t)))) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun y => (hE y).continuousAt
    have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (a := x) (b := x + 1)
      (fun y _ => hF y) ((hEc.mul hg).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_same, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul, hfp x] at hFTC
    have hshift : (∫ t in x..x + 1, |a t|) = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, |a t| := by
      have hp : Function.Periodic (fun t => |a t|) 1 := fun t => by simp only [hap t]
      have := hp.intervalIntegral_add_eq x 0
      simpa using this
    have hIb : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc x (x + 1), -(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t)) ≤ κ := by
      intro y hy
      have h1 : -(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t)) ≤ ∫ t in x..y, |a t| := by
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hy.1 ((hb.neg).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          (habs.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        intro t _
        have := le_abs_self (a t)
        linarith
      have h2 : (∫ t in x..y, |a t|) ≤ ∫ t in x..x + 1, |a t| := by
        have hadd := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume) (a := x)
          (b := y) (c := x + 1) (habs.intervalIntegrable _ _) (habs.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        have : 0 ≤ ∫ t in y..x + 1, |a t| :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hy.2 (fun t _ => abs_nonneg _)
        linarith
      linarith
    have hI1 : -(∫ t in x..x + 1, (2 * κ - a t)) ≤ -κ := by
      have h1 : -(∫ t in x..x + 1, (2 * κ - a t)) ≤ (∫ t in x..x + 1, |a t|) - 2 * κ := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const (ha.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
        simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, add_sub_cancel_left, one_smul]
        have : (∫ t in x..x + 1, a t) ≤ ∫ t in x..x + 1, |a t| :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by linarith) (ha.intervalIntegrable _ _)
            (habs.intervalIntegrable _ _) (fun t _ => le_abs_self _)
        linarith
      rw [hshift] at h1
      linarith
    have hnorm : ‖∫ y in x..x + 1, Real.exp (-(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t))) * g y‖ ≤
        Real.exp κ * G * |x + 1 - x| := by
      apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      intro y hy
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le (by linarith)] at hy
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact mul_le_mul (Real.exp_le_exp.2 (hIb y ⟨hy.1.le, hy.2⟩)) (hG y) (abs_nonneg _)
        (Real.exp_pos _).le
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hFTC, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_one, mul_one] at hnorm
    set β := -(∫ t in x..x + 1, (2 * κ - a t)) with hβ
    have hE1 : Real.exp β ≤ Real.exp (-κ) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hI1
    have hek : Real.exp (-κ) < 1 := by
      have := Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (show -κ < 0 by linarith)
      rwa [Real.exp_zero] at this
    have hpos : 0 < 1 - Real.exp (-κ) := by linarith
    have h3 : Real.exp β * f x - f x = -(f x * (1 - Real.exp β)) := by ring
    rw [h3, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 - Real.exp β)] at hnorm
    have h4 : |f x| * (1 - Real.exp (-κ)) ≤ Real.exp κ * G := by
      calc |f x| * (1 - Real.exp (-κ)) ≤ |f x| * (1 - Real.exp β) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ Real.exp κ * G := hnorm
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hpos]
    exact h4
  
  have s2 : ∀ (κ : ℝ) (q : CinfT) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic w 1 →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt w ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) →
      ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic φ 1 ∧
        (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (kdvRHS (q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * φ x - 2 * w x * φ x) x) ∧
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * φ x) = 0 := by
    intro κ q w hwp hw
    obtain ⟨Q, hQdef⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ → ℝ, Q = (q : ℝ → ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hQ := q.2.1
    have hQp : Function.Periodic Q 1 := by rw [hQdef]; exact q.2.2
    rw [← hQdef] at hQ hw ⊢
    obtain ⟨hd0, hQ1⟩ := contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.1 hQ
    obtain ⟨hd1, hQ2⟩ := contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.1 hQ1
    obtain ⟨hd2, -⟩ := contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.1 hQ2
    have hperd : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Differentiable ℝ f → Function.Periodic f 1 →
        Function.Periodic (deriv f) 1 := by
      intro f hf hp x
      have h1 := HasDerivAt.comp_add_const x 1 (hf (x + 1)).hasDerivAt
      have e : (fun y => f (y + 1)) = f := funext hp
      rw [e] at h1
      exact h1.deriv.symm
    have hQ1p := hperd Q hd0 hQp
    have hQ2p := hperd (deriv Q) hd1 hQ1p
    have h3 : iteratedDeriv 3 Q = deriv (deriv (deriv Q)) := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one]
    have hkdv : ∀ x, kdvRHS Q x = -(deriv (deriv (deriv Q)) x) + 6 * Q x * deriv Q x := by
      intro x; unfold kdvRHS; rw [h3]
    have hQ' : ∀ x, HasDerivAt Q (deriv Q x) x := fun x => (hd0 x).hasDerivAt
    have hQ1' : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (deriv Q) (deriv (deriv Q) x) x := fun x => (hd1 x).hasDerivAt
    have hQ2' : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (deriv (deriv Q)) (deriv (deriv (deriv Q)) x) x :=
      fun x => (hd2 x).hasDerivAt
    obtain ⟨φ, hφdef⟩ : ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, φ = fun x => -(deriv (deriv Q) x) +
        2 * deriv Q x * (w x - κ) + (2 * Q x - 4 * κ ^ 2) * (Q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hφx : ∀ x, φ x = -(deriv (deriv Q) x) +
        2 * deriv Q x * (w x - κ) + (2 * Q x - 4 * κ ^ 2) * (Q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) := by
      intro x; rw [hφdef]
    have hφd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (kdvRHS Q x + 2 * κ * φ x - 2 * w x * φ x) x := by
      intro x
      have h := ((hQ2' x).neg.add (((hQ1' x).const_mul 2).mul ((hw x).sub_const κ))).add
        ((((hQ' x).const_mul 2).sub_const (4 * κ ^ 2)).mul
          (((hQ' x).add ((hw x).const_mul (2 * κ))).sub ((hw x).pow 2)))
      rw [hkdv x, hφx x, hφdef]
      convert h using 1
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.pow_apply]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hwc : Continuous w := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hw x).continuousAt
    have hφc : Continuous φ := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hφd x).continuousAt
    have hφp : Function.Periodic φ 1 := by
      intro x
      rw [hφx, hφx, hQp x, hQ1p x, hQ2p x, hwp x]
    refine ⟨φ, hφp, hφd, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨H, hHdef⟩ : ∃ H : ℝ → ℝ, H = fun x => -(deriv (deriv Q) x) + 3 * Q x ^ 2 +
        2 * κ * (-(deriv Q x) + (2 * Q x - 4 * κ ^ 2) * (w x - κ)) - φ x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hHd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt H (2 * (w x * φ x)) x := by
      intro x
      have h := (((hQ2' x).neg.add (((hQ' x).pow 2).const_mul 3)).add
        ((((hQ1' x).neg).add ((((hQ' x).const_mul 2).sub_const (4 * κ ^ 2)).mul
          ((hw x).sub_const κ))).const_mul (2 * κ))).sub (hφd x)
      rw [hHdef]
      convert h using 1
      rw [hkdv x, hφx x]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (a := 0) (b := 1)
      (fun x _ => hHd x) ((continuous_const.mul (hwc.mul hφc)).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    have hH1 : H 1 = H 0 := by
      have e : ∀ x, H (x + 1) = H x := by
        intro x
        rw [hHdef]
        simp only [hQp x, hQ1p x, hQ2p x, hwp x, hφp x]
      have := e 0
      rwa [zero_add] at this
    rw [hH1, sub_self, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hFTC
    linarith
  
  have s3 : ∀ (κ M : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → 0 ≤ M → ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ (q q₁ g w w₁ φ : ℝ → ℝ) (h : ℝ),
      Continuous q → Continuous q₁ → Continuous g → Function.Periodic w 1 →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 256 → Function.Periodic w₁ 1 →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt w₁ (q₁ x + 2 * κ * w₁ x - w₁ x ^ 2) x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 256 → Function.Periodic φ 1 →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (g x + 2 * κ * φ x - 2 * w x * φ x) x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * φ x) = 0 → (∀ x, |q₁ x - q x| ≤ M * |h|) →
      (∀ x, |q₁ x - q x - h * g x| ≤ M * h ^ 2) →
      |(∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ x ^ 2) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2)| ≤ K * h ^ 2 := by
    intro κ M hκ hM
    have hκ0 : 0 < κ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = Real.exp κ / (1 - Real.exp (-κ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hek : Real.exp (-κ) < 1 := by
      have := Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (show -κ < 0 by linarith)
      rwa [Real.exp_zero] at this
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
      rw [hCdef]; exact div_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (by linarith)
    refine ⟨2 * (C * (M + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2)) * (1 / 4 + κ / 256) + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2, ?_⟩
    intro q q₁ g w w₁ φ h hq hq₁ hg hwp hw hwE hw₁p hw₁ hw₁E hφp hφ hwφ hT1 hT2
    have hwc : Continuous w := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hw x).continuousAt
    have hw₁c : Continuous w₁ := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hw₁ x).continuousAt

    have hK : (2 * (C * (M + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2)) * (1 / 4 + κ / 256) + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2) * h ^ 2 =

  intro u hu κ hκ W t₀ hW

subgoal_signatures.name: smooth_solution_time_taylor_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ u : ℝ → CinfT, IsSmoothSolutionT u → ∀ t₀ : ℝ, ∃ M ≥ (0:ℝ), ∀ h : ℝ, |h| ≤ 1 → ∀ x : ℝ, |(u (t₀ + h) : ℝ → ℝ) x - (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ M * |h| ∧ |(u (t₀ + h) : ℝ → ℝ) x - (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x - h * kdvRHS (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ M * h ^ 2

informal_problem.statement:
∀ R ≥ (0 : ℝ), ∃ C ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∃ κ₀ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ κ ≥ κ₀,
    ∀ c : ℝ → CinfT, IsHkSolutionT κ c → ‖ιT (c 0)‖ ≤ R → ∀ t : ℝ, ‖ιT (c t)‖ ≤ C ∧
      ∀ ϰ ≥ κ₀, WT ϰ ((ιT (c t) : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤
        C * WT ϰ ((ιT (c 0) : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ q hq hqper
  classical
  have hstep : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous g → Function.Periodic g 1 →
      ∃ v : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous v ∧ Function.Periodic v 1 ∧
        ∀ x, HasDerivAt v (q x + 2 * κ * v x - g x ^ 2) x := by
    intro g hg hgp
    have hf : Continuous (fun x => q x - g x ^ 2) := hq.sub (hg.pow 2)
    have hfp : Function.Periodic (fun x => q x - g x ^ 2) 1 := fun x => by
      show q (x + 1) - g (x + 1) ^ 2 = q x - g x ^ 2
      rw [hqper x, hgp x]
    obtain ⟨v, hvp, hvd⟩ := (periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ _ hf hfp).1
    refine ⟨v, continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hvd x).continuousAt, hvp, fun x => ?_⟩
    exact (hvd x).congr_deriv (by ring)
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ), ∀ g (h : Continuous g ∧ Function.Periodic g 1),
      S g = Classical.choose (hstep g h.1 h.2) :=
    ⟨fun g => if h : Continuous g ∧ Function.Periodic g 1 then
      Classical.choose (hstep g h.1 h.2) else 0, fun g h => dif_pos h⟩
  have hSspec : ∀ g, Continuous g → Function.Periodic g 1 →
      Continuous (S g) ∧ Function.Periodic (S g) 1 ∧
        ∀ x, HasDerivAt (S g) (q x + 2 * κ * S g x - g x ^ 2) x := by
    intro g hg hgp
    rw [hS g ⟨hg, hgp⟩]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hstep g hg hgp)
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ, w = fun j => S^[j] 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hw0 : w 0 = 0 := by rw [hw]; rfl
  have hws : ∀ j, w (j + 1) = S (w j) := by
    intro j
    rw [hw]
    exact Function.iterate_succ_apply' S j 0
  have hP : ∀ j, Continuous (w j) ∧ Function.Periodic (w j) 1 := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      rw [hw0]
      exact ⟨continuous_const, fun x => rfl⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [hws]
      exact ⟨(hSspec _ ih.1 ih.2).1, (hSspec _ ih.1 ih.2).2.1⟩
  refine ⟨w, hw0, fun j => (hP j).1, fun j => (hP j).2, fun j x => ?_⟩
  rw [hws]
  exact (hSspec _ (hP j).1 (hP j).2).2.2 x

signature.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q v : ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + q x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → w 0 = 0 → (∀ j, Continuous (w j)) → (∀ j, Function.Periodic (w j) 1) → (∀ j x, HasDerivAt (w (j + 1)) (q x + 2 * κ * w (j + 1) x - w j x ^ 2) x) → (∀ j, (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w j x ^ 2) ≤ 4 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ∧ (∀ j x, |w (j + 2) x - w (j + 1) x| ≤ 8 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) * (1 / 8) ^ j)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ q v w hvper hvd hv hw0 hwc hwper hwd
  have hκ0 : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hvc : Continuous v := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hvd x).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨a2, ha2⟩ : ∃ a2 : ℝ, (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) = a2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [ha2] at hv ⊢
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a2 := by
    rw [← ha2]; exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hstar : 1024 * a2 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hw0x : ∀ x, w 0 x = 0 := fun x => by rw [hw0]; rfl
  
  have hom : ∀ d : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic d 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt d (2 * κ * d x) x) →
      ∀ x, d x = 0 := by
    intro d hdp hdd x
    have hf : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => (0:ℝ)) := continuous_const
    have hfp : Function.Periodic (fun _ : ℝ => (0:ℝ)) 1 := fun _ => rfl
    have hdd' : ∀ x, HasDerivAt d (2 * κ * d x + (fun _ : ℝ => (0:ℝ)) x) x := fun x => by
      simpa using hdd x
    obtain ⟨-, hsup, -, -⟩ := (periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ _ hf hfp).2 d hdp hdd'
    have h := hsup x
    simpa using h
  
  have energy : ∀ a b : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous a → Continuous b → Function.Periodic a 1 →
      Function.Periodic b 1 →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => b y - v y) (2 * κ * (b x - v x) + -(a x ^ 2)) x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, a x ^ 2) ≤ 4 * a2 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, b x ^ 2) ≤ 4 * a2 := by
    intro a b ha hb hap hbp hd hA
    have hf : Continuous (fun y => -(a y ^ 2)) := (ha.pow 2).neg
    have hfp : Function.Periodic (fun y => -(a y ^ 2)) 1 := fun y => by
      show -(a (y + 1) ^ 2) = -(a y ^ 2)
      rw [hap y]
    have hdp : Function.Periodic (fun y => b y - v y) 1 := fun y => by
      show b (y + 1) - v (y + 1) = b y - v y
      rw [hbp y, hvper y]
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, hR5⟩ := (periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ _ hf hfp).2 _ hdp hd
    have hR5' : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (b x - v x) ^ 2) ≤
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |-(a x ^ 2)|) ^ 2 / κ := hR5
    have habs : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |-(a x ^ 2)|) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, a x ^ 2 := by
      congr 1; funext x; rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    rw [habs] at hR5'
    have hAa0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, a x ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hd2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (b x - v x) ^ 2) ≤ a2 / 64 := by
      refine le_trans hR5' ?_
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hκ0]
      have h1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, a x ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ (4 * a2) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hAa0 hA 2
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstar ha0]
    have hpt : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, b x ^ 2) ≤
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * v x ^ 2 + 2 * (b x - v x) ^ 2) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num) ((hb.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
        (fun x _ => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b x - 2 * v x)])
    have hsplit : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * v x ^ 2 + 2 * (b x - v x) ^ 2)) =
        2 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) + 2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (b x - v x) ^ 2 := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      all_goals (apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
    linarith
  
  have contr : ∀ (A : ℝ) (a b c : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous a → Continuous b → Continuous c →
      Function.Periodic a 1 → Function.Periodic b 1 → Function.Periodic c 1 →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => c y - b y) (2 * κ * (c x - b x) + (a x ^ 2 - b x ^ 2)) x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, a x ^ 2) ≤ A → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, b x ^ 2) ≤ A →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (c x - b x) ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (b x - a x) ^ 2) * (4 * A) / κ ∧
      ∀ x, (c x - b x) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ((∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (b x - a x) ^ 2) * (4 * A)) := by
    intro A a b c ha hb hc hap hbp hcp hd hA hB
    have hf : Continuous (fun y => a y ^ 2 - b y ^ 2) := (ha.pow 2).sub (hb.pow 2)
    have hfp : Function.Periodic (fun y => a y ^ 2 - b y ^ 2) 1 := fun y => by
      show a (y + 1) ^ 2 - b (y + 1) ^ 2 = a y ^ 2 - b y ^ 2
      rw [hap y, hbp y]
    have hep : Function.Periodic (fun y => c y - b y) 1 := fun y => by
      show c (y + 1) - b (y + 1) = c y - b y
      rw [hcp y, hbp y]
    obtain ⟨-, hsup, -, hR5⟩ := (periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ _ hf hfp).2 _ hep hd
    have hsup' : ∀ x, |c x - b x| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |a y ^ 2 - b y ^ 2| := hsup
    have hR5' : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (c x - b x) ^ 2) ≤
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |a x ^ 2 - b x ^ 2|) ^ 2 / κ := hR5
    have hI : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |a x ^ 2 - b x ^ 2|) =
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |b x - a x| * |b x + a x| := by
      congr 1; funext x
      have e : a x ^ 2 - b x ^ 2 = -((b x - a x) * (b x + a x)) := by ring
      rw [e, abs_neg, abs_mul]
    have hCS : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |b x - a x| * |b x + a x|) ^ 2 ≤
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |b x - a x| ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |b x + a x| ^ 2) :=
      cauchy_schwarz_unit_interval (fun y => |b y - a y|) (fun y => |b y + a y|)
        (hb.sub ha).abs (hb.add ha).abs
    simp only [sq_abs] at hCS
    have hS : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (b x + a x) ^ 2) ≤ 4 * A := by
      have h1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (b x + a x) ^ 2) ≤
          ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * b x ^ 2 + 2 * a x ^ 2) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num)
          (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
          (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
          (fun x _ => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b x - a x)])
      have h2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * b x ^ 2 + 2 * a x ^ 2)) =
          2 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, b x ^ 2) + 2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, a x ^ 2 := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
          intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        all_goals (apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
      linarith
    have hD0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (b x - a x) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hI2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |b x - a x| * |b x + a x|) ^ 2 ≤
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (b x - a x) ^ 2) * (4 * A) :=
      le_trans hCS (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS hD0)
    rw [hI] at hsup' hR5'
    refine ⟨le_trans hR5' (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hI2 hκ0.le), fun x => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hsup' x
    have h2 : |c x - b x| ^ 2 ≤ (2 * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |b y - a y| * |b y + a y|) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h1 2
    rw [sq_abs] at h2
    nlinarith
  
  have hdv : ∀ j x, HasDerivAt (fun y => w (j + 1) y - v y)
      (2 * κ * (w (j + 1) x - v x) + -(w j x ^ 2)) x := by
    intro j x
    have h := (hwd j x).sub (hvd x)
    have e : (q x + 2 * κ * w (j + 1) x - w j x ^ 2) - (2 * κ * v x + q x) =
        2 * κ * (w (j + 1) x - v x) + -(w j x ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [e] at h
    exact h
  have hdw : ∀ j x, HasDerivAt (fun y => w (j + 2) y - w (j + 1) y)
      (2 * κ * (w (j + 2) x - w (j + 1) x) + (w j x ^ 2 - w (j + 1) x ^ 2)) x := by
    intro j x
    have h := (hwd (j + 1) x).sub (hwd j x)
    have e : (q x + 2 * κ * w (j + 1 + 1) x - w (j + 1) x ^ 2) -
        (q x + 2 * κ * w (j + 1) x - w j x ^ 2) =
        2 * κ * (w (j + 2) x - w (j + 1) x) + (w j x ^ 2 - w (j + 1) x ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [e] at h
    exact h
  
  have hw1 : ∀ x, w 1 x = v x := by
    intro x
    have hp : Function.Periodic (fun y => w 1 y - v y) 1 := fun y => by
      show w 1 (y + 1) - v (y + 1) = w 1 y - v y
      rw [hwper 1 y, hvper y]
    have hd : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => w 1 y - v y) (2 * κ * (w 1 y - v y)) y := by
      intro y
      have h : HasDerivAt (fun y => w 1 y - v y)
          (2 * κ * (w 1 y - v y) + -(w 0 y ^ 2)) y := hdv 0 y
      rw [hw0x y] at h
      have e : 2 * κ * (w 1 y - v y) + -((0:ℝ) ^ 2) = 2 * κ * (w 1 y - v y) := by ring
      rw [e] at h
      exact h
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (hom _ hp hd x)
  
  have hE : ∀ j, (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w j x ^ 2) ≤ 4 * a2 := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      have h0 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w 0 x ^ 2) = 0 := by simp [hw0x]
      rw [h0]; linarith
    | succ j ih =>
      exact energy (w j) (w (j + 1)) (hwc j) (hwc (j + 1)) (hwper j) (hwper (j + 1)) (hdv j) ih
  
  have hD : ∀ j, (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w (j + 1) x - w j x) ^ 2) ≤ a2 * (1 / 64) ^ j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      show (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w 1 x - w 0 x) ^ 2) ≤ a2 * (1 / 64) ^ 0
      have h0 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w 1 x - w 0 x) ^ 2) = a2 := by
        rw [← ha2]; congr 1; funext x; rw [hw1 x, hw0x x, sub_zero]
      rw [h0]; simp
    | succ j ih =>
      have h : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w (j + 1 + 1) x - w (j + 1) x) ^ 2) ≤
          (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w (j + 1) x - w j x) ^ 2) * (4 * (4 * a2)) / κ :=
        (contr (4 * a2) (w j) (w (j + 1)) (w (j + 2)) (hwc j) (hwc (j + 1)) (hwc (j + 2))
          (hwper j) (hwper (j + 1)) (hwper (j + 2)) (hdw j) (hE j) (hE (j + 1))).1
      have hDj0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w (j + 1) x - w j x) ^ 2 :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
      have h2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w (j + 1) x - w j x) ^ 2) * (4 * (4 * a2)) / κ ≤
          (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w (j + 1) x - w j x) ^ 2) / 64 := by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hκ0 (by norm_num)]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstar hDj0]
      have e : a2 * (1 / 64 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) = a2 * (1 / 64) ^ j / 64 := by
        rw [pow_succ]; ring
      rw [e]
      linarith
  
  refine ⟨hE, fun j x => ?_⟩
  have h : (w (j + 2) x - w (j + 1) x) ^ 2 ≤
      4 * ((∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w (j + 1) x - w j x) ^ 2) * (4 * (4 * a2))) :=
    (contr (4 * a2) (w j) (w (j + 1)) (w (j + 2)) (hwc j) (hwc (j + 1)) (hwc (j + 2))
      (hwper j) (hwper (j + 1)) (hwper (j + 2)) (hdw j) (hE j) (hE (j + 1))).2 x
  have hDj := hD j
  have hpow : ((1:ℝ) / 64) ^ j = ((1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ j) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm j 2, pow_mul]; norm_num
  rw [hpow] at hDj
  have hb : 0 ≤ 8 * a2 * (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ j := by positivity
  apply abs_le_of_sq_le_sq _ hb
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDj ha0]

proof.tactics:

  have hex : ∀ x, ∃ y, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => w (k + 1) x) Filter.atTop (nhds y) :=
    fun x => cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete
      (cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (1 / 8 : ℝ) B (by norm_num) (hstep x))
  choose W hlim using hex
  obtain ⟨δ, hδdef⟩ : ∃ δ : ℕ → ℝ, δ = fun k => 8 / 7 * B * (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hb : ∀ k x, |W x - w (k + 1) x| ≤ δ k := by
    intro k x
    have h := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto (1 / 8 : ℝ) B (by norm_num) (hstep x) (hlim x) k
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] at h
    have e : B * (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k / (1 - 1 / 8) = 8 / 7 * B * (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k := by ring
    rw [hδdef]
    linarith
  have hδ0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ δ k := fun k => le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hb k 0)
  have hδ : Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have := (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8)
      (by norm_num)).const_mul (8 / 7 * B)
    rw [mul_zero] at this
    rw [hδdef]
    exact this
  
  have hper : Function.Periodic W 1 := by
    intro x
    have h1 := hlim (x + 1)
    have e : (fun k => w (k + 1) (x + 1)) = (fun k => w (k + 1) x) :=
      funext fun k => hwper (k + 1) x
    rw [e] at h1
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 (hlim x)
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.1
    ((hwper 1).isBounded_of_continuous one_ne_zero (hwc 1))
  have hC' : ∀ x, |w 1 x| ≤ C := fun x => by
    have := hC (w 1 x) ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = C + δ 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM : ∀ x, |W x| ≤ M := by
    intro x
    have h0 := hb 0 x
    have h1 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (W x) (w (0 + 1) x)
    have h2 := hC' x
    rw [hMdef]
    linarith
  have hsum : ∀ n x, |W x + w (n + 1) x| ≤ 2 * M + δ n := by
    intro n x
    have e : W x + w (n + 1) x = 2 * W x - (W x - w (n + 1) x) := by ring
    rw [e]
    have h1 := abs_sub_le (2 * W x) 0 (W x - w (n + 1) x)
    simp only [sub_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg] at h1
    have h2 : |2 * W x| = 2 * |W x| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_two]
    linarith [hM x, hb n x]
  
  have key : ∀ n y, dist (q y + 2 * κ * W y - W y ^ 2)
      (q y + 2 * κ * w (n + 2) y - w (n + 1) y ^ 2) ≤
        2 * |κ| * δ (n + 1) + δ n * (2 * M + δ n) := by
    intro n y
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have ha : |W y - w (n + 2) y| ≤ δ (n + 1) := hb (n + 1) y
    have e : q y + 2 * κ * W y - W y ^ 2 - (q y + 2 * κ * w (n + 2) y - w (n + 1) y ^ 2) =
        2 * κ * (W y - w (n + 2) y) - (W y - w (n + 1) y) * (W y + w (n + 1) y) := by ring
    rw [e]
    have h1 := abs_sub_le (2 * κ * (W y - w (n + 2) y)) 0
      ((W y - w (n + 1) y) * (W y + w (n + 1) y))
    simp only [sub_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg] at h1
    have h2 : |2 * κ * (W y - w (n + 2) y)| = 2 * |κ| * |W y - w (n + 2) y| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two]
    have h3 : |(W y - w (n + 1) y) * (W y + w (n + 1) y)| =
        |W y - w (n + 1) y| * |W y + w (n + 1) y| := abs_mul _ _
    have h4 : 2 * |κ| * |W y - w (n + 2) y| ≤ 2 * |κ| * δ (n + 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha (by positivity)
    have h5 : |W y - w (n + 1) y| * |W y + w (n + 1) y| ≤ δ n * (2 * M + δ n) :=
      mul_le_mul (hb n y) (hsum n y) (abs_nonneg _) (hδ0 n)
    linarith
  have hδ1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => δ (n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    hδ.comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have he : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => 2 * |κ| * δ (n + 1) + δ n * (2 * M + δ n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have := (hδ1.const_mul (2 * |κ|)).add (hδ.mul (hδ.const_add (2 * M)))
    have h0 : (2 * |κ| * 0 + 0 * (2 * M + 0) : ℝ) = 0 := by ring
    rw [h0] at this
    exact this
  have hW' : ∀ x, HasDerivAt W (q x + 2 * κ * W x - W x ^ 2) x := by
    intro x
    refine hasDerivAt_of_tendstoUniformly (l := Filter.atTop) (f := fun n => w (n + 2))
      (f' := fun n y => q y + 2 * κ * w (n + 2) y - w (n + 1) y ^ 2)
      (g' := fun y => q y + 2 * κ * W y - W y ^ 2) ?_ ?_ ?_ x
    · rw [Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff]
      intro ε hε
      filter_upwards [Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt_const hε he] with n hn
      intro y
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (key n y) hn
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n y => hwd (n + 1) y
    · intro y
      exact (hlim y).comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hWc : Continuous W := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hW' x).continuousAt
  refine ⟨W, hper, hW', fun A hA => ?_⟩
  have hpt : ∀ n x, W x ^ 2 ≤ w (n + 1) x ^ 2 + δ n * (2 * M + δ n) := by
    intro n x
    have e : W x ^ 2 - w (n + 1) x ^ 2 = (W x - w (n + 1) x) * (W x + w (n + 1) x) := by ring
    have h2 : (W x - w (n + 1) x) * (W x + w (n + 1) x) ≤ δ n * (2 * M + δ n) := by
      calc (W x - w (n + 1) x) * (W x + w (n + 1) x)
          ≤ |(W x - w (n + 1) x) * (W x + w (n + 1) x)| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |W x - w (n + 1) x| * |W x + w (n + 1) x| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ δ n * (2 * M + δ n) := mul_le_mul (hb n x) (hsum n x) (abs_nonneg _) (hδ0 n)
    linarith
  have hint : ∀ n, (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W x ^ 2) ≤ A + δ n * (2 * M + δ n) := by
    intro n
    have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => w (n + 1) x ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      ((hwc (n + 1)).pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
    calc (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W x ^ 2)
        ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w (n + 1) x ^ 2 + δ n * (2 * M + δ n)) :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num) ((hWc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _)
            ((((hwc (n + 1)).pow 2).add continuous_const).intervalIntegrable _ _)
            (fun x _ => hpt n x)
      _ = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w (n + 1) x ^ 2) + δ n * (2 * M + δ n) := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hi1 intervalIntegrable_const]
          simp
      _ ≤ A + δ n * (2 * M + δ n) := by linarith [hA (n + 1)]
  have hc : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => A + δ n * (2 * M + δ n)) Filter.atTop (nhds A) := by
    have := (hδ.mul (hδ.const_add (2 * M))).const_add A
    rw [zero_mul, add_zero] at this
    exact this
  exact ge_of_tendsto' hc hint

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q v w : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + q x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → Function.Periodic w 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ≤ 4 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) → 3 / 4 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ≤ 81 / 64 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2)

signature.name: periodic_riccati_compare_T
signature.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q v w : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + q x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → Function.Periodic w 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ≤ 4 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) → 3 / 4 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ≤ 81 / 64 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ q v w hvper hv hA hwper hw hBA
  have hκpos : (0:ℝ) < κ := by linarith
  have hvc : Continuous v := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hv x).continuousAt
  have hwc : Continuous w := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hw x).continuousAt
  have hfc : Continuous (fun x => -(w x ^ 2)) := (hwc.pow 2).neg
  have hfp : Function.Periodic (fun x => -(w x ^ 2)) 1 := fun x => by
    show -(w (x + 1) ^ 2) = -(w x ^ 2)
    rw [hwper x]
  have hdp : Function.Periodic (fun x => w x - v x) 1 := fun x => by
    show w (x + 1) - v (x + 1) = w x - v x
    rw [hwper x, hvper x]
  have hdd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => w y - v y)
      (2 * κ * (fun y => w y - v y) x + (fun y => -(w y ^ 2)) x) x := by
    intro x
    have := (hw x).sub (hv x)
    convert this using 1
    simp only
    ring
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hL⟩ := (periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ _ hfc hfp).2 _ hdp hdd
  have habs : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |(fun y => -(w y ^ 2)) x|) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2 := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x _
    simp only [abs_neg]
    exact abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)
  rw [habs] at hL
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w x - v x) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x * (w x - v x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD1 : D ≤ B ^ 2 / κ := by rw [hDdef, hBdef]; exact hL
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by
    rw [hAdef]; exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by
    rw [hBdef]; exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by
    rw [hDdef]; exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
  rw [← hAdef] at hA hBA ⊢
  rw [← hBdef] at hBA ⊢
  have hκD : D * κ ≤ B ^ 2 := (le_div_iff₀ hκpos).1 hD1
  have hB2 : B ^ 2 ≤ (4 * A) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hB0 hBA 2
  have hA1024 : 1024 * A * A ≤ κ * A := by nlinarith
  have hD64 : D ≤ A / 64 := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have : A / 64 * κ < D * κ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hc hκpos
    nlinarith
  have hid : B = A + 2 * C + D := by
    rw [hBdef, hAdef, hCdef, hDdef]
    have e : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1,
        (v x ^ 2 + 2 * (v x * (w x - v x)) + (w x - v x) ^ 2) := by
      congr 1; funext x; ring
    rw [e, intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_add,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    all_goals (apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
  have hCS : C ^ 2 ≤ A * D := by
    rw [hCdef, hAdef, hDdef]
    exact cauchy_schwarz_unit_interval v (fun x => w x - v x) hvc (hwc.sub hvc)
  have hC2 : C ^ 2 ≤ (A / 8) ^ 2 := by
    have : A * D ≤ A * (A / 64) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD64 hA0
    nlinarith
  have hCabs := abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hC2 (by linarith)
  constructor <;> linarith [hCabs.1, hCabs.2]

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Function.Periodic f 1 → (∃ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 ∧ ∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) ∧ ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) → (∀ x, v x = -(1 - Real.exp (-(2 * κ)))⁻¹ * ∫ y in x..(x + 1), Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (y - x)) * f y) ∧ (∀ x, |v x| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |f y|) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |f x|) ^ 2 / κ

subgoal_signatures.name: cauchy_schwarz_unit_interval
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x * g x) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g x ^ 2)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ q p : CinfT, WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → WT κ ((ιT p : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - greenT κ (p : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) ≤ 2 * ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2

signature.name: green_T_small_lipschitz
signature.statement: ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ q p : CinfT, WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → WT κ ((ιT p : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - greenT κ (p : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) ≤ 2 * ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ q p hq hp
  obtain ⟨wp, wm, hwpP, hwmP, hwpD, hwmD, hwp2, hwm2, hwd⟩ := riccati_pair_T κ hκ q hq
  obtain ⟨up, um, hupP, humP, hupD, humD, hup2, hum2, hud⟩ := riccati_pair_T κ hκ p hp
  have hA : ∀ x, 3 / 2 ≤ 2 * κ + wm x - wp x := by
    intro x
    have h := (abs_le.1 (hwd x)).1
    linarith
  have hB : ∀ x, 3 / 2 ≤ 2 * κ + um x - up x := by
    intro x
    have h := (abs_le.1 (hud x)).1
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hGq, hgq⟩ := greenT_eq_of_riccati_pair_T κ q wp wm hwpP hwmP hwpD hwmD
    (fun x => by linarith [hA x])
  obtain ⟨hGp, hgp⟩ := greenT_eq_of_riccati_pair_T κ p up um hupP humP hupD humD
    (fun x => by linarith [hB x])
  refine ⟨hGq, ?_⟩
  have h3 := riccati_L2_lipschitz_plus_T κ hκ q p wp up hwpP hupP hwpD hupD hwp2 hup2
  have h4 := riccati_L2_lipschitz_minus_T κ hκ q p wm um hwmP humP hwmD humD hwm2 hum2
  have cwp : Continuous wp := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hwpD x).continuousAt
  have cwm : Continuous wm := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hwmD x).continuousAt
  have cup : Continuous up := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hupD x).continuousAt
  have cum : Continuous um := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (humD x).continuousAt
  have hpt : ∀ x, (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - greenT κ (p : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 ≤
      32 / 81 * ((wp x - up x) ^ 2 + (wm x - um x) ^ 2) := by
    intro x
    rw [hgq x, hgp x]
    have ha := hA x
    have hb := hB x
    set a := 2 * κ + wm x - wp x with ha_def
    set b := 2 * κ + um x - up x with hb_def
    have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
    have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith
    have hdiff : 1 / a - 1 / b = (b - a) / (a * b) := by
      field_simp
    have hab : 9 / 4 ≤ a * b := by nlinarith
    have hP : 81 / 16 ≤ (a * b) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hX : (b - a) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ((wp x - up x) ^ 2 + (wm x - um x) ^ 2) := by
      have e : b - a = (um x - wm x) - (up x - wp x) := by
        rw [ha_def, hb_def]; ring
      rw [e]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((um x - wm x) + (up x - wp x))]
    have hY : 0 ≤ (wp x - up x) ^ 2 + (wm x - um x) ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [hdiff, div_pow, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP hY]
  have hLint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x => (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - greenT κ (p : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
    ((hGq.1.continuous.sub hGp.1.continuous).pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have i1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => (wp x - up x) ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
    ((cwp.sub cup).pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have i2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => (wm x - um x) ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
    ((cwm.sub cum).pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hRint : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x => 32 / 81 * ((wp x - up x) ^ 2 + (wm x - um x) ^ 2)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
    (continuous_const.mul (((cwp.sub cup).pow 2).add ((cwm.sub cum).pow 2))).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hmono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one hLint hRint (fun x _ => hpt x)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_add i1 i2] at hmono
  have hD : 0 ≤ ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  nlinarith

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_pair_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ q : CinfT, WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → ∃ wp wm : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic wp 1 ∧ Function.Periodic wm 1 ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2) x) ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wp x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wm x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 ∧ ∀ x, |wm x - wp x| ≤ κ / 2

subgoal_signatures.name: greenT_eq_of_riccati_pair_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (q : CinfT) (wp wm : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic wp 1 → Function.Periodic wm 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, 0 < 2 * κ + wm x - wp x) → IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧ ∀ x, greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x)

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_L2_lipschitz_plus_T

  have resolvent_energy_hasDerivAt : ∀ (D G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => D p.1 p.2) → Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G p.1 p.2) → (∀ t x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => D s x) (G t x) t) → ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (-(1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹ * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * s) * D τ (x + s)) ^ 2) (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, 2 * (-(1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹ * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * s) * D t (x + s)) * (-(1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹ * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * s) * G t (x + s))) t := by

  have resolvent_energy_rate_bound : ∀ (v f r g : ℝ → ℝ) (a L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L → Continuous v → Continuous f → Continuous r → Continuous g → Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt v (2 * v x + g x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, r x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) / 4 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) ≤ L ^ 2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2 → |∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, 2 * v x * (f x + 2 * r x + a * (2 * v x + g x))| ≤ 4 * L * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2 := by

    have cY : Y ^ 2 ≤ A * R := cauchy_schwarz_unit_interval v r hv hr
    have hLA : 0 ≤ L * A := mul_nonneg hL hA0
    have hX2 : X ^ 2 ≤ (L * A) ^ 2 := by

      _ ≤ 4 * L * A := by linarith

  have hk1 : ∀ q : CinfT, ContDiff ℝ 1 (q : ℝ → ℝ) :=
    fun q => q.2.1.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
  have hkc : ∀ q : CinfT, Continuous (q : ℝ → ℝ) := fun q => q.2.1.continuous
  have hkp : ∀ q : CinfT, Function.Periodic (q : ℝ → ℝ) 1 := fun q => q.2.2
  have hkd : ∀ q : CinfT, Continuous (deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ)) :=
    fun q => (hk1 q).continuous_deriv le_rfl
  have hD1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (d p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2) := hd2.of_le (by norm_num)
  
  have hGc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      (fun τ y => deriv (e τ : ℝ → ℝ) y + a * deriv (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) y) p.1 p.2) :=
    time_partial_continuous_of_contDiff (fun τ y => (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) y)
      (fun τ y => deriv (e τ : ℝ → ℝ) y + a * deriv (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) y) hD1 hderiv
  
  have hE := resolvent_energy_hasDerivAt (fun τ y => (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) y)
      (fun τ y => deriv (e τ : ℝ → ℝ) y + a * deriv (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) y) hd2.continuous hGc hderiv
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, V = fun τ x => -(1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹ *
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * s) * (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) (x + s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, W = fun τ x => -(1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹ *
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * s) *
        (deriv (e τ : ℝ → ℝ) (x + s) + a * deriv (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) (x + s)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, Q = fun τ x => -(1 - Real.exp (-2))⁻¹ *
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * s) * (e τ : ℝ → ℝ) (x + s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hE' : ∀ τ, HasDerivAt (fun σ => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, V σ x ^ 2)
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, 2 * V τ x * W τ x) τ := by
    intro τ
    rw [hV, hW]
    exact hE τ
  
  have hVf : ∀ τ, Function.Periodic (V τ) 1 ∧
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt (V τ) (2 * V τ x + (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) x) x) ∧
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, V τ x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2) / 4 :=
    fun τ => resolvent_one_facts_T (d τ) (V τ) (hkc _) (hkp _) (fun x => by rw [hV])
  have hQf : ∀ τ, Function.Periodic (Q τ) 1 ∧
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt (Q τ) (2 * Q τ x + (e τ : ℝ → ℝ) x) x) ∧
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, Q τ x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (e τ : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2) / 4 :=
    fun τ => resolvent_one_facts_T (e τ) (Q τ) (hkc _) (hkp _) (fun x => by rw [hQ])
  have hnorm : ∀ τ, ‖ιT (d τ)‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, V τ x ^ 2 :=
    fun τ => hm1T_norm_sq_resolvent_one (d τ) (V τ) (hVf τ).1 (hVf τ).2.1
  
  have hWid : ∀ τ x, W τ x = (e τ : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * Q τ x +
      a * (2 * V τ x + (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) x) := by
    intro τ x
    have i1 := resolvent_one_deriv_ibp (e τ) (hk1 _) (hkp _) x
    have i2 := resolvent_one_deriv_ibp (d τ) (hk1 _) (hkp _) x
    have c1 : Continuous fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * s) * deriv (e τ : ℝ → ℝ) (x + s) :=
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).mul
        ((hkd _).comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id))
    have c2 : Continuous fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * s) * deriv (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) (x + s) :=
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).mul
        ((hkd _).comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id))
    have hsplit : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * s) *
        (deriv (e τ : ℝ → ℝ) (x + s) + a * deriv (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) (x + s))) =
        (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * s) * deriv (e τ : ℝ → ℝ) (x + s)) +
          a * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * s) * deriv (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) (x + s) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_add (c1.intervalIntegrable _ _)
          ((c2.intervalIntegrable _ _).const_mul a)]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
      try simp only
      ring
    rw [hW, hQ, hV]
    try simp only
    rw [hsplit]
    linear_combination i1 + a * i2
  have hEder : ∀ τ, HasDerivAt (fun σ => ‖ιT (d σ)‖ ^ 2)
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, 2 * V τ x * W τ x) τ := by
    intro τ
    have hfun : (fun σ => ‖ιT (d σ)‖ ^ 2) = fun σ => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, V σ x ^ 2 :=
      funext hnorm
    rw [hfun]
    exact hE' τ
  
  have hrate : ∀ τ, |∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, 2 * V τ x * W τ x| ≤ 4 * L * ‖ιT (d τ)‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro τ
    have hVc : Continuous (V τ) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => ((hVf τ).2.1 x).continuousAt
    have hQc : Continuous (Q τ) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => ((hQf τ).2.1 x).continuousAt
    have hint : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, 2 * V τ x * W τ x) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, 2 * V τ x *
        ((e τ : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * Q τ x + a * (2 * V τ x + (d τ : ℝ → ℝ) x)) := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      simp only [hWid]
    have hfe : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (e τ : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2) ≤ L ^ 2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, V τ x ^ 2 := by
      rw [← hnorm τ]
      exact hL2 τ
    rw [hint, hnorm τ]
    exact resolvent_energy_rate_bound (V τ) (e τ) (Q τ) (d τ) a L hL hVc (hkc _) hQc (hkc _)
      (hVf τ).1 (hVf τ).2.1 (hQf τ).2.2 hfe
  
  have hgr := transport_gronwall_scalar (fun σ => ‖ιT (d σ)‖ ^ 2)
    (fun τ => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, 2 * V τ x * W τ x) (4 * L) (by linarith) hEder hrate t
  beta_reduce at hgr
  
  have hexp : Real.exp (4 * L * |t|) = Real.exp (2 * L * |t|) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add]
    ring_nf
  rw [hexp, ← mul_pow] at hgr
  exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity) two_ne_zero).1 hgr

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Function.Periodic f 1 → (∃ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 ∧ ∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) ∧ ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) → (∀ x, v x = -(1 - Real.exp (-(2 * κ)))⁻¹ * ∫ y in x..(x + 1), Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (y - x)) * f y) ∧ (∀ x, |v x| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |f y|) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |f x|) ^ 2 / κ

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_parseval_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q : CinfT) (v : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) = ∑' n : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / ((2 * π * n) ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n‖ ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: cauchy_schwarz_unit_interval
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x * g x) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g x ^ 2)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (κ ϰ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → 1 ≤ ϰ → ϰ ≠ κ → ∀ (q : CinfT) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic w 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt w ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * ϰ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ≤ ϰ / 256 → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic φ 1 ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (hkRHST κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * ϰ * φ x - 2 * w x * φ x) x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * φ x) = 0

signature.name: hk_riccati_current_T
signature.statement: ∀ (κ ϰ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → 1 ≤ ϰ → ϰ ≠ κ → ∀ (q : CinfT) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic w 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt w ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * ϰ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ≤ ϰ / 256 → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic φ 1 ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (hkRHST κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * ϰ * φ x - 2 * w x * φ x) x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * φ x) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ ϰ hκ hϰ hne q w hwper hwder hw2
  
  have deriv_per : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic f 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) →
      Function.Periodic f' 1 := by
    intro f f' hp hd x
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => f (y + 1)) (f' (x + 1)) x := (hd (x + 1)).comp_add_const x 1
    have h2 : (fun y => f (y + 1)) = f := funext hp

  have s1 : ∀ (a g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous a → Function.Periodic a 1 → Continuous g →
      Function.Periodic g 1 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, a x) ≠ 0 →
      ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic φ 1 ∧ ∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (a x * φ x + g x) x := by
    intro a g ha hap hg hgp hA
    obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, a x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hAdef] at hA

    have hPfun : P = fun x => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..x, a y := funext hP
    have hPd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt P (a x) x := by
      intro x; rw [hPfun]; exact (ha.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 x).hasDerivAt
    have hPc : Continuous P := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hPd x).continuousAt
    have hPp : ∀ x, P (x + 1) = P x + A := by

    obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ x, J x = ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..x, k y := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩

      intro x

      intro h; exact hA ((Real.exp_eq_one_iff A).1 h)

    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = Real.exp A * J 1 / (1 - Real.exp A) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

      rw [hC, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h1E]
    have hCeq : Real.exp A * (C + J 1) = C := by linear_combination -hC'
    refine ⟨fun x => Real.exp (P x) * (C + J x), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x
      show Real.exp (P (x + 1)) * (C + J (x + 1)) = Real.exp (P x) * (C + J x)
      rw [hPp, hJp, Real.exp_add]
      have hee : Real.exp A * Real.exp (-A) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
      calc Real.exp (P x) * Real.exp A * (C + (J 1 + Real.exp (-A) * J x))
          = Real.exp (P x) * (Real.exp A * (C + J 1) + (Real.exp A * Real.exp (-A)) * J x) := by
            ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hCeq, hee, one_mul]
    · intro x
      have h := ((hPd x).exp).mul ((hJd x).const_add C)

  have s5 : ∀ (w G φ F : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → Continuous F → Function.Periodic G 1 →
      Function.Periodic φ 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt G (2 * (w x - ϰ) * G x + 1) x) →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (F x + 2 * ϰ * φ x - 2 * w x * φ x) x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * φ x) =
        (1 / 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, F x) - ϰ * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, G x * F x := by

    have hΦ : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => G y * b2 y - (2 * (w y - ϰ) * G y + 1) * b1 y +
        (2 * (w y - ϰ) - 2 * (q y + 2 * ϰ * w y - w y * w y) * G y) * b y)
        (4 * (κ ^ 2 - ϰ ^ 2) * (G x * b1 x)) x := by
      intro x
      have hG1 := ((((hw x).sub_const ϰ).const_mul 2).mul (hG x)).add_const 1
      have hΨ := (((hw x).sub_const ϰ).const_mul 2).sub
