    have h4 : b 1 = b 0 := by simpa using hbp 0
    have h5 : b1 1 = b1 0 := by simpa using hb1p 0
    have h6 : b2 1 = b2 0 := by simpa using hb2p 0
    simp only [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, sub_self] at hI
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hI
    have hc : 4 * (κ ^ 2 - ϰ ^ 2) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (sub_ne_zero.2 hne2)
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 hI).resolve_left hc
  
  have hwc : Continuous w := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hwder x).continuousAt
  have hq3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 (q : ℝ → ℝ) := q.2.1.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
  have hqp : Function.Periodic (q : ℝ → ℝ) 1 := q.2.2
  have hqd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (q : ℝ → ℝ) (deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x :=
    fun x => ((hq3.differentiable (by norm_num)) x).hasDerivAt
  have hq'c : Continuous (deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ)) := hq3.continuous_deriv (by norm_num)
  have hq'p : Function.Periodic (deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 := deriv_per _ _ hqp hqd
  
  have hmean : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2 := by
    obtain ⟨m, hmdef⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ, m = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w x - m) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have e : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w x - m) ^ 2 =
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) - 2 * m * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x) + m ^ 2 := by
      have : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w x - m) ^ 2 =
          ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w x ^ 2 - (2 * m) * w x + m ^ 2) := by
        congr 1; funext x; ring
      rw [this, intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_sub,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      · simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
      all_goals (apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
    rw [← hmdef] at e
    rw [← hmdef]
    nlinarith
  have hm : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x) ≠ ϰ := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hmean
    nlinarith
  have hint1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, 2 * (w x - ϰ)) = 2 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x) - 2 * ϰ := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hwc.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      intervalIntegrable_const]
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
    ring
  have hint2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * ϰ - 2 * w x)) = 2 * ϰ - 2 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const
      ((hwc.intervalIntegrable _ _).const_mul 2)]
    have e2 : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, 2 * w x = 2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul 2 w
    rw [e2]
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨G, hGp, hGd⟩ := s1 (fun x => 2 * (w x - ϰ)) (fun _ => 1) (by fun_prop)
    (fun x => by show 2 * (w (x + 1) - ϰ) = 2 * (w x - ϰ); rw [hwper x]) continuous_const
    (fun _ => rfl) (by
      show (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, 2 * (w x - ϰ)) ≠ 0
      rw [hint1]
      intro h; apply hm; linarith)
  have hG : ∀ x, HasDerivAt G (2 * (w x - ϰ) * G x + 1) x := hGd
  have hGc : Continuous G := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hG x).continuousAt
  have hGq : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, G x * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 0 :=
    s3a _ _ G hqd hq'c hqp hwder hGp hG
  have hk2 : κ ^ 2 ≠ ϰ ^ 2 := by
    intro h
    have h' : (κ - ϰ) * (κ + ϰ) = 0 := by linear_combination h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h' with h'' | h''
    · exact hne (by linarith)
    · linarith
  
  have key_main : ∀ b : ℝ → ℝ, IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) b →
      Continuous (deriv b) ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt b (deriv b x) x) ∧ Function.Periodic b 1 ∧
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, G x * deriv b x = 0 := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨hbs, hbp, hbpos, hE⟩ := hb
    have hb3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 b := hbs.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
    have d0 : Differentiable ℝ b := hb3.differentiable (by norm_num)
    have d1 : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedDeriv 1 b) := hb3.differentiable_iteratedDeriv 1 (by norm_num)
    have d2 : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedDeriv 2 b) := hb3.differentiable_iteratedDeriv 2 (by norm_num)
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one] at d1
    have e2 : iteratedDeriv 2 b = deriv (deriv b) := by rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one]
    have e3 : iteratedDeriv 3 b = deriv (iteratedDeriv 2 b) := iteratedDeriv_succ
    have hbd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt b (deriv b x) x := fun x => (d0 x).hasDerivAt
    have hb1d : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (deriv b) (iteratedDeriv 2 b x) x := fun x => by
      rw [e2]; exact (d1 x).hasDerivAt
    have hb2d : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv 2 b) (iteratedDeriv 3 b x) x := fun x => by
      rw [e3]; exact (d2 x).hasDerivAt
    have hb1c : Continuous (deriv b) := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hb1d x).continuousAt
    have hb1p : Function.Periodic (deriv b) 1 := deriv_per _ _ hbp hbd
    have hb2p : Function.Periodic (iteratedDeriv 2 b) 1 := deriv_per _ _ hb1p hb1d
    have hode : ∀ x, iteratedDeriv 3 b x = 2 * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x * b x +
        4 * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x * deriv b x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv b x := by
      intro x
      have h := (((hb1d x).mul (hb1d x)).sub (((hbd x).const_mul 2).mul (hb2d x))).add
        ((((hqd x).const_add (κ ^ 2)).const_mul 4).mul ((hbd x).mul (hbd x)))
      have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => (1:ℝ)) (-2 * b x * (iteratedDeriv 3 b x -
          2 * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x * b x - 4 * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x * deriv b x -
          4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv b x)) x := by
        convert h using 1
        · funext y
          simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply]
          linear_combination (-1:ℝ) * hE y
        · simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply]
          ring
      have h1 := h0.unique (hasDerivAt_const x (1:ℝ))
      have hpos := hbpos x
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h1 with h2 | h2
      · exfalso; linarith
      · linarith
    exact ⟨hb1c, hbd, hbp, s3b _ _ G b (deriv b) (iteratedDeriv 2 b) (iteratedDeriv 3 b) hqd hqp
      hwder hGp hG hbd hb1d hb2d hbp hb1p hb2p hode hk2⟩
  have key : Continuous (deriv (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ))) ∧
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) (deriv (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x) x) ∧
      Function.Periodic (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 ∧
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, G x * deriv (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x = 0 := by
    by_cases h : ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) g
    · have hbeq : greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) = Classical.choose h := by
        rw [greenT, dif_pos h]
      rw [hbeq]
      exact key_main _ (Classical.choose_spec h)
    · have hbeq : greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) = fun _ => 1 / (2 * κ) := by
        rw [greenT, dif_neg h]
      rw [hbeq]
      have hd : deriv (fun _ : ℝ => 1 / (2 * κ)) = fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        funext x; exact deriv_const x _
      rw [hd]
      refine ⟨continuous_const, fun x => hasDerivAt_const x _, fun x => rfl, ?_⟩
      simp
  obtain ⟨hb1c, hbd, hbp, hGb⟩ := key
  have hb1p : Function.Periodic (deriv (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ))) 1 := deriv_per _ _ hbp hbd
  
  have hF : ∀ x, hkRHST κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x =
      16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
    fun x => rfl
  have hFfun : hkRHST κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) = fun x =>
      16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x := funext hF
  have hFc : Continuous (hkRHST κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) := by rw [hFfun]; fun_prop
  have hFp : Function.Periodic (hkRHST κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 := by
    intro x; rw [hF, hF, hb1p x, hq'p x]
  have hFint : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, hkRHST κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 0 := by
    have hH : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => 16 * κ ^ 5 * greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) y + 4 * κ ^ 2 * (q : ℝ → ℝ) y)
        (hkRHST κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x := by
      intro x; rw [hF]; exact ((hbd x).const_mul _).add ((hqd x).const_mul _)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun x _ => hH x) (hFc.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    have h4 : greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) 1 = greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) 0 := by simpa using hbp 0
    have h3 : (q : ℝ → ℝ) 1 = (q : ℝ → ℝ) 0 := by simpa using hqp 0
    simp only [h3, h4, sub_self]
  have hGF : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, G x * hkRHST κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 0 := by
    have e : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, G x * hkRHST κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x =
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (16 * κ ^ 5 * (G x * deriv (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x) +
          4 * κ ^ 2 * (G x * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x)) := by
      congr 1; funext x; rw [hF]; ring
    rw [e, intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hGb, hGq]
    · ring
    all_goals (apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
  
  obtain ⟨φ, hφp, hφd⟩ := s1 (fun x => 2 * ϰ - 2 * w x) (hkRHST κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) (by fun_prop)
    (fun x => by show 2 * ϰ - 2 * w (x + 1) = 2 * ϰ - 2 * w x; rw [hwper x]) hFc hFp
    (by
      show (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * ϰ - 2 * w x)) ≠ 0
      rw [hint2]
      intro h; apply hm; linarith)
  have hφ : ∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (hkRHST κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * ϰ * φ x - 2 * w x * φ x) x := by
    intro x
    convert hφd x using 1
    ring
  refine ⟨φ, hφp, hφ, ?_⟩
  rw [s5 w G φ _ hwc hFc hGp hφp hG hφ, hFint, hGF]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (c : ℝ → CinfT), ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (c p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2) → ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (c s : ℝ → ℝ) x) (F t x) t) → ∀ ϰ : ℝ, 1 ≤ ϰ → ∀ (W : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ᶠ s in nhds t₀, Function.Periodic (W s) 1 ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt (W s) ((c s : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * ϰ * W s x - W s x ^ 2) x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W s x ^ 2) ≤ ϰ / 256) → Function.Periodic φ 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (F t₀ x + 2 * ϰ * φ x - 2 * W t₀ x * φ x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W t₀ x * φ x) = 0 → HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W s x ^ 2) 0 t₀

signature.name: riccati_conservation_of_current_T
signature.statement: ∀ (c : ℝ → CinfT), ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (c p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2) → ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (c s : ℝ → ℝ) x) (F t x) t) → ∀ ϰ : ℝ, 1 ≤ ϰ → ∀ (W : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ᶠ s in nhds t₀, Function.Periodic (W s) 1 ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt (W s) ((c s : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * ϰ * W s x - W s x ^ 2) x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W s x ^ 2) ≤ ϰ / 256) → Function.Periodic φ 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (F t₀ x + 2 * ϰ * φ x - 2 * W t₀ x * φ x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W t₀ x * φ x) = 0 → HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W s x ^ 2) 0 t₀

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have P : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 0 < κ → ∀ (a g f : ℝ → ℝ) (G : ℝ), Continuous a → Function.Periodic a 1 →
      Continuous g → Function.Periodic f 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt f ((2 * κ - a x) * f x + g x) x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |a x|) ≤ κ → (∀ y, |g y| ≤ G) →
      ∀ x, |f x| ≤ Real.exp κ / (1 - Real.exp (-κ)) * G := by
    intro κ hκ a g f G ha hap hg hfp hf hint hG x
    have hb : Continuous (fun t => 2 * κ - a t) := continuous_const.sub ha
    have habs : Continuous (fun t => |a t|) := ha.abs
    have hI : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => ∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t)) (2 * κ - a y) y :=
      fun y => (hb.integral_hasStrictDerivAt x y).hasDerivAt
    have hE : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.exp (-(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t))))
        (Real.exp (-(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t))) * (-(2 * κ - a y))) y :=
      fun y => (hI y).neg.exp
    have hF : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.exp (-(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t))) * f y)
        (Real.exp (-(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t))) * g y) y := by
      intro y
      have := (hE y).mul (hf y)
      convert this using 1
      ring
    have hEc : Continuous (fun y => Real.exp (-(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t)))) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun y => (hE y).continuousAt
    have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (a := x) (b := x + 1)
      (fun y _ => hF y) ((hEc.mul hg).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_same, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul, hfp x] at hFTC
    have hshift : (∫ t in x..x + 1, |a t|) = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, |a t| := by
      have hp : Function.Periodic (fun t => |a t|) 1 := fun t => by simp only [hap t]
      have := hp.intervalIntegral_add_eq x 0
      simpa using this
    have hIb : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc x (x + 1), -(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t)) ≤ κ := by
      intro y hy
      have h1 : -(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t)) ≤ ∫ t in x..y, |a t| := by
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hy.1 ((hb.neg).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          (habs.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        intro t _
        have := le_abs_self (a t)
        linarith
      have h2 : (∫ t in x..y, |a t|) ≤ ∫ t in x..x + 1, |a t| := by
        have hadd := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume) (a := x)
          (b := y) (c := x + 1) (habs.intervalIntegrable _ _) (habs.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        have : 0 ≤ ∫ t in y..x + 1, |a t| :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hy.2 (fun t _ => abs_nonneg _)
        linarith
      linarith
    have hI1 : -(∫ t in x..x + 1, (2 * κ - a t)) ≤ -κ := by
      have h1 : -(∫ t in x..x + 1, (2 * κ - a t)) ≤ (∫ t in x..x + 1, |a t|) - 2 * κ := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const (ha.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
        simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, add_sub_cancel_left, one_smul]
        have : (∫ t in x..x + 1, a t) ≤ ∫ t in x..x + 1, |a t| :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by linarith) (ha.intervalIntegrable _ _)
            (habs.intervalIntegrable _ _) (fun t _ => le_abs_self _)
        linarith
      rw [hshift] at h1
      linarith
    have hnorm : ‖∫ y in x..x + 1, Real.exp (-(∫ t in x..y, (2 * κ - a t))) * g y‖ ≤
        Real.exp κ * G * |x + 1 - x| := by
      apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      intro y hy
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le (by linarith)] at hy
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact mul_le_mul (Real.exp_le_exp.2 (hIb y ⟨hy.1.le, hy.2⟩)) (hG y) (abs_nonneg _)
        (Real.exp_pos _).le
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hFTC, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_one, mul_one] at hnorm
    set β := -(∫ t in x..x + 1, (2 * κ - a t)) with hβ
    have hE1 : Real.exp β ≤ Real.exp (-κ) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hI1
    have hek : Real.exp (-κ) < 1 := by
      have := Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (show -κ < 0 by linarith)
      rwa [Real.exp_zero] at this
    have hpos : 0 < 1 - Real.exp (-κ) := by linarith
    have h3 : Real.exp β * f x - f x = -(f x * (1 - Real.exp β)) := by ring
    rw [h3, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 - Real.exp β)] at hnorm
    have h4 : |f x| * (1 - Real.exp (-κ)) ≤ Real.exp κ * G := by
      calc |f x| * (1 - Real.exp (-κ)) ≤ |f x| * (1 - Real.exp β) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ Real.exp κ * G := hnorm
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hpos]
    exact h4
  
  have s3 : ∀ (κ M : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → 0 ≤ M → ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ (q q₁ g w w₁ φ : ℝ → ℝ) (h : ℝ),
      Continuous q → Continuous q₁ → Continuous g → Function.Periodic w 1 →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 256 → Function.Periodic w₁ 1 →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt w₁ (q₁ x + 2 * κ * w₁ x - w₁ x ^ 2) x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 256 → Function.Periodic φ 1 →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (g x + 2 * κ * φ x - 2 * w x * φ x) x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * φ x) = 0 → (∀ x, |q₁ x - q x| ≤ M * |h|) →
      (∀ x, |q₁ x - q x - h * g x| ≤ M * h ^ 2) →
      |(∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ x ^ 2) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2)| ≤ K * h ^ 2 := by
    intro κ M hκ hM
    have hκ0 : 0 < κ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = Real.exp κ / (1 - Real.exp (-κ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hek : Real.exp (-κ) < 1 := by
      have := Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (show -κ < 0 by linarith)
      rwa [Real.exp_zero] at this
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
      rw [hCdef]; exact div_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (by linarith)
    refine ⟨2 * (C * (M + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2)) * (1 / 4 + κ / 256) + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2, ?_⟩
    intro q q₁ g w w₁ φ h hq hq₁ hg hwp hw hwE hw₁p hw₁ hw₁E hφp hφ hwφ hT1 hT2
    have hwc : Continuous w := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hw x).continuousAt
    have hw₁c : Continuous w₁ := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hw₁ x).continuousAt
    have hφc : Continuous φ := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hφ x).continuousAt
    have hpt : ∀ v : ℝ, |v| ≤ 1 / 4 + v ^ 2 := by
      intro v
      nlinarith [sq_abs v, abs_nonneg v, sq_nonneg (|v| - 1 / 2)]
    have hwabs : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w x|) ≤ 1 / 4 + κ / 256 := by
      have h1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w x|) ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (1 / 4 + w x ^ 2) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num) (hwc.abs.intervalIntegrable _ _)
          ((continuous_const.add (hwc.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable _ _) (fun x _ => hpt (w x))
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const
        ((hwc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _)] at h1
      simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, one_smul] at h1
      linarith
    
    have hδ : ∀ x, |w₁ x - w x| ≤ C * (M * |h|) := by
      have hint : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w x + w₁ x|) ≤ κ := by
        have h1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w x + w₁ x|) ≤
            ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (1 / 2 + (w x ^ 2 + w₁ x ^ 2)) := by
          apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num)
            ((hwc.add hw₁c).abs.intervalIntegrable _ _)
            ((continuous_const.add ((hwc.pow 2).add (hw₁c.pow 2))).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          intro x _
          have := abs_add_le (w x) (w₁ x)
          have := hpt (w x)
          have := hpt (w₁ x)
          linarith
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const
          (((hwc.pow 2).add (hw₁c.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable _ _),
          intervalIntegral.integral_add ((hwc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _)
            ((hw₁c.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _)] at h1
        simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, one_smul] at h1
        linarith
      have hder : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => w₁ y - w y)
          ((2 * κ - (fun y => w y + w₁ y) x) * (fun y => w₁ y - w y) x +
            (fun y => q₁ y - q y) x) x := by
        intro x
        have := (hw₁ x).sub (hw x)
        convert this using 1
        ring
      have := P κ hκ0 (fun y => w y + w₁ y) (fun y => q₁ y - q y) (fun y => w₁ y - w y) (M * |h|)
        (hwc.add hw₁c) (fun y => by simp only [hwp y, hw₁p y]) (hq₁.sub hq)
        (fun y => by simp only [hwp y, hw₁p y]) hder hint hT1
      intro x
      rw [hCdef]
      exact this x
    
    have he : ∀ x, |w₁ x - w x - h * φ x| ≤ C * ((M + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2) * h ^ 2) := by
      have hint : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |2 * w x|) ≤ κ := by
        have h1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |2 * w x|) ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (1 / 2 + 2 * w x ^ 2) := by
          apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num)
            ((continuous_const.mul hwc).abs.intervalIntegrable _ _)
            ((continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul (hwc.pow 2))).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          intro x _
          rw [abs_mul, abs_two]
          have := hpt (w x)
          linarith
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const
          ((continuous_const.mul (hwc.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable _ _),
          intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h1
        simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, one_smul] at h1
        linarith
      have hder : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => w₁ y - w y - h * φ y)
          ((2 * κ - (fun y => 2 * w y) x) * (fun y => w₁ y - w y - h * φ y) x +
            (fun y => (q₁ y - q y - h * g y) - (w₁ y - w y) ^ 2) x) x := by
        intro x
        have := ((hw₁ x).sub (hw x)).sub ((hφ x).const_mul h)
        convert this using 1
        ring
      have hG : ∀ y, |(q₁ y - q y - h * g y) - (w₁ y - w y) ^ 2| ≤
          (M + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2) * h ^ 2 := by
        intro y
        have h1 := abs_sub (q₁ y - q y - h * g y) ((w₁ y - w y) ^ 2)
        have h2 : |(w₁ y - w y) ^ 2| ≤ C ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * h ^ 2 := by
          rw [abs_pow]
          have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hδ y) 2
          calc |w₁ y - w y| ^ 2 ≤ (C * (M * |h|)) ^ 2 := this
            _ = C ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * h ^ 2 := by rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs]; ring
        have h3 := hT2 y
        nlinarith
      have := P κ hκ0 (fun y => 2 * w y) (fun y => (q₁ y - q y - h * g y) - (w₁ y - w y) ^ 2)
        (fun y => w₁ y - w y - h * φ y) ((M + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2) * h ^ 2)
        (continuous_const.mul hwc) (fun y => by simp only [hwp y])
        ((hq₁.sub hq).sub (continuous_const.mul hg) |>.sub ((hw₁c.sub hwc).pow 2))
        (fun y => by simp only [hwp y, hw₁p y, hφp y]) hder hint hG
      intro x
      have hx := this x
      rw [← hCdef] at hx
      exact hx
    
    have hexp : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ x ^ 2) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) =
        2 * h * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * φ x) +
        2 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * (w₁ x - w x - h * φ x)) +
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w x) ^ 2 := by
      have e1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ x ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w x ^ 2 +
          (2 * h * (w x * φ x) + (2 * (w x * (w₁ x - w x - h * φ x)) + (w₁ x - w x) ^ 2))) := by
        congr 1; funext x; ring
      rw [e1, intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_add,
        intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      · ring
      all_goals (apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
    rw [hwφ, mul_zero, zero_add] at hexp
    rw [hexp]
    set E₂ := C * ((M + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2) * h ^ 2) with hE₂
    have hE₂0 : 0 ≤ E₂ := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (he 0)
    have hX : |∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * (w₁ x - w x - h * φ x)| ≤ E₂ * (1 / 4 + κ / 256) := by
      have h1 := intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs (μ := volume)
        (f := fun x => w x * (w₁ x - w x - h * φ x)) (a := 0) (b := 1) (by norm_num)
      have h2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w x * (w₁ x - w x - h * φ x)|) ≤
          ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w x| * E₂ := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num)
        · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop
        · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop
        intro x _
        rw [abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (he x) (abs_nonneg _)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const] at h2
      have h3 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w x|) * E₂ ≤ (1 / 4 + κ / 256) * E₂ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hwabs hE₂0
      linarith
    have hY0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w x) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hY : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w x) ^ 2) ≤ C ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * h ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w x) ^ 2) ≤
          ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, C ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * h ^ 2 := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num)
        · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop
        · exact intervalIntegrable_const
        intro x _
        have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hδ x) 2
        rw [sq_abs] at this
        calc (w₁ x - w x) ^ 2 ≤ (C * (M * |h|)) ^ 2 := this
          _ = C ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * h ^ 2 := by rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs]; ring
      simpa using h1
    have hK : (2 * (C * (M + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2)) * (1 / 4 + κ / 256) + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2) * h ^ 2 =
        2 * (E₂ * (1 / 4 + κ / 256)) + C ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * h ^ 2 := by
      rw [hE₂]; ring
    rw [hK, abs_le]
    have hX' := abs_le.1 hX
    constructor <;> linarith [hX'.1, hX'.2]
  intro c hc2 F hF ϰ hϰ W t₀ φ hW hφp hφd hwφ
  
  have bound : ∀ V : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Continuous V → (∀ t x : ℝ, V (t, x + 1) = V (t, x)) →
      ∃ B ≥ (0:ℝ), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), ∀ x : ℝ, |V (t, x)| ≤ B := by
    intro V hV hper
    have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :=
      isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hV.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun t ht x => ?_⟩
    have hp : Function.Periodic (fun y => V (t, y)) 1 := fun y => hper t y
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hp.exists_mem_Ico₀ zero_lt_one x
    have h1 := hC (t, y) (Set.mk_mem_prod ht (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hy))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    have hxy' : V (t, x) = V (t, y) := hxy
    rw [hxy']
    exact h1.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have mvt2 : ∀ (g g' g'' : ℝ → ℝ) (A B : ℝ), (∀ s, HasDerivAt g (g' s) s) →
      (∀ s, HasDerivAt g' (g'' s) s) →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), |g' s| ≤ A) →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), |g'' s| ≤ B) →
      ∀ h : ℝ, |h| ≤ 1 → |g (t₀ + h) - g t₀| ≤ A * |h| ∧
        |g (t₀ + h) - g t₀ - h * g' t₀| ≤ B * h ^ 2 := by
    intro g g' g'' A B hg hg' hA hB h hh
    have hh' := abs_le.1 hh
    have hsub : Set.uIcc t₀ (t₀ + h) ⊆ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1) := by
      intro σ hσ
      rcases Set.mem_uIcc.1 hσ with h1 | h1
      · exact ⟨by linarith [h1.1, h1.2], by linarith [h1.1, h1.2]⟩
      · exact ⟨by linarith [h1.1, h1.2], by linarith [h1.1, h1.2]⟩
    have hdist : ∀ σ ∈ Set.uIcc t₀ (t₀ + h), |σ - t₀| ≤ |h| := by
      intro σ hσ
      rcases Set.mem_uIcc.1 hσ with h1 | h1
      · exact abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [h1.1, h1.2, neg_abs_le h, abs_nonneg h],
          by linarith [h1.1, h1.2, le_abs_self h, abs_nonneg h]⟩
      · exact abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [h1.1, h1.2, neg_abs_le h, abs_nonneg h],
          by linarith [h1.1, h1.2, le_abs_self h, abs_nonneg h]⟩
    have hconv : Convex ℝ (Set.uIcc t₀ (t₀ + h)) := convex_uIcc _ _
    have ha : t₀ ∈ Set.uIcc t₀ (t₀ + h) := Set.left_mem_uIcc
    have hb : t₀ + h ∈ Set.uIcc t₀ (t₀ + h) := Set.right_mem_uIcc
    have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hB t₀ ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
    constructor
    · have h1 := hconv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le (f := g) (f' := g') (C := A)
        (fun σ _ => (hg σ).hasDerivWithinAt)
        (fun σ hσ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hA σ (hsub hσ)) ha hb
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, add_sub_cancel_left] at h1
      exact h1
    · have haux : ∀ σ ∈ Set.uIcc t₀ (t₀ + h), |g' σ - g' t₀| ≤ B * |h| := by
        intro σ hσ
        have h1 := hconv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le (f := g') (f' := g'')
          (C := B) (fun τ _ => (hg' τ).hasDerivWithinAt)
          (fun τ hτ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hB τ (hsub hτ)) ha hσ
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
        exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdist σ hσ) hB0)
      have hψ : ∀ σ, HasDerivAt (fun τ => g τ - g t₀ - (τ - t₀) * g' t₀) (g' σ - g' t₀) σ := by
        intro σ
        have h1 := ((hg σ).sub_const (g t₀)).sub
          (((hasDerivAt_id' σ).sub_const t₀).mul_const (g' t₀))
        convert h1 using 1
        ring
      have h1 := hconv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
        (f := fun τ => g τ - g t₀ - (τ - t₀) * g' t₀) (f' := fun σ => g' σ - g' t₀)
        (C := B * |h|) (fun σ _ => (hψ σ).hasDerivWithinAt)
        (fun σ hσ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact haux σ hσ) ha hb
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, add_sub_cancel_left] at h1
      have e : (g (t₀ + h) - g t₀ - (t₀ + h - t₀) * g' t₀) - (g t₀ - g t₀ - (t₀ - t₀) * g' t₀) =
          g (t₀ + h) - g t₀ - h * g' t₀ := by ring
      have h2 : |g (t₀ + h) - g t₀ - h * g' t₀| ≤ B * |h| * |h| := by
        rw [← e]; exact h1
      calc |g (t₀ + h) - g t₀ - h * g' t₀| ≤ B * |h| * |h| := h2
        _ = B * h ^ 2 := by rw [mul_assoc, abs_mul_abs_self, sq]
  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, U = fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (c p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUeval : ∀ σ x : ℝ, U (σ, x) = (c σ : ℝ → ℝ) x := fun σ x => by rw [hUdef]
  have hU2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 U := by rw [hUdef]; exact hc2
  have hUd : Differentiable ℝ U := hU2.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hU' : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ U) := hU2.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, D = fun p => fderiv ℝ U p ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 D := by rw [hDdef]; exact hU'.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hDd : Differentiable ℝ D := hD1.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hDc : Continuous D := hD1.continuous
  obtain ⟨D₂, hD₂def⟩ : ∃ D₂ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, D₂ = fun p => fderiv ℝ D p ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD₂c : Continuous D₂ := by
    rw [hD₂def]; exact (hD1.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hγ : ∀ s x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => (σ, x)) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) s := fun s x =>
    (hasDerivAt_id' s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const s x)
  have hder1 : ∀ s x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => (c σ : ℝ → ℝ) x) (D (s, x)) s := by
    intro s x
    have h1 := (hUd (s, x)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hγ s x)
    have e : (U ∘ fun σ : ℝ => (σ, x)) = fun σ : ℝ => (c σ : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
      funext fun σ => hUeval σ x
    rw [e] at h1
    rw [hDdef]
    exact h1
  have hder2 : ∀ s x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => D (σ, x)) (D₂ (s, x)) s := by
    intro s x
    have h1 := (hDd (s, x)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hγ s x)
    rw [hD₂def]
    exact h1
  have hDper : ∀ s x : ℝ, D (s, x + 1) = D (s, x) := by
    intro s x
    have h1 := hder1 s (x + 1)
    have hfun : (fun σ : ℝ => (c σ : ℝ → ℝ) (x + 1)) = fun σ : ℝ => (c σ : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
      funext fun σ => (c σ).2.2 x
    rw [hfun] at h1
    exact h1.unique (hder1 s x)
  have hD₂per : ∀ s x : ℝ, D₂ (s, x + 1) = D₂ (s, x) := by
    intro s x
    have h1 := hder2 s (x + 1)
    have hfun : (fun σ : ℝ => D (σ, x + 1)) = fun σ : ℝ => D (σ, x) :=
      funext fun σ => hDper σ x
    rw [hfun] at h1
    exact h1.unique (hder2 s x)
  obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁0, hM₁⟩ := bound D hDc hDper
  obtain ⟨M₂, hM₂0, hM₂⟩ := bound D₂ hD₂c hD₂per
  have hid : ∀ x, D (t₀, x) = F t₀ x := fun x => (hder1 t₀ x).unique (hF t₀ x)
  have hgc : Continuous (F t₀) := by
    have e : F t₀ = fun x => D (t₀, x) := funext fun x => (hid x).symm
    rw [e]
    exact hDc.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  obtain ⟨M, hM0, hM⟩ : ∃ M ≥ (0:ℝ), ∀ h : ℝ, |h| ≤ 1 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      |(c (t₀ + h) : ℝ → ℝ) x - (c t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ M * |h| ∧
      |(c (t₀ + h) : ℝ → ℝ) x - (c t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x - h * F t₀ x| ≤ M * h ^ 2 := by
    refine ⟨max M₁ M₂, le_max_of_le_left hM₁0, fun h hh x => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mvt2 (fun σ => (c σ : ℝ → ℝ) x) (fun σ => D (σ, x)) (fun σ => D₂ (σ, x))
      (max M₁ M₂) (max M₁ M₂) (fun s => hder1 s x) (fun s => hder2 s x)
      (fun s hs => (hM₁ s hs x).trans (le_max_left _ _))
      (fun s hs => (hM₂ s hs x).trans (le_max_right _ _)) h hh
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    rw [← hid]
    exact h2
  
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.1 hW
  have h0 : dist t₀ t₀ < ε := by rw [dist_self]; exact hε
  obtain ⟨hw0p, hw0d, hw0E⟩ := hball h0
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := s3 ϰ M hϰ hM0
  have hbound : ∀ h : ℝ, |h| < min ε 1 →
      |(∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W (t₀ + h) x ^ 2) - (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W t₀ x ^ 2)| ≤ K * h ^ 2 := by
    intro h hh
    have hhε : |h| < ε := lt_of_lt_of_le hh (min_le_left _ _)
    have hh1 : |h| ≤ 1 := (lt_of_lt_of_le hh (min_le_right _ _)).le
    have hd : dist (t₀ + h) t₀ < ε := by rw [Real.dist_eq, add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hhε
    obtain ⟨h1p, h1d, h1E⟩ := hball hd
    exact hK (c t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) (c (t₀ + h) : ℝ → ℝ) (F t₀) (W t₀) (W (t₀ + h)) φ h
      (c t₀).2.1.continuous (c (t₀ + h)).2.1.continuous hgc hw0p hw0d hw0E h1p h1d h1E
      hφp hφd hwφ (fun x => (hM h hh1 x).1) (fun x => (hM h hh1 x).2)
  rw [hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero]
  have hO : (fun h : ℝ => (fun s => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W s x ^ 2) (t₀ + h) -
      (fun s => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, W s x ^ 2) t₀ - h • (0:ℝ)) =O[nhds 0] (fun h : ℝ => h ^ 2) := by
    apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound K
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0:ℝ) (lt_min hε one_pos)] with h hh
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hh
    simp only [smul_zero, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg h)]
    exact hbound h hh
  exact hO.trans_isLittleO (Asymptotics.isLittleO_pow_id (by norm_num))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ κ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ ρ ≥ (0 : ℝ), 2 * ρ ≤ κ → ∀ w₀ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w₀ → Function.Periodic w₀ 1 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₀ x ^ 2) < ρ ^ 2 → ∃ V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, V 0 x = w₀ x) ∧ Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => V p.1 p.2) ∧ (∀ t, Function.Periodic (V t) 1) ∧ (∀ t, (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, V t x ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₀ x ^ 2) ∧ ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => V s x) (wfieldT κ (V t) x) t

signature.statement: ∀ κ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ ρ ≥ (0 : ℝ), 2 * ρ ≤ κ → ∀ w₀ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w₀ → Function.Periodic w₀ 1 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₀ x ^ 2) < ρ ^ 2 → ∃ V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, V 0 x = w₀ x) ∧ Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => V p.1 p.2) ∧ (∀ t, Function.Periodic (V t) 1) ∧ (∀ t, (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, V t x ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₀ x ^ 2) ∧ ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => V s x) (wfieldT κ (V t) x) t

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ ρ hρ h2ρ w₀ hw₀c hw₀p hw₀E
  
  have hbootstrap : ∀ (g D : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (D t) t) → g 0 < c →
      (∀ t : ℝ, g t ≤ c → D t = 0) → ∀ t : ℝ, g t = g 0 := by
    intro g D c hg h0 hD
    have hcont : Continuous g := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun t => (hg t).continuousAt
    have hclosed : IsClosed {t : ℝ | g t = g 0} := isClosed_eq hcont continuous_const
    have hopen : IsOpen {t : ℝ | g t = g 0} := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]

      (∀ t y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => f (s, y)) (F (t, y)) t) → ∀ b t x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun s => f (s, x + b * s))

  have hs5 : ∀ (f A : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (((⊤ : ℕ∞)) : WithTop ℕ∞) f →

subgoal_signatures.name: rgreenT_ode_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → Function.Periodic w 1 → (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y) < κ → (∀ x, HasDerivAt (rgreenT κ w) (2 * (w x - κ) * rgreenT κ w x + 1) x) ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt (rgreenRT κ w) (2 * (κ - w x) * rgreenRT κ w x - 1) x) ∧ Function.Periodic (rgreenT κ w) 1 ∧ Function.Periodic (rgreenRT κ w) 1 ∧ (∀ x, 0 < rgreenT κ w x)

subgoal_signatures.name: greenT_eq_rgreenT
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ κ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ u : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (((⊤ : ℕ∞)) : WithTop ℕ∞) u → Function.Periodic u 1 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, u x) < κ → greenT κ (fun x => deriv u x - 2 * κ * u x + u x ^ 2) = rgreenT κ u

search_metadata.last_error: Approved: the glue compiles and uses both children substantively. rgreenT_ode_T (already proved, shared with wflowT_smooth) supplies g', h' for the x-derivative of wfieldT and deriv g inside hkRHST, and greenT_eq_rgreenT rewrites greenT κ (c t). The blueprint's generic steps s3-s6 are proved inline, and findings.md records this as a Divergence with the crux kept in greenT_eq_rgreenT. greenT_eq_rgreenT is true and static: with α=u−κ we have κ²+Q(u)=α'+α², and g'=2αg+1 gives g'²−2gg''+4(α'+α²)g²=(g'−2αg)²=1, so rgreenT is an IsGreenT witness. Positive periodic IsGreenT solutions are unique: by Floquet theory only ψ₊ψ₋ can occur, and the elliptic/parabolic monodromy cases admit no solution. Its planner should take isGreenT_unique_T as the sub-crux. Blueprint §4/§5 carry adequate numerics, degenerate cases and falsification attempts. No assumed result is restated, no ancestor is restated, and a=4κ² is derived from the frame sign.

    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨vp, hvpP, hvpD⟩ := (periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ Q hQc hQp).1
  have hvp2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vp x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 1024 := by
    have h := periodic_resolvent_parseval_T κ hκ q vp hvpP hvpD
    rw [h]
    exact hW
  
  obtain ⟨Qr, hQr⟩ : ∃ Qr : ℝ → ℝ, Qr = fun x => Q (-x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQrx : ∀ x, Qr x = Q (-x) := fun x => by rw [hQr]
  have hQrc : Continuous Qr := by rw [hQr]; exact hQc.comp continuous_neg
  have hQrp : Function.Periodic Qr 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [hQrx, hQrx]
    have h1 := hQp (-(x + 1))
    rw [show -(x + 1) + 1 = -x by ring] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  obtain ⟨vr, hvrP, hvrD⟩ := (periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ Qr hQrc hQrp).1
  obtain ⟨vm, hvm⟩ : ∃ vm : ℝ → ℝ, vm = fun y => -vr (-y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hvmx : ∀ x, vm x = -vr (-x) := fun x => by rw [hvm]
  have hvmP : Function.Periodic vm 1 := by rw [hvm]; exact hreflP vr hvrP
  have hvmD : ∀ x, HasDerivAt vm (Q x - 2 * κ * vm x) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hvm]
    refine (hreflD vr _ hvrD x).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [hQrx, neg_neg]
    ring
  have hvpc := hcont vp _ hvpD
  have hvmc := hcont vm _ hvmD
  
  have hiso : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vm x ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vp x ^ 2 := by
    have hF : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt
        (fun y => -(1 / (4 * κ)) * ((vm y - vp y) * (vm y - vp y))) (vm x ^ 2 - vp x ^ 2) x := by
      intro x _
      have h1 := (((hvmD x).sub (hvpD x)).mul ((hvmD x).sub (hvpD x))).const_mul (-(1 / (4 * κ)))
      refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => vm x ^ 2 - vp x ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      ((hvmc.pow 2).sub (hvpc.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    have h2 := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hF hint
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((hvmc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      ((hvpc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1)] at h2
    have h3 : vm 1 = vm 0 := by simpa using hvmP 0
    have h4 : vp 1 = vp 0 := by simpa using hvpP 0
    rw [h3, h4, sub_self] at h2
    linarith
  have hvm2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vm x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 1024 := by rw [hiso]; exact hvp2
  have hvr2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vr x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 1024 := by
    have h1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vm x ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vr x ^ 2 := by
      simp only [hvmx]
      exact hRsq vr hvrP
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨wp, hwpP, hwpD, -, hwp2'⟩ :=
    periodic_riccati_exists_T κ hκ Q vp hQc hQp hvpP hvpD hvp2
  obtain ⟨wr, hwrP, hwrD, -, hwr2'⟩ :=
    periodic_riccati_exists_T κ hκ Qr vr hQrc hQrp hvrP hvrD hvr2
  obtain ⟨wm, hwm⟩ : ∃ wm : ℝ → ℝ, wm = fun y => -wr (-y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hwmx : ∀ x, wm x = -wr (-x) := fun x => by rw [hwm]
  have hwmP : Function.Periodic wm 1 := by rw [hwm]; exact hreflP wr hwrP
  have hwmD : ∀ x, HasDerivAt wm (Q x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hwm]
    refine (hreflD wr _ hwrD x).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [hQrx, neg_neg]
    ring
  have hwp2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wp x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 := by linarith
  have hwmr : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wm x ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wr x ^ 2 := by
    simp only [hwmx]
    exact hRsq wr hwrP
  have hwm2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wm x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 := by rw [hwmr]; linarith
  
  have hdp : ∀ x, |wp x - vp x| ≤ κ / 32 := by
    intro x
    have h := hdiff Q vp wp hvpP hvpD hwpP hwpD x
    linarith
  have hdm : ∀ x, |wm x - vm x| ≤ κ / 32 := by
    intro x
    have h := hdiff Qr vr wr hvrP hvrD hwrP hwrD (-x)
    rw [hwmx, hvmx, show -wr (-x) - -vr (-x) = -(wr (-x) - vr (-x)) by ring, abs_neg]
    linarith
  
  have hsob : ∀ x, |vm x - vp x| ≤ κ / 4 := by
    intro x
    have hhc : Continuous (fun t => κ * (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm t + vp t) ^ 2) :=
      (continuous_const.mul ((hvmc.sub hvpc).pow 2)).add
        (continuous_const.mul ((hvmc.add hvpc).pow 2))
    have hhp : Function.Periodic
        (fun t => κ * (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm t + vp t) ^ 2) 1 := fun t => by
      simp only [hvmP t, hvpP t]
    have hh0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ κ * (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm t + vp t) ^ 2 := fun t => by
      positivity
    have hDc : Continuous (fun t => -4 * κ * ((vm t - vp t) * (vm t + vp t))) :=
      continuous_const.mul ((hvmc.sub hvpc).mul (hvmc.add hvpc))
    have hu2c : Continuous (fun t => (vm t - vp t) ^ 2) := (hvmc.sub hvpc).pow 2
    have hu2p : Function.Periodic (fun t => (vm t - vp t) ^ 2) 1 := fun t => by
      simp only [hvmP t, hvpP t]
    have hIh : (∫ t in (x - 1)..x, κ * (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm t + vp t) ^ 2) =
        ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, κ * (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm t + vp t) ^ 2 := by
      have h1 := hhp.intervalIntegral_add_eq (x - 1) 0
      rw [show x - 1 + 1 = x by ring, zero_add] at h1
      exact h1
    have hIu : (∫ t in (x - 1)..x, (vm t - vp t) ^ 2) = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 := by
      have h1 := hu2p.intervalIntegral_add_eq (x - 1) 0
      rw [show x - 1 + 1 = x by ring, zero_add] at h1
      exact h1
    set I := ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, κ * (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm t + vp t) ^ 2 with hI
    have key : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (x - 1) x, (vm x - vp x) ^ 2 ≤ (vm y - vp y) ^ 2 + I := by
      intro y hy
      have hF : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc y x, HasDerivAt (fun s => (vm s - vp s) * (vm s - vp s))
          (-4 * κ * ((vm t - vp t) * (vm t + vp t))) t := by
        intro t _
        refine (((hvmD t).sub (hvpD t)).mul ((hvmD t).sub (hvpD t))).congr_deriv ?_
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        ring
      have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hF (hDc.intervalIntegrable y x)
      have hmon := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hy.2
        (hDc.intervalIntegrable y x)
        (hhc.intervalIntegrable y x) (fun t _ => by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hκ0.le (sq_nonneg ((vm t - vp t) + 2 * (vm t + vp t)))])
      have hadd := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        (hhc.intervalIntegrable (x - 1) y) (hhc.intervalIntegrable y x)
      have hnn := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hy.1
        (fun t _ => hh0 t)
      rw [hIh] at hadd
      nlinarith
    have hmono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
      (by linarith : x - 1 ≤ x)
      (f := fun _ => (vm x - vp x) ^ 2) (g := fun y => (vm y - vp y) ^ 2 + I)
      (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      ((hu2c.add continuous_const).intervalIntegrable _ _) key
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, intervalIntegral.integral_add
      (hu2c.intervalIntegrable _ _) (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const, hIu] at hmono
    simp only [show x - (x - 1) = (1:ℝ) by ring, one_smul] at hmono
    have hA := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) zero_le_one
      (f := fun y => (vm y - vp y) ^ 2 + (κ * (vm y - vp y) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm y + vp y) ^ 2))
      (g := fun y => 12 * κ * (vm y ^ 2 + vp y ^ 2))
      ((hu2c.add hhc).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      ((continuous_const.mul ((hvmc.pow 2).add (hvpc.pow 2))).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (fun y _ => by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3 * κ - 1) (sq_nonneg (vm y - vp y)),
          mul_nonneg hκ0.le (sq_nonneg (vm y)), mul_nonneg hκ0.le (sq_nonneg (vp y))])
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hu2c.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hhc.intervalIntegrable _ _),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_add
      ((hvmc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _) ((hvpc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _)] at hA
    have hB : 12 * κ * ((∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vm x ^ 2) + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vp x ^ 2) ≤
        12 * κ * (κ / 1024 + κ / 1024) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
    have hsq : (vm x - vp x) ^ 2 ≤ (κ / 4) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    exact abs_le_of_sq_le_sq hsq (by positivity)
  refine ⟨wp, wm, hwpP, hwmP, hwpD, hwmD, hwp2, hwm2, fun x => ?_⟩
  have e1 := abs_le.1 (hsob x)
  have e2 := abs_le.1 (hdm x)
  have e3 := abs_le.1 (hdp x)
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Function.Periodic f 1 → (∃ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 ∧ ∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) ∧ ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) → (∀ x, v x = -(1 - Real.exp (-(2 * κ)))⁻¹ * ∫ y in x..(x + 1), Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (y - x)) * f y) ∧ (∀ x, |v x| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |f y|) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |f x|) ^ 2 / κ

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_parseval_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q : CinfT) (v : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) = ∑' n : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / ((2 * π * n) ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n‖ ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_riccati_exists_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q v : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous q → Function.Periodic q 1 → Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + q x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → ∃ w : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic w 1 ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) ∧ 3 / 4 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ≤ 81 / 64 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (q : CinfT) (wp wm : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic wp 1 → Function.Periodic wm 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, 0 < 2 * κ + wm x - wp x) → IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧ ∀ x, greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x)

signature.name: greenT_eq_of_riccati_pair_T
signature.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (q : CinfT) (wp wm : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic wp 1 → Function.Periodic wm 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, 0 < 2 * κ + wm x - wp x) → IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧ ∀ x, greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ q wp wm hwpP hwmP hwpD hwmD hpos
  
  have boot : ∀ (β : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt w ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + β * w x - w x ^ 2) x) → ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n w := by
    intro β w hw n
    have hdw : deriv w = fun x => (q : ℝ → ℝ) x + β * w x - w x ^ 2 :=
      funext fun x => (hw x).deriv
    have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ w := fun x => (hw x).differentiableAt
    induction n with
    | zero => exact contDiff_zero.2 hdiff.continuous
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
      refine ⟨hdiff, fun h => absurd h (by simp), ?_⟩
      rw [hdw]
      have hq : ContDiff ℝ n (q : ℝ → ℝ) := contDiff_infty.1 q.2.1 n
      exact (hq.add (contDiff_const.mul ih)).sub (ih.pow 2)
  have hwpS : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n wp := boot (2 * κ) wp hwpD
  have hwmS : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n wm :=
    boot (-(2 * κ)) wm fun x => (hwmD x).congr_deriv (by ring)
  have cwp : Continuous wp := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hwpD x).continuousAt
  have cwm : Continuous wm := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hwmD x).continuousAt
  
  have hcand : IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (fun x => 1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x)) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact contDiff_infty.2 fun n =>
        contDiff_const.div ((contDiff_const.add (hwmS n)).sub (hwpS n)) (fun x => (hpos x).ne')
    · intro x
      show 1 / (2 * κ + wm (x + 1) - wp (x + 1)) = 1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x)
      rw [hwpP x, hwmP x]
    · intro x
      exact one_div_pos.2 (hpos x)
    · intro x
      have hD : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * κ + wm y - wp y)
          (((q : ℝ → ℝ) y - 2 * κ * wm y - wm y ^ 2) -
            ((q : ℝ → ℝ) y + 2 * κ * wp y - wp y ^ 2)) y := by
        intro y
        have := ((hasDerivAt_const y (2 * κ)).add (hwmD y)).sub (hwpD y)
        simpa using this
      have hg : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ + wm y - wp y))
          ((wm y + wp y) * (1 / (2 * κ + wm y - wp y))) y := by
        intro y
        have hne := (hpos y).ne'
        have := (hasDerivAt_const y (1 : ℝ)).div (hD y) hne
        refine this.congr_deriv ?_
        field_simp
        ring
      have hdg : deriv (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ + wm y - wp y)) =
          fun y => (wm y + wp y) * (1 / (2 * κ + wm y - wp y)) :=
        funext fun y => (hg y).deriv
      have hs : HasDerivAt (fun y => wm y + wp y)
          (((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) +
            ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2)) x := (hwmD x).add (hwpD x)
      have h2 : iteratedDeriv 2 (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ + wm y - wp y)) x =
          (((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) +
            ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2)) * (1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x)) +
          (wm x + wp x) * ((wm x + wp x) * (1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x))) := by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, hdg]
        exact (hs.mul (hg x)).deriv
      rw [h2, hdg]
      have hne := (hpos x).ne'
      field_simp
      ring
  
  have expRep : ∀ (c F : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous c → (∀ x, HasDerivAt F (c x * F x) x) →
      ∀ x, F x = F 0 * Real.exp (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, c t) := by
    intro c F hc hF x
    have hC : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun z => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..z, c t) (c y) y :=
      fun y => (hc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 y).hasDerivAt
    have hG : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun z => F z * Real.exp (-(∫ t in (0:ℝ)..z, c t))) 0 y := by
      intro y
      have := (hF y).mul ((hC y).neg.exp)
      refine this.congr_deriv ?_
      ring
    have hconst := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun y => (hG y).differentiableAt)
      (fun y => (hG y).deriv) x 0
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_same, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one] at hconst
    rw [← hconst, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  
  have dich : ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic w 1 →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt w ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) →
      w = wp ∨ w = fun x => wm x + 2 * κ := by
    intro w hwP hwD
    have cw : Continuous w := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hwD x).continuousAt
    have hc1 : Continuous fun t => 2 * κ - w t - wp t := (continuous_const.sub cw).sub cwp
    have hc2 : Continuous fun t => -(w t + wm t) := (cw.add cwm).neg
    have rep1 : ∀ x, w x - wp x =
        (w 0 - wp 0) * Real.exp (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, (2 * κ - w t - wp t)) :=
      expRep (fun t => 2 * κ - w t - wp t) (fun x => w x - wp x) hc1
        (fun x => ((hwD x).sub (hwpD x)).congr_deriv (by ring))
    have rep2 : ∀ x, w x - (wm x + 2 * κ) =
        (w 0 - (wm 0 + 2 * κ)) * Real.exp (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, -(w t + wm t)) :=
      expRep (fun t => -(w t + wm t)) (fun x => w x - (wm x + 2 * κ)) hc2
        (fun x => ((hwD x).sub ((hwmD x).add_const (2 * κ))).congr_deriv (by ring))
    by_cases h1 : w 0 - wp 0 = 0
    · left
      funext x
      have := rep1 x
      rw [h1, zero_mul] at this
      linarith
    by_cases h2 : w 0 - (wm 0 + 2 * κ) = 0
    · right
      funext x
      have := rep2 x
      rw [h2, zero_mul] at this
      linarith
    exfalso
    have pw : w 1 = w 0 := by simpa using hwP 0
    have pp : wp 1 = wp 0 := by simpa using hwpP 0
    have pm : wm 1 = wm 0 := by simpa using hwmP 0
    have e1 := rep1 1
    have e2 := rep2 1
    rw [pw, pp] at e1
    rw [pw, pm] at e2
    have I1 : (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * κ - w t - wp t)) = 0 := by
      have : Real.exp (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * κ - w t - wp t)) = 1 := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ h1
        linarith
      exact Real.exp_eq_one_iff _ |>.1 this
    have I2 : (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, -(w t + wm t)) = 0 := by
      have : Real.exp (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, -(w t + wm t)) = 1 := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ h2
        linarith
      exact Real.exp_eq_one_iff _ |>.1 this
    have hsub := intervalIntegral.integral_sub
      (hc1.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 1)
      (hc2.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 1)
    rw [I1, I2, sub_zero] at hsub
    have hcongr : (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ((2 * κ - w t - wp t) - -(w t + wm t))) =
        ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * κ + wm t - wp t) := by
      congr 1
      funext t
      ring
    rw [hcongr] at hsub
    have hposI : 0 < ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * κ + wm t - wp t) :=
      intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_pos_of_pos
        (((continuous_const.add cwm).sub cwp).intervalIntegrable 0 1) hpos zero_lt_one
    linarith
  
  have uniq : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) g → ∀ x, g x = 1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x) := by
    intro g ⟨hsm, hper, hgpos, hid⟩
    have hgd : Differentiable ℝ g := hsm.differentiable (by simp)
    have hg'd : Differentiable ℝ (deriv g) :=
      (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.1 hsm).2.differentiable (by simp)
    have hdper : ∀ x, deriv g (x + 1) = deriv g x := by
      intro x
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => g (y + 1)) (deriv g (x + 1)) x :=
        HasDerivAt.comp_add_const x 1 (hgd (x + 1)).hasDerivAt
      have h2 : (fun y => g (y + 1)) = g := funext hper
      rw [h2] at h1
      exact h1.deriv.symm
    have hg2 : ∀ x, deriv (deriv g) x =
        (deriv g x ^ 2 + 4 * (κ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) * g x ^ 2 - 1) / (2 * g x) := by
      intro x
      have hne := (hgpos x).ne'
      have h := hid x
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one] at h
      field_simp
      linarith
    
    have lift : ∀ σ : ℝ, σ ^ 2 = 1 →
        Function.Periodic (fun x => κ + (deriv g x + σ) / (2 * g x)) 1 ∧
        ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => κ + (deriv g y + σ) / (2 * g y))
          ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * (κ + (deriv g x + σ) / (2 * g x)) -
            (κ + (deriv g x + σ) / (2 * g x)) ^ 2) x := by
      intro σ hσ
      refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
      · show κ + (deriv g (x + 1) + σ) / (2 * g (x + 1)) = κ + (deriv g x + σ) / (2 * g x)
        rw [hdper x, hper x]
      · have hne := (hgpos x).ne'
        have hN : HasDerivAt (fun y => deriv g y + σ) (deriv (deriv g) x) x :=
          (hg'd x).hasDerivAt.add_const σ
        have hM : HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * g y) (2 * deriv g x) x :=
          (hgd x).hasDerivAt.const_mul 2
        have := (hN.div hM (by positivity)).const_add κ
        refine this.congr_deriv ?_
        rw [hg2 x]
        field_simp
        linear_combination hσ
    obtain ⟨haP, haD⟩ := lift (-1) (by norm_num)
    obtain ⟨hcP, hcD⟩ := lift 1 (by norm_num)
    have hca : ∀ x, (κ + (deriv g x + 1) / (2 * g x)) - (κ + (deriv g x + -1) / (2 * g x)) =
        1 / g x := by
      intro x
      have hne := (hgpos x).ne'
      field_simp
      ring
    have hinv : ∀ x, 0 < 1 / g x := fun x => one_div_pos.2 (hgpos x)
    rcases dich _ haP haD with ha | ha <;> rcases dich _ hcP hcD with hc | hc
    · exfalso
      have e := hca 0
      have ea := congrFun ha 0
      have ec := congrFun hc 0
      simp only at ea ec
      rw [ea, ec, sub_self] at e
      linarith [hinv 0]
    · intro x
      have e := hca x
      have ea := congrFun ha x
      have ec := congrFun hc x
      simp only at ea ec
      rw [ea, ec] at e
      have hne := (hgpos x).ne'
      have hDx := (hpos x).ne'
      rw [eq_div_iff hDx]
      field_simp at e
      linarith
    · exfalso
      have e := hca 0
      have ea := congrFun ha 0
      have ec := congrFun hc 0
      simp only at ea ec
      rw [ea, ec] at e
      linarith [hinv 0, hpos 0]
    · exfalso
      have e := hca 0
      have ea := congrFun ha 0
      have ec := congrFun hc 0
      simp only at ea ec
      rw [ea, ec, sub_self] at e
      linarith [hinv 0]
  
  have hex : ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) g := ⟨_, hcand⟩
  have hGeq : greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) = Classical.choose hex := by
    unfold greenT
    exact dif_pos hex
  have hG : IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) := by
    rw [hGeq]
    exact Classical.choose_spec hex
  exact ⟨hG, uniq _ hG⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ q p : CinfT, ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic w₁ 1 → Function.Periodic w₂ 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt w₁ ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * w₁ x - w₁ x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt w₂ ((p : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * w₂ x - w₂ x ^ 2) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₂ x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) ≤ 2 * ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2

signature.name: riccati_L2_lipschitz_plus_T
signature.statement: ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ q p : CinfT, ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic w₁ 1 → Function.Periodic w₂ 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt w₁ ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * w₁ x - w₁ x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt w₂ ((p : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * w₂ x - w₂ x ^ 2) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₂ x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) ≤ 2 * ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ q p w₁ w₂ hw₁P hw₂P hw₁ hw₂ h₁ h₂
  have hκ0 : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have cw₁ : Continuous w₁ := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hw₁ x).continuousAt
  have cw₂ : Continuous w₂ := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hw₂ x).continuousAt
  
  obtain ⟨r, hrx⟩ : ∃ r : CinfT, ∀ x, (r : ℝ → ℝ) x = (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - (p : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
    ⟨⟨fun x => (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - (p : ℝ → ℝ) x, q.2.1.sub p.2.1,
      fun x => by simp only [q.2.2 x, p.2.2 x]⟩, fun x => rfl⟩
  have hr : ιT r = ιT q - ιT p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show toHm1T r = toHm1T q - toHm1T p
    rw [toHm1T_basic.1 q p r 1 (-1) (fun x => by rw [hrx x]; ring), one_smul, neg_one_smul,
      ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  
  obtain ⟨⟨v, hvP, hvD⟩, -⟩ := periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ (r : ℝ → ℝ) r.2.1.continuous r.2.2
  have cv : Continuous v := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hvD x).continuousAt
  
  have hV : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [periodic_resolvent_parseval_T κ hκ r v hvP hvD, ← hr]
    exact (weight_compare_T ((ιT r : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) κ hκ).2.1
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2 :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2 :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
  
  have hS : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x + w₂ x) ^ 2) ≤ κ / 16 := by
    have i1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * w₁ x ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (continuous_const.mul (cw₁.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    have i2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 2 * w₂ x ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (continuous_const.mul (cw₂.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    have hmono : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x + w₂ x) ^ 2) ≤
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * w₁ x ^ 2 + 2 * w₂ x ^ 2) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one
        (((cw₁.add cw₂).pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1) (i1.add i2)
        (fun x _ => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (w₁ x - w₂ x)])
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add i1 i2, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hmono
    linarith
  
  have he : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => w₁ y - w₂ y - v y)
      (2 * κ * (w₁ x - w₂ x - v x) + (fun y => -((w₁ y + w₂ y) * (w₁ y - w₂ y))) x) x := by
    intro x
    refine (((hw₁ x).sub (hw₂ x)).sub (hvD x)).congr_deriv ?_
    rw [hrx x]
    ring
  have cf : Continuous (fun y => -((w₁ y + w₂ y) * (w₁ y - w₂ y))) :=
    ((cw₁.add cw₂).mul (cw₁.sub cw₂)).neg
  have hfP : Function.Periodic (fun y => -((w₁ y + w₂ y) * (w₁ y - w₂ y))) 1 :=
    fun x => by simp only [hw₁P x, hw₂P x]
  have heP : Function.Periodic (fun y => w₁ y - w₂ y - v y) 1 :=
    fun x => by simp only [hw₁P x, hw₂P x, hvP x]
  have hE2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x - v x) ^ 2) ≤
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |(w₁ x + w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x)|) ^ 2 / κ := by
    have := ((periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ _ cf hfP).2 _ heP he).2.2.2
    simpa only [abs_neg] using this
  
  have hCS1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |(w₁ x + w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x)|) ^ 2 ≤
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x + w₂ x) ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) := by
    have := cauchy_schwarz_unit_interval (fun x => |w₁ x + w₂ x|) (fun x => |w₁ x - w₂ x|)
      (cw₁.add cw₂).abs (cw₁.sub cw₂).abs
    simpa only [abs_mul, sq_abs] using this
  have hE : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x - v x) ^ 2) ≤
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) / 16 := by
    have h1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |(w₁ x + w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x)|) ^ 2 ≤
        κ / 16 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) :=
      le_trans hCS1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS hD0)
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hκ0] at hE2
    have h3 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x - v x) ^ 2) * κ ≤
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) / 16 * κ := by linarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h3 hκ0
  
  have hsplit : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) =
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) * v x) +
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x - v x) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add (((cw₁.sub cw₂).mul cv).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      (((cw₁.sub cw₂).mul ((cw₁.sub cw₂).sub cv)).intervalIntegrable 0 1)]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    show (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2 = (w₁ x - w₂ x) * v x + (w₁ x - w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x - v x)
    ring
  
  have hX : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) * v x) ^ 2 ≤
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) :=
    cauchy_schwarz_unit_interval (fun x => w₁ x - w₂ x) v (cw₁.sub cw₂) cv
  have hY : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x - v x)) ^ 2 ≤
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x - v x) ^ 2) :=
    cauchy_schwarz_unit_interval (fun x => w₁ x - w₂ x) (fun x => w₁ x - w₂ x - v x)
      (cw₁.sub cw₂) ((cw₁.sub cw₂).sub cv)
  
  have hDV : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) ≤ 16 / 9 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2 := by
    set D := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2 with hDdef
    set V := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2 with hVdef
    set X := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) * v x with hXdef
    set Y := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x - v x) with hYdef
    set E := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x - v x) ^ 2 with hEdef
    have hY2 : Y ^ 2 ≤ (D / 4) ^ 2 := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE hD0
      nlinarith
    have hYle : Y ≤ D / 4 := (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hY2 (by linarith)).2
    have hX3 : 3 * D / 4 ≤ X := by linarith
    have hX2 : (3 * D / 4) ^ 2 ≤ X ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hX3 2
    rcases hD0.eq_or_lt with h | h
    · rw [← h]; linarith
    · have h4 : D * (9 / 16 * D) ≤ D * V := by nlinarith
      have h5 := le_of_mul_le_mul_left h4 h
      linarith
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  linarith

subgoal_signatures.name: toHm1T_basic
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ (q₁ q₂ r : CinfT) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ),
      (∀ x, (r : ℝ → ℝ) x = c₁ * (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x + c₂ * (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) →
      toHm1T r = c₁ • toHm1T q₁ + c₂ • toHm1T q₂) ∧
    (∀ (q : CinfT) (M : ℝ), (∀ x, |(q : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ M) → ‖toHm1T q‖ ≤ M)

subgoal_signatures.name: cauchy_schwarz_unit_interval
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x * g x) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g x ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Function.Periodic f 1 → (∃ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 ∧ ∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) ∧ ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) → (∀ x, v x = -(1 - Real.exp (-(2 * κ)))⁻¹ * ∫ y in x..(x + 1), Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (y - x)) * f y) ∧ (∀ x, |v x| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |f y|) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |f x|) ^ 2 / κ

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_parseval_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q : CinfT) (v : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) = ∑' n : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / ((2 * π * n) ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n‖ ^ 2

signature.name: riccati_L2_lipschitz_minus_T
signature.statement: ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ q p : CinfT, ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic w₁ 1 → Function.Periodic w₂ 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt w₁ ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * w₁ x - w₁ x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt w₂ ((p : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * w₂ x - w₂ x ^ 2) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w₂ x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) ≤ 2 * ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ q p w₁ w₂ hw₁P hw₂P hw₁D hw₂D hI₁ hI₂
  have hκ0 : (0:ℝ) < κ := by linarith
  have hκne : κ ≠ 0 := hκ0.ne'
  obtain ⟨hlin, -⟩ := toHm1T_basic
  
  have hcont : ∀ (f F : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ x, HasDerivAt f (F x) x) → Continuous f :=
    fun f F h => continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (h x).continuousAt
  have hreflD : ∀ (f F : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ y, HasDerivAt f (F y) y) → ∀ x,
      HasDerivAt (fun y => -f (-y)) (F (-x)) x := by
    intro f F hf x
    have h1 := ((hf (-x)).comp x (hasDerivAt_neg x)).neg
    refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
    ring
  have hreflP : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic f 1 →
      Function.Periodic (fun y => -f (-y)) 1 := by
    intro f hf x
    have h1 := hf (-(x + 1))
    rw [show -(x + 1) + 1 = -x by ring] at h1
    show -f (-(x + 1)) = -f (-x)
    rw [h1]
  have hR : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic g 1 →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g (-x)) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g x := by
    intro g hg
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg]
    have h1 := hg.intervalIntegral_add_eq (-1) 0
    norm_num at h1
    simpa using h1
  have hRsq : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic f 1 →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (-f (-x)) ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2 := by
    intro f hf
    have h2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f (-x) ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2 :=
      hR (fun y => f y ^ 2) (fun x => by show f (x + 1) ^ 2 = f x ^ 2; rw [hf x])
    simp only [neg_sq]
    exact h2
  
  let rC : CinfT := ⟨fun x => (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - (p : ℝ → ℝ) x, q.2.1.sub p.2.1,
    fun x => by simp only [q.2.2 x, p.2.2 x]⟩
  have hRx : ∀ x, (rC : ℝ → ℝ) x = (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - (p : ℝ → ℝ) x := fun x => rfl
  have hRc : Continuous (rC : ℝ → ℝ) := rC.2.1.continuous
  have hRp : Function.Periodic (rC : ℝ → ℝ) 1 := rC.2.2
  have hdist : ιT rC = ιT q - ιT p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show toHm1T rC = toHm1T q - toHm1T p
    rw [hlin q p rC 1 (-1) (fun x => by
      show (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - (p : ℝ → ℝ) x = 1 * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x + -1 * (p : ℝ → ℝ) x
      ring), one_smul, neg_one_smul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  
  obtain ⟨vp, hvpP, hvpD⟩ := (periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ (rC : ℝ → ℝ) hRc hRp).1
  have hvp2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vp x ^ 2) ≤ ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [periodic_resolvent_parseval_T κ hκ rC vp hvpP hvpD, ← hdist]
    have h := (weight_compare_T ((ιT rC : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) κ hκ).2.1
    rw [Submodule.coe_norm]
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨Rr, hRr⟩ : ∃ Rr : ℝ → ℝ, Rr = fun x => (rC : ℝ → ℝ) (-x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hRrx : ∀ x, Rr x = (rC : ℝ → ℝ) (-x) := fun x => by rw [hRr]
  have hRrc : Continuous Rr := by rw [hRr]; exact hRc.comp continuous_neg
  have hRrp : Function.Periodic Rr 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [hRrx, hRrx]
    have h1 := hRp (-(x + 1))
    rw [show -(x + 1) + 1 = -x by ring] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  obtain ⟨vr, hvrP, hvrD⟩ := (periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ Rr hRrc hRrp).1
  obtain ⟨vm, hvm⟩ : ∃ vm : ℝ → ℝ, vm = fun y => -vr (-y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hvmP : Function.Periodic vm 1 := by rw [hvm]; exact hreflP vr hvrP
  have hvmD : ∀ x, HasDerivAt vm ((rC : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * vm x) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hvm]
    refine (hreflD vr _ hvrD x).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [hRrx, neg_neg]
    ring
  have hvpc := hcont vp _ hvpD
  have hvmc := hcont vm _ hvmD
  
  have hiso : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vm x ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vp x ^ 2 := by
    have hF : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt
        (fun y => -(1 / (4 * κ)) * ((vm y - vp y) * (vm y - vp y))) (vm x ^ 2 - vp x ^ 2) x := by
      intro x _
      have h1 := (((hvmD x).sub (hvpD x)).mul ((hvmD x).sub (hvpD x))).const_mul (-(1 / (4 * κ)))
      refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => vm x ^ 2 - vp x ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      ((hvmc.pow 2).sub (hvpc.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    have h2 := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hF hint
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((hvmc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      ((hvpc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1)] at h2
    have h3 : vm 1 = vm 0 := by simpa using hvmP 0
    have h4 : vp 1 = vp 0 := by simpa using hvpP 0
    rw [h3, h4, sub_self] at h2
    linarith
  have hV : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vm x ^ 2) ≤ ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2 := by rw [hiso]; exact hvp2
  
  have hw₁c := hcont w₁ _ hw₁D
  have hw₂c := hcont w₂ _ hw₂D
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : ℝ → ℝ, y = fun x => w₁ x - w₂ x - vm x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hyx : ∀ x, y x = w₁ x - w₂ x - vm x := fun x => by rw [hy]
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, g = fun x => -((w₁ x + w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgx : ∀ x, g x = -((w₁ x + w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x)) := fun x => by rw [hg]
  have hyc : Continuous y := by rw [hy]; exact (hw₁c.sub hw₂c).sub hvmc
  have hyP : Function.Periodic y 1 := fun x => by rw [hyx, hyx, hw₁P x, hw₂P x, hvmP x]
  have hyD : ∀ x, HasDerivAt y (g x - 2 * κ * y x) x := by
    intro x
    have h := ((hw₁D x).sub (hw₂D x)).sub (hvmD x)
    rw [hy]
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [hgx, hRx]
    ring
  have hgc : Continuous g := by rw [hg]; exact ((hw₁c.add hw₂c).mul (hw₁c.sub hw₂c)).neg
  have hgP : Function.Periodic g 1 := fun x => by rw [hgx, hgx, hw₁P x, hw₂P x]
  have hgrc : Continuous (fun x => g (-x)) := hgc.comp continuous_neg
  have hgrP : Function.Periodic (fun x => g (-x)) 1 := by
    intro x
    show g (-(x + 1)) = g (-x)
    have h1 := hgP (-(x + 1))
    rw [show -(x + 1) + 1 = -x by ring] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have hyrD : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun z => -y (-z)) (2 * κ * -y (-x) + g (-x)) x := by
    intro x
    refine (hreflD y _ hyD x).congr_deriv ?_
    show g (-x) - 2 * κ * y (-x) = _
    ring
  have hYr := ((periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ (fun x => g (-x)) hgrc hgrP).2
    (fun z => -y (-z)) (hreflP y hyP) hyrD).2.2.2
  have e2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |g (-x)|) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |g x| :=
    hR (fun z => |g z|) (fun x => by show |g (x + 1)| = |g x|; rw [hgP x])
  have hG : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |g x|) =
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |(w₁ x + w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x)| := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    simp only [hgx, abs_neg]
  have hY : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, y x ^ 2) ≤
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |(w₁ x + w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x)|) ^ 2 / κ := by
    calc (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, y x ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (-y (-x)) ^ 2 := (hRsq y hyP).symm
      _ ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |g (-x)|) ^ 2 / κ := hYr
      _ = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |(w₁ x + w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x)|) ^ 2 / κ := by rw [e2, hG]
  
  have hA : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x + w₂ x) ^ 2) ≤ κ / 16 := by
    have hm := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) zero_le_one
      (f := fun x => (w₁ x + w₂ x) ^ 2) (g := fun x => 2 * w₁ x ^ 2 + 2 * w₂ x ^ 2)
      (((hw₁c.add hw₂c).pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      (((continuous_const.mul (hw₁c.pow 2)).add (continuous_const.mul (hw₂c.pow 2))).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      (fun x _ => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (w₁ x - w₂ x)])
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((continuous_const.mul (hw₁c.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      ((continuous_const.mul (hw₂c.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable 0 1),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hm
    linarith
  
  have hCS : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |(w₁ x + w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x)|) ^ 2 ≤
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x + w₂ x) ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) := by
    have h := cauchy_schwarz_unit_interval (fun x => |w₁ x + w₂ x|) (fun x => |w₁ x - w₂ x|)
      (hw₁c.add hw₂c).abs (hw₁c.sub hw₂c).abs
    have e3 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |(w₁ x + w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x)|) =
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w₁ x + w₂ x| * |w₁ x - w₂ x| := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      simp only [abs_mul]
    have e4 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w₁ x + w₂ x| ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x + w₂ x) ^ 2 := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      simp only [sq_abs]
    have e5 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w₁ x - w₂ x| ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2 := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      simp only [sq_abs]
    calc (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |(w₁ x + w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x)|) ^ 2
        = (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w₁ x + w₂ x| * |w₁ x - w₂ x|) ^ 2 := by rw [e3]
      _ ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w₁ x + w₂ x| ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |w₁ x - w₂ x| ^ 2) := h
      _ = _ := by rw [e4, e5]
  
  have hD := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) zero_le_one
    (f := fun x => (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) (g := fun x => 4 * y x ^ 2 + 4 / 3 * vm x ^ 2)
    (((hw₁c.sub hw₂c).pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    (((continuous_const.mul (hyc.pow 2)).add (continuous_const.mul (hvmc.pow 2))).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    (fun x _ => by
      simp only [hyx]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (3 * (w₁ x - w₂ x - vm x) - vm x)])
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((continuous_const.mul (hyc.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    ((continuous_const.mul (hvmc.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable 0 1),
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hD
  
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2 :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
  set B := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2 with hBdef
  set A := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (w₁ x + w₂ x) ^ 2 with hAdef
  set Gv := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |(w₁ x + w₂ x) * (w₁ x - w₂ x)| with hGvdef
  set Y := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, y x ^ 2 with hYdef
  set V := ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vm x ^ 2 with hVdef
  have hYk : Y * κ ≤ Gv ^ 2 := (le_div_iff₀ hκ0).1 hY
  have hAB : A * B ≤ κ / 16 * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA hB0
  have hκY : κ * Y ≤ κ * (B / 16) := by nlinarith
  have hYB : Y ≤ B / 16 := le_of_mul_le_mul_left hκY hκ0
  have hN : 0 ≤ ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  nlinarith

subgoal_signatures.name: toHm1T_basic
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ (q₁ q₂ r : CinfT) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ),
      (∀ x, (r : ℝ → ℝ) x = c₁ * (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x + c₂ * (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) →
      toHm1T r = c₁ • toHm1T q₁ + c₂ • toHm1T q₂) ∧
    (∀ (q : CinfT) (M : ℝ), (∀ x, |(q : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ M) → ‖toHm1T q‖ ≤ M)

subgoal_signatures.name: cauchy_schwarz_unit_interval
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x * g x) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g x ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Function.Periodic f 1 → (∃ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 ∧ ∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) ∧ ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) → (∀ x, v x = -(1 - Real.exp (-(2 * κ)))⁻¹ * ∫ y in x..(x + 1), Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (y - x)) * f y) ∧ (∀ x, |v x| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |f y|) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |f x|) ^ 2 / κ

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_parseval_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q : CinfT) (v : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) = ∑' n : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / ((2 * π * n) ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n‖ ^ 2

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → Function.Periodic w 1 → (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y) < κ → (∀ x, HasDerivAt (rgreenT κ w) (2 * (w x - κ) * rgreenT κ w x + 1) x) ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt (rgreenRT κ w) (2 * (κ - w x) * rgreenRT κ w x - 1) x) ∧ Function.Periodic (rgreenT κ w) 1 ∧ Function.Periodic (rgreenRT κ w) 1 ∧ (∀ x, 0 < rgreenT κ w x)

signature.name: rgreenT_ode_T
signature.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → Function.Periodic w 1 → (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y) < κ → (∀ x, HasDerivAt (rgreenT κ w) (2 * (w x - κ) * rgreenT κ w x + 1) x) ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt (rgreenRT κ w) (2 * (κ - w x) * rgreenRT κ w x - 1) x) ∧ Function.Periodic (rgreenT κ w) 1 ∧ Function.Periodic (rgreenRT κ w) 1 ∧ (∀ x, 0 < rgreenT κ w x)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ w hw hper hm
  have hFTC : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous f → ∀ a b : ℝ,
      (∫ y in a..b, f y) = (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..b, f y) - ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..a, f y := by
    intro f hf a b
    exact (intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hf.intervalIntegrable 0 b)
      (hf.intervalIntegrable 0 a)).symm
  have hDer : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous f → ∀ u : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun v => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..v, f y) (f u) u :=
    fun f hf u => (hf.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 u).hasDerivAt
  obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, P = fun x => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..x, w y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hP : ∀ x, HasDerivAt P (w x) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hPdef]
    exact hDer w hw x
  have hPc : Continuous P := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hP x).continuousAt
  have hF3 : ∀ a b : ℝ, (∫ y in a..b, w y) = P b - P a := by
    intro a b
    rw [hPdef]
    exact hFTC w hw a b
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hinc : ∀ z, P (z + 1) = P z + M := by
    intro z
    have h := hper.intervalIntegral_add_eq z 0
    rw [zero_add, hF3 z (z + 1), ← hMdef] at h
    linarith
  have hMk : M < κ := by rw [hMdef]; exact hm
  obtain ⟨e, hedef⟩ : ∃ e : ℝ, e = Real.exp (2 * M - 2 * κ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have he1 : e < 1 := by rw [hedef]; exact Real.exp_lt_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = (1 - e)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD : D * (1 - e) = 1 := by rw [hDdef]; exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (by linarith)
  have hDpos : 0 < D := by rw [hDdef]; exact inv_pos.2 (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨E, hEdef⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ → ℝ, E = fun y => Real.exp (2 * κ * y - 2 * P y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ → ℝ, C = fun y => Real.exp (2 * P y - 2 * κ * y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hEc : Continuous E := by
    rw [hEdef]
    exact Real.continuous_exp.comp
      ((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).sub (continuous_const.mul hPc))
  have hCc : Continuous C := by
    rw [hCdef]
    exact Real.continuous_exp.comp
      ((continuous_const.mul hPc).sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))
  have hCE : ∀ x, C x * E x = 1 := by
    intro x
    simp only [hCdef, hEdef]
    rw [← Real.exp_add, show 2 * P x - 2 * κ * x + (2 * κ * x - 2 * P x) = 0 by ring,
      Real.exp_zero]
  have hCE1 : ∀ x, C x * E (x - 1) = e := by
    intro x
    simp only [hCdef, hEdef]
    rw [← Real.exp_add, hedef]
    congr 1
    have h := hinc (x - 1)
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
    linear_combination 2 * h
  have hEC1 : ∀ x, E x * C (x + 1) = e := by
    intro x
    simp only [hCdef, hEdef]
    rw [← Real.exp_add, hedef]
    congr 1
    have h := hinc x
    linear_combination 2 * h
  have hCder : ∀ x, HasDerivAt C (C x * (2 * w x - 2 * κ)) x := by
    intro x
    have h := (((hP x).const_mul 2).sub ((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul (2 * κ))).exp
    simp only [hCdef]
    exact h.congr_deriv (by simp only [Pi.sub_apply]; ring)
  have hEder : ∀ x, HasDerivAt E (E x * (2 * κ - 2 * w x)) x := by
    intro x
    have h := (((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul (2 * κ)).sub ((hP x).const_mul 2)).exp
    simp only [hEdef]
    exact h.congr_deriv (by simp only [Pi.sub_apply]; ring)
  have hGrep : ∀ x, rgreenT κ w x = D * (C x * ∫ y in (x - 1)..x, E y) := by
    intro x
    unfold rgreenT
    rw [← hMdef, ← hedef, ← hDdef]
    congr 1
    have h1 : ∀ s, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) = C x * E (x - s) := by
      intro s
      rw [hF3]
      simp only [hCdef, hEdef]
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    simp_rw [h1]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left E x,
      sub_zero]
  have hHrep : ∀ x, rgreenRT κ w x = D * (E x * ∫ y in x..(x + 1), C y) := by
    intro x
    unfold rgreenRT
    rw [← hMdef, ← hedef, ← hDdef]
    congr 1
    have h1 : ∀ s, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) = E x * C (x + s) := by
      intro s
      rw [hF3]
      simp only [hCdef, hEdef]
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    simp_rw [h1]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_left C x,
      add_zero]
  have hGfun : rgreenT κ w = fun x =>
      D * (C x * ((∫ y in (0:ℝ)..x, E y) - ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..(x - 1), E y)) := by
    funext x
    rw [hGrep, hFTC E hEc (x - 1) x]
  have hHfun : rgreenRT κ w = fun x =>
      D * (E x * ((∫ y in (0:ℝ)..(x + 1), C y) - ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..x, C y)) := by
    funext x
    rw [hHrep, hFTC C hCc x (x + 1)]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rw [hGfun]
    beta_reduce
    have hW := (hDer E hEc x).sub ((hDer E hEc (x - 1)).comp_sub_const x 1)
    refine (((hCder x).mul hW).const_mul D).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
    have h1 := hCE x
    have h2 := hCE1 x
    linear_combination D * h1 - D * h2 + hD
  · intro x
    rw [hHfun]
    beta_reduce
    have hW := ((hDer C hCc (x + 1)).comp_add_const x 1).sub (hDer C hCc x)
    refine (((hEder x).mul hW).const_mul D).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
    have h1 := hEC1 x
    have h2 := hCE x
    linear_combination D * h1 - D * h2 - hD
  · intro x
    unfold rgreenT
    congr 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s _
    simp only [hF3]
    rw [show x + 1 - s = (x - s) + 1 by ring, hinc, hinc]
    congr 1
    ring
  · intro x
    unfold rgreenRT
    congr 1
