    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s _
    simp only [hF3]
    rw [show x + 1 + s = (x + s) + 1 by ring, hinc, hinc]
    congr 1
    ring
  · intro x
    rw [hGrep]
    have hCpos : 0 < C x := by rw [hCdef]; exact Real.exp_pos _
    have hI : 0 < ∫ y in (x - 1)..x, E y :=
      intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_pos_of_pos_on (hEc.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (fun y _ => by rw [hEdef]; exact Real.exp_pos _) (by linarith)
    exact mul_pos hDpos (mul_pos hCpos hI)

informal_problem.statement: {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [CompleteSpace G] (n : ℕ) (F : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → G) (hF : ContDiff ℝ n F) : ContDiff ℝ n (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, F (p, s))

signature.name: parametric_integral_contDiff_T
signature.statement: {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [CompleteSpace G] (n : ℕ) (F : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → G) (hF : ContDiff ℝ n F) : ContDiff ℝ n (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, F (p, s))

proof.tactics:
by
  induction n generalizing G with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, contDiff_zero] at hF ⊢
    exact intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
      (f := fun p s => F (p, s)) hF 0 1
  | succ n ih =>
    have hF' : ContDiff ℝ ((n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1) F := by
      rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = (n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 by norm_cast] at hF
      exact hF
    have hDn : ContDiff ℝ n (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
        (fderiv ℝ F q).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) ℝ)) :=
      (hF'.fderiv_right (le_refl _)).clm_comp contDiff_const
    have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ F := hF'.differentiable (by simp)
    have hFD : ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (s : ℝ), HasFDerivAt (fun x : ℝ × ℝ => F (x, s))
        ((fderiv ℝ F (p, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) ℝ)) p := by
      intro p s
      exact (hdiff (p, s)).hasFDerivAt.comp p (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left p s)
    have hI := ih _ hDn
    have hFc : Continuous F := hF'.continuous
    have hDc := hDn.continuous
    rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = (n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 by norm_cast,
      contDiff_succ_iff_hasFDerivAt]
    refine ⟨_, hI, fun p₀ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ((isCompact_closedBall p₀ 1).prod isCompact_Icc :
        IsCompact (Metric.closedBall p₀ 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hDc.continuousOn
    have hmem : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIoc (0:ℝ) 1, t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      exact ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
    haveI : SecondCountableTopologyEither ℝ ((ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] G) :=
      secondCountableTopologyEither_of_left ℝ _
    have key := intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
      (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (a := 0) (b := 1) (x₀ := p₀)
      (F := fun p s => F (p, s))
      (F' := fun p s => (fderiv ℝ F (p, s)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) ℝ))
      (bound := fun _ => C)
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ one_pos)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p =>
        (hFc.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
      ((hFc.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      ((hDc.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun t ht x hx =>
        hC (x, t) ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx, hmem t ht⟩)
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun t _ x _ => hFD x t)
    exact key

informal_problem.statement: (n : ℕ) (f A B : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hA : ∀ t x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => f (s, x)) (A (t, x)) t) (hB : ∀ t x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => f (t, y)) (B (t, x)) x) (hAc : ContDiff ℝ n A) (hBc : ContDiff ℝ n B) : ContDiff ℝ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) f

signature.name: contDiff_of_partials_T
signature.statement: (n : ℕ) (f A B : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hA : ∀ t x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => f (s, x)) (A (t, x)) t) (hB : ∀ t x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => f (t, y)) (B (t, x)) x) (hAc : ContDiff ℝ n A) (hBc : ContDiff ℝ n B) : ContDiff ℝ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) f

proof.tactics:
by
  have hBcont : Continuous B := hBc.continuous
  
  have s1 : ∀ t x : ℝ, ∀ ε > (0:ℝ), ∃ δ > (0:ℝ), ∀ h k : ℝ, |h| < δ → |k| < δ →
      |f (t + h, x + k) - f (t + h, x) - B (t, x) * k| ≤ ε * |k| := by
    intro t x ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hcont⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.1 (hBcont.continuousAt (x := (t, x))) ε hε
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun h k hh hk => ?_⟩
    have hder : ∀ y ∈ Set.uIcc x (x + k), HasDerivWithinAt (fun y => f (t + h, y) - B (t, x) * y)
        (B (t + h, y) - B (t, x)) (Set.uIcc x (x + k)) y := by
      intro y _
      have h0 := (hB (t + h) y).sub ((hasDerivAt_id' y).const_mul (B (t, x)))
      rw [mul_one] at h0
      exact h0.hasDerivWithinAt
    have hbound : ∀ y ∈ Set.uIcc x (x + k), ‖B (t + h, y) - B (t, x)‖ ≤ ε := by
      intro y hy
      have h1 : |y - x| ≤ |x + k - x| := Set.abs_sub_left_of_mem_uIcc hy
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at h1
      have h2 : dist (t + h, y) (t, x) < δ := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, add_sub_cancel_left]
        exact max_lt hh (lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hk)
      have h3 := hcont h2
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at h3
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact h3.le
    have key := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le hder hbound
      (convex_uIcc x (x + k)) Set.left_mem_uIcc Set.right_mem_uIcc
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, add_sub_cancel_left] at key
    have e : f (t + h, x + k) - B (t, x) * (x + k) - (f (t + h, x) - B (t, x) * x) =
        f (t + h, x + k) - f (t + h, x) - B (t, x) * k := by ring
    rw [e] at key
    exact key
  
  have hd : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, HasFDerivAt f
      (A p • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ + B p • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) p := by
    rintro ⟨t, x⟩
    have ha := hA t x
    rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
    intro c hc
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff] at ha
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h1⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.1 (ha (half_pos hc))
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h2⟩ := s1 t x (c / 2) (half_pos hc)
    rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
    refine ⟨min δ₁ δ₂, lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨h, k⟩ hv
    rw [dist_zero_right, Prod.norm_def, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hv
    have hm1 : |h| ≤ max |h| |k| := le_max_left _ _
    have hm2 : |k| ≤ max |h| |k| := le_max_right _ _
    have hmd1 : max |h| |k| < δ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hv (min_le_left _ _)
    have hmd2 : max |h| |k| < δ₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hv (min_le_right _ _)
    have e1 := h1 (show dist h 0 < δ₁ by rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero]; linarith)
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, smul_eq_mul] at e1
    have e2 := h2 h k (by linarith) (by linarith)
    simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul, Prod.norm_def,
      Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have tri : |f (t + h, x + k) - f (t, x) - (A (t, x) * h + B (t, x) * k)| ≤
        |f (t + h, x + k) - f (t + h, x) - B (t, x) * k| + |f (t + h, x) - f (t, x) - h * A (t, x)| := by
      calc _ = |(f (t + h, x + k) - f (t + h, x) - B (t, x) * k) +
            (f (t + h, x) - f (t, x) - h * A (t, x))| := by congr 1; ring
        _ ≤ _ := abs_add_le _ _
    have m1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm1 (half_pos hc).le
    have m2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm2 (half_pos hc).le
    linarith
  
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ f := fun p => (hd p).differentiableAt
  have hfd : ∀ p y, fderiv ℝ f p y = A p * y.1 + B p * y.2 := by
    intro p y
    rw [(hd p).fderiv]
    simp
  rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = (n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 by norm_cast,
    contDiff_succ_iff_fderiv_apply]
  refine ⟨hdiff, by simp, fun y => ?_⟩
  have hfun : (fun p => fderiv ℝ f p y) = fun p => A p * y.1 + B p * y.2 :=
    funext fun p => hfd p y
  rw [hfun]
  exact (hAc.mul contDiff_const).add (hBc.mul contDiff_const)

informal_problem.statement: (n : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (hV : ContDiff ℝ n (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => V p.1 p.2)) (hM : ∀ t, (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, V t y) < κ) : ContDiff ℝ n (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rgreenT κ (V p.1) p.2) ∧ ContDiff ℝ n (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rgreenRT κ (V p.1) p.2)

signature.name: rgreenT_joint_contDiff
signature.statement: (n : ℕ) (κ : ℝ) (V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (hV : ContDiff ℝ n (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => V p.1 p.2)) (hM : ∀ t, (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, V t y) < κ) : ContDiff ℝ n (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rgreenT κ (V p.1) p.2) ∧ ContDiff ℝ n (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rgreenRT κ (V p.1) p.2)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hVt : ∀ t, Continuous (V t) := fun t =>
    hV.continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, P = fun p => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..p.2, V p.1 y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPeq : P = fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.2 * ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, V p.1 (p.2 * u) := by
    rw [hPdef]
    funext p
    have h := intervalIntegral.mul_integral_comp_mul_left (a := 0) (b := 1) (f := V p.1) p.2
    simp only [mul_zero, mul_one] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hP : ContDiff ℝ n P := by
    rw [hPeq]
    have hF0 : ContDiff ℝ n (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => V q.1.1 (q.1.2 * q.2)) :=
      hV.comp (contDiff_fst.fst.prodMk (contDiff_fst.snd.mul contDiff_snd))
    exact contDiff_snd.mul (parametric_integral_contDiff_T n _ hF0)
  
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
      D = fun p => 1 - Real.exp (2 * P (p.1, 1) - 2 * κ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD : ContDiff ℝ n D := by
    rw [hDdef]
    exact contDiff_const.sub (((contDiff_const.mul
      (hP.comp (contDiff_fst.prodMk contDiff_const))).sub contDiff_const).exp)
  have hDne : ∀ p, D p ≠ 0 := by
    intro p
    have h1 : P (p.1, 1) = ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, V p.1 y := by rw [hPdef]
    have h2 := hM p.1
    have h3 : Real.exp (2 * P (p.1, 1) - 2 * κ) < 1 :=
      Real.exp_lt_one_iff.2 (by rw [h1]; linarith)
    rw [hDdef]
    exact (sub_pos.2 h3).ne'
  
  have ha : ContDiff ℝ n (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => P (q.1.1, q.1.2)) :=
    hP.comp (contDiff_fst.fst.prodMk contDiff_fst.snd)
  have hb : ContDiff ℝ n (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => P (q.1.1, q.1.2 - q.2)) :=
    hP.comp (contDiff_fst.fst.prodMk (contDiff_fst.snd.sub contDiff_snd))
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ n (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => P (q.1.1, q.1.2 + q.2)) :=
    hP.comp (contDiff_fst.fst.prodMk (contDiff_fst.snd.add contDiff_snd))
  have hF1 : ContDiff ℝ n (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
      Real.exp (-2 * κ * q.2 + 2 * (P (q.1.1, q.1.2) - P (q.1.1, q.1.2 - q.2)))) :=
    ((contDiff_const.mul contDiff_snd).add (contDiff_const.mul (ha.sub hb))).exp
  have hF2 : ContDiff ℝ n (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
      Real.exp (-2 * κ * q.2 + 2 * (P (q.1.1, q.1.2 + q.2) - P (q.1.1, q.1.2)))) :=
    ((contDiff_const.mul contDiff_snd).add (contDiff_const.mul (hc.sub ha))).exp
  have hI1 := parametric_integral_contDiff_T n _ hF1
  have hI2 := parametric_integral_contDiff_T n _ hF2
  
  have hG : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, rgreenT κ (V p.1) p.2 = (D p)⁻¹ *
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * (P (p.1, p.2) - P (p.1, p.2 - s))) := by
    intro p
    subst hPdef hDdef
    show (1 - Real.exp (2 * (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, V p.1 y) - 2 * κ))⁻¹ *
        ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (p.2 - s)..p.2, V p.1 y) =
      (1 - Real.exp (2 * (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, V p.1 y) - 2 * κ))⁻¹ *
        ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s +
          2 * ((∫ y in (0:ℝ)..p.2, V p.1 y) - ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..(p.2 - s), V p.1 y))
    congr 1
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
    show Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (p.2 - s)..p.2, V p.1 y) =
      Real.exp (-2 * κ * s +
          2 * ((∫ y in (0:ℝ)..p.2, V p.1 y) - ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..(p.2 - s), V p.1 y))
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left ((hVt p.1).intervalIntegrable 0 p.2)
      ((hVt p.1).intervalIntegrable 0 (p.2 - s))]
  have hH : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, rgreenRT κ (V p.1) p.2 = (D p)⁻¹ *
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * (P (p.1, p.2 + s) - P (p.1, p.2))) := by
    intro p
    subst hPdef hDdef
    show (1 - Real.exp (2 * (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, V p.1 y) - 2 * κ))⁻¹ *
        ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in p.2..(p.2 + s), V p.1 y) =
      (1 - Real.exp (2 * (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, V p.1 y) - 2 * κ))⁻¹ *
        ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s +
          2 * ((∫ y in (0:ℝ)..(p.2 + s), V p.1 y) - ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..p.2, V p.1 y))
    congr 1
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
    show Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in p.2..(p.2 + s), V p.1 y) =
      Real.exp (-2 * κ * s +
          2 * ((∫ y in (0:ℝ)..(p.2 + s), V p.1 y) - ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..p.2, V p.1 y))
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left ((hVt p.1).intervalIntegrable 0 (p.2 + s))
      ((hVt p.1).intervalIntegrable 0 p.2)]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [funext hG]
    exact (hD.inv hDne).mul hI1
  · rw [funext hH]
    exact (hD.inv hDne).mul hI2

subgoal_signatures.name: parametric_integral_contDiff_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [CompleteSpace G] (n : ℕ) (F : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → G) (hF : ContDiff ℝ n F) : ContDiff ℝ n (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, F (p, s))

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (G : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → Function.Periodic w 1 → Continuous (G w) ∧ Function.Periodic (G w) 1) → (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → Function.Periodic w 1 → ∀ x, |G w x| ≤ M) → (∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w₁ → Function.Periodic w₁ 1 → Continuous w₂ → Function.Periodic w₂ 1 → ∀ D : ℝ, (∀ y, |w₁ y - w₂ y| ≤ D) → ∀ x, |G w₁ x - G w₂ x| ≤ L * D) → ∀ w₀ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w₀ → Function.Periodic w₀ 1 → ∃ V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, V 0 x = w₀ x) ∧ Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => V p.1 p.2) ∧ (∀ t, Function.Periodic (V t) 1) ∧ (∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => V s x) (G (V t) x) t) ∧ (∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, V s x ^ 2) (2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, V t x * G (V t) x) t)

signature.name: periodic_lipschitz_flow_T
signature.statement: ∀ (G : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → Function.Periodic w 1 → Continuous (G w) ∧ Function.Periodic (G w) 1) → (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → Function.Periodic w 1 → ∀ x, |G w x| ≤ M) → (∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w₁ → Function.Periodic w₁ 1 → Continuous w₂ → Function.Periodic w₂ 1 → ∀ D : ℝ, (∀ y, |w₁ y - w₂ y| ≤ D) → ∀ x, |G w₁ x - G w₂ x| ≤ L * D) → ∀ w₀ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w₀ → Function.Periodic w₀ 1 → ∃ V : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, V 0 x = w₀ x) ∧ Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => V p.1 p.2) ∧ (∀ t, Function.Periodic (V t) 1) ∧ (∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => V s x) (G (V t) x) t) ∧ (∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, V s x ^ 2) (2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, V t x * G (V t) x) t)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro G hG hM hL w₀ hw₀c hw₀p
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨L, hL0, hL⟩ := hL
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    hw₀c.continuousOn
  have hCw : ∀ x, ‖w₀ x‖ ≤ C := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hw₀p.exists_mem_Ico₀ one_pos x
    rw [hxy]
    exact hC y (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hy)
  let f₀ : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ :=
    BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup w₀ hw₀c C hCw
  
  let S : Submodule ℝ (BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) :=
    { carrier := {f | ∀ x, f (x + 1) = f x}
      add_mem' := by
        intro f g hf hg x
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]
        rw [hf x, hg x]
      zero_mem' := by
        intro x
        rfl
      smul_mem' := by
        intro c f hf x
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply]
        rw [hf x] }
  have hSclosed : IsClosed (S : Set (BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)) := by
    have hSeq : (S : Set (BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)) =
        ⋂ x : ℝ, {f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ | f (x + 1) = f x} := by
      ext f
      simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      rfl
    rw [hSeq]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun x =>
      isClosed_eq (continuous_eval_const (x + 1)) (continuous_eval_const x)
  haveI : IsClosed (S : Set (BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)) := hSclosed
  haveI : CompleteSpace S := inferInstance
  have hper : ∀ f : S, Function.Periodic (⇑(f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)) 1 :=
    fun f => f.2
  let F : S → S := fun f =>
    ⟨BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup (G ⇑(f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ))
      (hG _ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ).continuous (hper f)).1 M
      (fun x => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hM _ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ).continuous (hper f) x),
     (hG _ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ).continuous (hper f)).2⟩
  have hFapp : ∀ (f : S) (x : ℝ),
      ((F f : S) : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) x = G ⇑(f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) x :=
    fun f x => rfl
  have hFL : LipschitzWith ⟨L, hL0⟩ F := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro f g
    rw [Subtype.dist_eq, Subtype.dist_eq]
    show dist ((F f : S) : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) ((F g : S) : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)
      ≤ L * dist (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)
    rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.dist_le (mul_nonneg hL0 dist_nonneg)]
    intro x
    rw [Real.dist_eq, hFapp, hFapp]
    exact hL _ _ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ).continuous (hper f)
      (g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ).continuous (hper g) _
      (fun y => by
        rw [← Real.dist_eq]
        exact BoundedContinuousFunction.dist_coe_le_dist y) x
  have hf₀S : f₀ ∈ S := hw₀p
  
  open Set in
  have hglobal : ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
      (f : E → E) (K : NNReal), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ x₀ : E,
      ∃ γ : ℝ → E, γ 0 = x₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt γ (f (γ t)) t := by
    intro E _ _ _ f K hf x₀
    have hK0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ K := K.2
    obtain ⟨h, hpos, hKh⟩ : ∃ h : ℝ, 0 < h ∧ (K : ℝ) * h ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      refine ⟨1 / (2 * ((K : ℝ) + 1)), by positivity, ?_⟩
      rw [mul_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
      nlinarith
    have hfwd : ∀ g : E → E, LipschitzWith K g → ∀ y : E, ∃ α : ℝ → E, α 0 = y ∧
        ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt α (g (α t)) (Ici 0) t := by
      intro g hg
      have hloc : ∀ y : E, ∃ β : ℝ → E, β 0 = y ∧
          ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 h, HasDerivWithinAt β (g (β t)) (Icc 0 h) t := by
        intro y
        have ha0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * h * ‖g y‖ + 1 := by positivity
        have hL0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖g y‖ + K * (2 * h * ‖g y‖ + 1) := by positivity
        have hP : IsPicardLindelof (fun _ : ℝ => g)
            (⟨0, left_mem_Icc.2 hpos.le⟩ : Icc (0:ℝ) h) y ⟨2 * h * ‖g y‖ + 1, ha0⟩ 0
            ⟨‖g y‖ + K * (2 * h * ‖g y‖ + 1), hL0⟩ K := by
          apply IsPicardLindelof.of_time_independent
          · intro x hx
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hx
            have hx' : ‖x - y‖ ≤ 2 * h * ‖g y‖ + 1 := hx
            have h1 : ‖g x - g y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ := hg.norm_sub_le x y
            have h2 : ‖g x‖ ≤ ‖g y‖ + ‖g x - g y‖ := by
              have := norm_add_le (g y) (g x - g y)
              simpa using this
            have h3 : (K:ℝ) * ‖x - y‖ ≤ K * (2 * h * ‖g y‖ + 1) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx' hK0
            show ‖g x‖ ≤ ‖g y‖ + K * (2 * h * ‖g y‖ + 1)
            linarith
          · exact hg.lipschitzOnWith
          · show (‖g y‖ + K * (2 * h * ‖g y‖ + 1)) * max (h - 0) (0 - 0) ≤
              (2 * h * ‖g y‖ + 1) - ((0 : NNReal) : ℝ)
            rw [sub_zero, sub_self, max_eq_left hpos.le, NNReal.coe_zero, sub_zero]
            have hn : 0 ≤ ‖g y‖ := norm_nonneg _
            nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKh ha0]
        obtain ⟨β, hβ0, hβ⟩ := hP.exists_eq_forall_mem_Icc_hasDerivWithinAt₀
        exact ⟨β, hβ0, hβ⟩
      have hstep : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ y : E, ∃ α : ℝ → E, α 0 = y ∧
          ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (((n:ℝ) + 1) * h),
            HasDerivWithinAt α (g (α t)) (Icc 0 (((n:ℝ) + 1) * h)) t := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero =>
          intro y
          obtain ⟨β, hβ0, hβ⟩ := hloc y
          refine ⟨β, hβ0, ?_⟩
          simpa using hβ
        | succ n ih =>
          intro y
          obtain ⟨β, hβ0, hβ⟩ := hloc y
          obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα⟩ := ih (β h)
          have hT0 : 0 < ((n:ℝ) + 1) * h := by positivity
          have hcast : (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * h = h + ((n:ℝ) + 1) * h := by push_cast; ring
          rw [hcast]
          generalize ((n:ℝ) + 1) * h = T at hT0 hα
          refine ⟨fun t => if t ≤ h then β t else α (t - h), by simp [hpos.le, hβ0], ?_⟩
          have hA : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 h, HasDerivWithinAt (fun t => if t ≤ h then β t else α (t - h))
              (g (if t ≤ h then β t else α (t - h))) (Icc 0 h) t := by
            intro t ht
            rw [if_pos ht.2]
            exact (hβ t ht).congr_of_mem (fun s hs => if_pos hs.2) ht
          have hB : ∀ t ∈ Icc h (h + T), HasDerivWithinAt (fun t => if t ≤ h then β t else α (t - h))
              (g (if t ≤ h then β t else α (t - h))) (Icc h (h + T)) t := by
            intro t ht
            have hmem : t - h ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
            have h1 : HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => α (s - h)) (g (α (t - h))) (Icc h (h + T)) t := by
              have hs : HasDerivWithinAt (fun s : ℝ => s - h) 1 (Icc h (h + T)) t :=
                ((hasDerivAt_id' t).sub_const h).hasDerivWithinAt
              have := (hα (t - h) hmem).scomp t hs (fun s hs' => by
                simp only [mem_Icc] at hs' ⊢
                constructor <;> linarith [hs'.1, hs'.2])
              simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
            have heq : ∀ s ∈ Icc h (h + T), (if s ≤ h then β s else α (s - h)) = α (s - h) := by
              intro s hs
              split_ifs with hsh
              · have hsh' : s = h := le_antisymm hsh hs.1
                rw [hsh', sub_self, hα0]
              · rfl
            rw [heq t ht]
            exact h1.congr_of_mem heq ht
          intro t ht
          rcases lt_trichotomy t h with hlt | hth | hgt
          · apply (hA t ⟨ht.1, hlt.le⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin
            exact Filter.mem_of_superset (inter_mem_nhdsWithin (Icc 0 (h + T)) (Iio_mem_nhds hlt))
              (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1.1, le_of_lt hx.2⟩)
          · have hu := (hA t ⟨ht.1, hth.le⟩).union (hB t ⟨hth.ge, ht.2⟩)
            rwa [Set.Icc_union_Icc_eq_Icc hpos.le (by linarith)] at hu
          · apply (hB t ⟨hgt.le, ht.2⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin
            exact Filter.mem_of_superset (inter_mem_nhdsWithin (Icc 0 (h + T)) (Ioi_mem_nhds hgt))
              (fun x hx => ⟨le_of_lt hx.2, hx.1.2⟩)
      intro y
      choose α hα0 hα using fun n => hstep n y
      have hcont : ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousOn (α n) (Icc 0 (((n:ℝ) + 1) * h)) :=
        fun n t ht => (hα n t ht).continuousWithinAt
      have hIci : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 (((n:ℝ) + 1) * h),
          HasDerivWithinAt (α n) (g (α n t)) (Ici t) t := by
        intro n t ht
        apply (hα n t (Ico_subset_Icc_self ht)).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin
        exact Filter.mem_of_superset (Icc_mem_nhdsGE ht.2) (fun x hx => ⟨le_trans ht.1 hx.1, hx.2⟩)
      have hagree : ∀ n m : ℕ, n ≤ m → EqOn (α n) (α m) (Icc 0 (((n:ℝ) + 1) * h)) := by
        intro n m hnm
        have hnm' : (n:ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hnm
        have hle : ((n:ℝ) + 1) * h ≤ ((m:ℝ) + 1) * h := by nlinarith
        apply ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc_right (v := fun _ => g) (s := fun _ => univ) (K := K)
        · intro t _
          exact hg.lipschitzOnWith
        · exact hcont n
        · exact hIci n
        · intro t _
          trivial
        · exact (hcont m).mono (Icc_subset_Icc_right hle)
        · intro t ht
          exact hIci m t ⟨ht.1, lt_of_lt_of_le ht.2 hle⟩
        · intro t _
          trivial
        · rw [hα0, hα0]
      have hN : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ ((⌈t / h⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) * h := by
        intro t
        have := Nat.le_ceil (t / h)
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos] at this
        exact this
      refine ⟨fun t => α ⌈t / h⌉₊ t, hα0 _, ?_⟩
      intro t ht
      set M : ℕ := ⌈t / h⌉₊ + 1 with hM
      have hag : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 (((M:ℝ) + 1) * h), α ⌈s / h⌉₊ s = α M s := by
        intro s hs
        rcases le_total ⌈s / h⌉₊ M with hle | hle
        · exact hagree _ _ hle ⟨hs.1, by linarith [hN s]⟩
        · exact (hagree _ _ hle hs).symm
      have hlt : t < ((M:ℝ) + 1) * h := by
        have := hN t
        rw [hM]
        push_cast
        nlinarith
      have htm : t ∈ Icc 0 (((M:ℝ) + 1) * h) := ⟨ht, hlt.le⟩
      have hd := (hα M t htm).congr_of_mem hag htm
      rw [← hag t htm] at hd
      apply hd.mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin
      exact Filter.mem_of_superset (inter_mem_nhdsWithin (Ici 0) (Iio_mem_nhds hlt))
        (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, le_of_lt hx.2⟩)
    obtain ⟨γp, hγp0, hγp⟩ := hfwd f hf x₀
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδ⟩ := hfwd (fun x => -f x) hf.neg x₀
    refine ⟨fun t => if 0 ≤ t then γp t else δ (-t), by simp [hγp0], ?_⟩
    intro t
    rcases lt_trichotomy t 0 with hlt | hzero | hgt
    · have hd : HasDerivAt δ (-f (δ (-t))) (-t) :=
        (hδ (-t) (by linarith)).hasDerivAt (Ici_mem_nhds (by linarith))
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun s => δ (-s)) (f (δ (-t))) t := by
        have := hd.scomp t (hasDerivAt_neg t)
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
      have hev : (fun s => if 0 ≤ s then γp s else δ (-s)) =ᶠ[nhds t] fun s => δ (-s) := by
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hlt] with s hs
        rw [if_neg (not_le.2 hs)]
      show HasDerivAt (fun s => if 0 ≤ s then γp s else δ (-s))
        (f (if 0 ≤ t then γp t else δ (-t))) t
      rw [if_neg (not_le.2 hlt)]
      exact hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    · subst hzero
      show HasDerivAt (fun s => if 0 ≤ s then γp s else δ (-s))
        (f (if (0:ℝ) ≤ 0 then γp 0 else δ (-0))) 0
      rw [if_pos le_rfl]
      have h1 : HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => if 0 ≤ s then γp s else δ (-s)) (f (γp 0)) (Ici 0) 0 :=
        (hγp 0 le_rfl).congr_of_mem (fun s hs => if_pos hs) self_mem_Ici
      have h2 : HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => if 0 ≤ s then γp s else δ (-s)) (f (γp 0)) (Iic 0) 0 := by
        have hd : HasDerivWithinAt δ (-f (δ (-0))) (Ici 0) (-0) := by
          rw [neg_zero]
          exact hδ 0 le_rfl
        have hmaps : MapsTo (Neg.neg : ℝ → ℝ) (Iic 0) (Ici 0) :=
          fun s (hs : s ≤ 0) => show (0:ℝ) ≤ -s from neg_nonneg.2 hs
        have hc := hd.scomp (0:ℝ) (hasDerivAt_neg (0:ℝ)).hasDerivWithinAt hmaps
        have hc' : HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => δ (-s)) (f (γp 0)) (Iic 0) 0 := by
          rw [hγp0]
          simpa [hδ0, Function.comp_def] using hc
        apply hc'.congr_of_mem _ self_mem_Iic
        intro s hs
        by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ s
        · have hs0 : s = 0 := le_antisymm hs h0
          rw [if_pos h0, hs0, neg_zero, hγp0, hδ0]
        · rw [if_neg h0]
      have hu := h1.union h2
      have hU : Ici (0:ℝ) ∪ Iic 0 = univ := by
        ext x
        simp [le_total]
      rw [hU, hasDerivWithinAt_univ] at hu
      exact hu
    · have hd : HasDerivAt γp (f (γp t)) t := (hγp t hgt.le).hasDerivAt (Ici_mem_nhds hgt)
      have hev : (fun s => if 0 ≤ s then γp s else δ (-s)) =ᶠ[nhds t] γp := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hgt] with s hs
        rw [if_pos (le_of_lt hs)]
      show HasDerivAt (fun s => if 0 ≤ s then γp s else δ (-s))
        (f (if 0 ≤ t then γp t else δ (-t))) t
      rw [if_pos hgt.le]
      exact hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  obtain ⟨γS, hγS0, hγS⟩ := hglobal S F ⟨L, hL0⟩ hFL ⟨f₀, hf₀S⟩
  let γ : ℝ → BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ := fun t => (γS t : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)
  have hγd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt γ ((F (γS t) : S) : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) t := by
    intro t
    have h := (S.subtypeL).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hγS t)
    exact h
  have hγc : Continuous γ := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun t => (hγd t).continuousAt
  
  have hint : ∀ f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ,
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f x * g x) volume 0 1 :=
    fun f g => (f.continuous.mul g.continuous).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  let Lb : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun f g => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x * g x)
      (fun f₁ f₂ g => by
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add (hint f₁ g) (hint f₂ g)]
        congr 1
        funext x
        ring)
      (fun c f g => by
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        congr 1
        funext x
        ring)
      (fun f g₁ g₂ => by
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add (hint f g₁) (hint f g₂)]
        congr 1
        funext x
        ring)
      (fun c f g => by
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        congr 1
        funext x
        ring)
  have hbd : ∀ f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ, ‖Lb f g‖ ≤ 1 * ‖f‖ * ‖g‖ := by
    intro f g
    show ‖∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x * g x‖ ≤ 1 * ‖f‖ * ‖g‖
    have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1)
      (C := ‖f‖ * ‖g‖) (f := fun x => f x * g x) (fun x _ => by
        rw [norm_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul (f.norm_coe_le_norm x) (g.norm_coe_le_norm x) (norm_nonneg _)
          (norm_nonneg _))
    simp only [sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one] at h
    linarith
  let B := Lb.mkContinuous₂ 1 hbd
  have hBapp : ∀ f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ, B f g = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x * g x :=
    fun f g => rfl
  have key : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, γ s x ^ 2)
      (2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, γ t x * G ⇑(γ t) x) t := by
    intro t
    have hB := ContinuousLinearMap.hasDerivAt_of_bilinear (B := B) (hγd t) (hγd t)
    have e1 : (fun τ => B (γ τ) (γ τ)) = fun s => ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, γ s x ^ 2 := by
      funext τ
      rw [hBapp]
      congr 1
      funext x
      ring
    have e2 : B (γ t) ((F (γS t) : S) : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) +
        B ((F (γS t) : S) : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (γ t) =
          2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, γ t x * G ⇑(γ t) x := by
      rw [hBapp, hBapp]
      have h1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, γ t x * ((F (γS t) : S) : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) x) =
          ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, γ t x * G ⇑(γ t) x := rfl
      have h2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((F (γS t) : S) : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) x * γ t x) =
          ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, γ t x * G ⇑(γ t) x := by
        rw [← h1]
        congr 1
        funext x
        ring
      rw [h1, h2]
      ring
    rw [e1, e2] at hB
    exact hB
  
  refine ⟨fun t x => γ t x, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    show (γS 0 : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) x = w₀ x
    rw [hγS0]
    rfl
  · exact continuous_eval.comp ((hγc.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd)
  · intro t
    exact hper (γS t)
  · intro t x
    have h := (BoundedContinuousFunction.evalCLM ℝ x).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hγd t)
    exact h
  · intro t
    exact key t

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (κ ρ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → Continuous (wfieldTclamp κ ρ w) ∧ (Function.Periodic w 1 → Function.Periodic (wfieldTclamp κ ρ w) 1)

signature.name: wfieldTclamp_continuous_periodic
signature.statement: ∀ (κ ρ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → Continuous (wfieldTclamp κ ρ w) ∧ (Function.Periodic w 1 → Function.Periodic (wfieldTclamp κ ρ w) 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ ρ w hw
  have hii : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable w MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
    fun a b => hw.intervalIntegrable a b
  set P : ℝ → ℝ := fun b => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..b, w y with hPdef
  have hP : Continuous P := intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive hii 0
  have hwinA : ∀ x s : ℝ, (∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) = P x - P (x - s) := by
    intro x s
    simp only [hPdef]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hii 0 x) (hii 0 (x - s))]
  have hwinB : ∀ x s : ℝ, (∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) = P (x + s) - P x := by
    intro x s
    simp only [hPdef]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hii 0 (x + s)) (hii 0 x)]
  have hcl : ∀ {g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ}, Continuous g → Continuous fun p => wclamp ρ (g p) := by
    intro g hg
    unfold wclamp
    exact continuous_const.max (hg.min continuous_const)
  have hA : Continuous fun x : ℝ =>
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y)) := by
    have hf : Continuous (Function.uncurry fun x s : ℝ =>
        Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y))) := by
      have heq : (Function.uncurry fun x s : ℝ =>
          Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y))) =
          fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * p.2 + 2 * wclamp ρ (P p.1 - P (p.1 - p.2))) := by
        funext p
        simp only [Function.uncurry, hwinA]
      rw [heq]
      have hg : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => P p.1 - P (p.1 - p.2) :=
        (hP.comp continuous_fst).sub (hP.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd))
      exact Real.continuous_exp.comp
        ((continuous_const.mul continuous_snd).add (continuous_const.mul (hcl hg)))
    exact intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hf 0 1
  have hB : Continuous fun x : ℝ =>
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in x..(x + s), w y)) := by
    have hf : Continuous (Function.uncurry fun x s : ℝ =>
        Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in x..(x + s), w y))) := by
      have heq : (Function.uncurry fun x s : ℝ =>
          Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in x..(x + s), w y))) =
          fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * p.2 + 2 * wclamp ρ (P (p.1 + p.2) - P p.1)) := by
        funext p
        simp only [Function.uncurry, hwinB]
      rw [heq]
      have hg : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => P (p.1 + p.2) - P p.1 :=
        (hP.comp (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd)).sub (hP.comp continuous_fst)
      exact Real.continuous_exp.comp
        ((continuous_const.mul continuous_snd).add (continuous_const.mul (hcl hg)))
    exact intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hf 0 1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold wfieldTclamp
    exact continuous_const.mul (hA.sub hB)
  · intro hp x
    have hp' : ∀ y : ℝ, w (y + 1) = w y := hp
    have hpA : ∀ s : ℝ, (∫ y in (x + 1 - s)..(x + 1), w y) = ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y := by
      intro s
      have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right w (a := x - s) (b := x) 1
      simp only [hp'] at h1
      rw [h1]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hpB : ∀ s : ℝ, (∫ y in (x + 1)..(x + 1 + s), w y) = ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y := by
      intro s
      have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right w (a := x) (b := x + s) 1
      simp only [hp'] at h1
      rw [h1]
      congr 1
      ring
    unfold wfieldTclamp
    simp only [hpA, hpB]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ κ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ ρ ≥ (0 : ℝ), 2 * ρ ≤ κ → (∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → ∀ x, |wfieldTclamp κ ρ w x| ≤ 16 * κ ^ 5 * Real.exp (2 * ρ)) ∧ (∀ w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w₁ → Continuous w₂ → ∀ D : ℝ, (∀ y, |w₁ y - w₂ y| ≤ D) → ∀ x, |wfieldTclamp κ ρ w₁ x - wfieldTclamp κ ρ w₂ x| ≤ 128 * κ ^ 5 * Real.exp (2 * ρ) * D)

signature.name: wfieldTclamp_bound_lipschitz
signature.statement: ∀ κ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ ρ ≥ (0 : ℝ), 2 * ρ ≤ κ → (∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → ∀ x, |wfieldTclamp κ ρ w x| ≤ 16 * κ ^ 5 * Real.exp (2 * ρ)) ∧ (∀ w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w₁ → Continuous w₂ → ∀ D : ℝ, (∀ y, |w₁ y - w₂ y| ≤ D) → ∀ x, |wfieldTclamp κ ρ w₁ x - wfieldTclamp κ ρ w₂ x| ≤ 128 * κ ^ 5 * Real.exp (2 * ρ) * D)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ ρ hρ h2ρ
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ κ := by linarith
  have h8 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 8 * κ ^ 5 := mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (pow_nonneg hk0 5)
  
  have exp_lip : ∀ p q m : ℝ, p ≤ m → q ≤ m →
      |Real.exp p - Real.exp q| ≤ Real.exp m * |p - q| := by
    have key : ∀ p q m : ℝ, q ≤ p → p ≤ m →
        |Real.exp p - Real.exp q| ≤ Real.exp m * |p - q| := by
      intro p q m hqp hpm
      have h1 : Real.exp q ≤ Real.exp p := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hqp
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith), abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
      have h2 : Real.exp q = Real.exp p * Real.exp (q - p) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      have h3 := Real.add_one_le_exp (q - p)
      have h4 : Real.exp p ≤ Real.exp m := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hpm
      have h5 := Real.exp_pos p
      rw [h2]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 h5.le,
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4 (sub_nonneg.2 hqp)]
    intro p q m hp hq
    rcases le_total q p with h | h
    · exact key p q m h hp
    · rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_sub_comm p q]; exact key q p m h hq
  
  have cl_le : ∀ a, wclamp ρ a ≤ ρ := fun a => max_le (by linarith) (min_le_right a ρ)
  have cl_lip : ∀ a b, |wclamp ρ a - wclamp ρ b| ≤ |a - b| := by
    intro a b
    have h1 := le_abs_self (a - b)
    have h2 := neg_abs_le (a - b)
    rw [abs_le]
    unfold wclamp
    constructor <;> (simp only [max_def, min_def]; split_ifs <;> linarith)
  have clcont : ∀ F : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous F → Continuous fun s => wclamp ρ (F s) := by
    intro F hF
    unfold wclamp
    exact continuous_const.max (hF.min continuous_const)
  
  have pre : ∀ a₁ a₂ : ℝ, a₁ ≤ -1 → a₂ ≤ -1 → 0 < (1 - Real.exp a₁)⁻¹ ∧
      (1 - Real.exp a₁)⁻¹ ≤ 2 ∧
      |(1 - Real.exp a₁)⁻¹ - (1 - Real.exp a₂)⁻¹| ≤ 4 * |a₁ - a₂| := by
    intro a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
    have hh := Real.exp_neg_one_lt_half
    have e1 : Real.exp a₁ ≤ Real.exp (-1) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 h₁
    have e2 : Real.exp a₂ ≤ Real.exp (-1) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 h₂
    have p1 : 0 < 1 - Real.exp a₁ := by linarith
    have p2 : 0 < 1 - Real.exp a₂ := by linarith
    have b1 : (1 - Real.exp a₁)⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
      rw [inv_le_iff_one_le_mul₀ p1]; linarith
    have b2 : (1 - Real.exp a₂)⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
      rw [inv_le_iff_one_le_mul₀ p2]; linarith
    refine ⟨inv_pos.2 p1, b1, ?_⟩
    have hid : (1 - Real.exp a₁)⁻¹ - (1 - Real.exp a₂)⁻¹ =
        (Real.exp a₁ - Real.exp a₂) * ((1 - Real.exp a₁)⁻¹ * (1 - Real.exp a₂)⁻¹) := by
      field_simp; ring
    rw [hid, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (mul_pos (inv_pos.2 p1) (inv_pos.2 p2))]
    have hl := exp_lip a₁ a₂ 0 (by linarith) (by linarith)
    rw [Real.exp_zero, one_mul] at hl
    have q1 := inv_pos.2 p1
    have q2 := inv_pos.2 p2
    have hprod : (1 - Real.exp a₁)⁻¹ * (1 - Real.exp a₂)⁻¹ ≤ 4 := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul b1 b2 q2.le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    calc |Real.exp a₁ - Real.exp a₂| * ((1 - Real.exp a₁)⁻¹ * (1 - Real.exp a₂)⁻¹)
        ≤ |a₁ - a₂| * 4 := mul_le_mul hl hprod (by positivity) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = 4 * |a₁ - a₂| := by ring
  
  have intest : ∀ D : ℝ, ∀ g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous g₁ → Continuous g₂ →
      (∀ s, g₁ s ≤ ρ) → (∀ s, g₂ s ≤ ρ) → (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |g₁ s - g₂ s| ≤ D) →
      0 ≤ (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * g₁ s)) ∧
      (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * g₁ s)) ≤ Real.exp (2 * ρ) ∧
      |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * g₁ s)) -
        ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * g₂ s)| ≤ 2 * Real.exp (2 * ρ) * D := by
    intro D g₁ g₂ hg₁ hg₂ hb₁ hb₂ hD
    have hc₁ : Continuous fun s => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * g₁ s) := by fun_prop
    have hc₂ : Continuous fun s => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * g₂ s) := by fun_prop
    have hexp : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ s, g s ≤ ρ) → ∀ s ∈ Set.uIoc (0:ℝ) 1,
        -2 * κ * s + 2 * g s ≤ 2 * ρ := by
      intro g hg s hs
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one, Set.mem_Ioc] at hs
      have := hg s
      nlinarith
    refine ⟨intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun s _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 1)
        (C := Real.exp (2 * ρ)) (f := fun s => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * g₁ s))
        (fun s hs => by
          dsimp only
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
          exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 (hexp g₁ hb₁ s hs))
      rw [sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) h
    · rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hc₁.intervalIntegrable 0 1) (hc₂.intervalIntegrable 0 1)]
      have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 1)
        (C := 2 * Real.exp (2 * ρ) * D)
        (f := fun s => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * g₁ s) - Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * g₂ s))
        (fun s hs => by
          dsimp only
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
          have hl := exp_lip _ _ _ (hexp g₁ hb₁ s hs) (hexp g₂ hb₂ s hs)
          have hs' : s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
            rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs; exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hs
          have e : -2 * κ * s + 2 * g₁ s - (-2 * κ * s + 2 * g₂ s) = 2 * (g₁ s - g₂ s) := by ring
          rw [e, abs_mul, abs_two] at hl
          have hE := Real.exp_pos (2 * ρ)
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hD s hs') hE.le
          nlinarith)
      rw [sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
      exact h
  
  have innercont : ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (Continuous fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) ∧
      (Continuous fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) := by
    intro w hw x
    have hW : Continuous fun z => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..z, w y :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive (fun a b => hw.intervalIntegrable a b) 0
    have e1 : (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) =
        fun s => (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..x, w y) - ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..(x - s), w y := by
      funext s
      exact (intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 x)
        (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 (x - s))).symm
    have e2 : (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) =
        fun s => (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..(x + s), w y) - ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..x, w y := by
      funext s
      exact (intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 (x + s))
        (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 x)).symm
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact ⟨continuous_const.sub (hW.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)),
      (hW.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).sub continuous_const⟩
  have gen : ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w₁ → Continuous w₂ → ∀ D : ℝ,
      (∀ y, |w₁ y - w₂ y| ≤ D) → ∀ a b : ℝ, |b - a| ≤ 1 →
      |(∫ y in a..b, w₁ y) - ∫ y in a..b, w₂ y| ≤ D := by
    intro w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ D hD a b hab
    have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hD 0)
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (h₁.intervalIntegrable a b) (h₂.intervalIntegrable a b)]
    have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := a) (b := b) (C := D)
      (f := fun y => w₁ y - w₂ y) (fun y _ => by dsimp only; rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hD y)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    calc _ ≤ D * |b - a| := h
      _ ≤ D * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab hD0
      _ = D := mul_one D
  
  have comb : ∀ P₁ P₂ A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ E D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D → 0 < P₁ → P₁ ≤ 2 → 0 < P₂ → P₂ ≤ 2 →
      0 ≤ A₁ → A₁ ≤ E → 0 ≤ B₁ → B₁ ≤ E → |P₁ - P₂| ≤ 8 * D → |A₁ - A₂| ≤ 2 * E * D →
      |B₁ - B₂| ≤ 2 * E * D → |P₁ * (A₁ - B₁) - P₂ * (A₂ - B₂)| ≤ 16 * E * D := by
    intro P₁ P₂ A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ E D hD hP₁ hP₁2 hP₂ hP₂2 hA₁ hA₁E hB₁ hB₁E hP hA hB
    have hE : 0 ≤ E := le_trans hA₁ hA₁E
    have hAB : |A₁ - B₁| ≤ E := abs_sub_le_iff.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have e : P₁ * (A₁ - B₁) - P₂ * (A₂ - B₂) =
        (P₁ - P₂) * (A₁ - B₁) + P₂ * ((A₁ - A₂) - (B₁ - B₂)) := by ring
    rw [e]
    have t1 : |(P₁ - P₂) * (A₁ - B₁)| ≤ 8 * D * E := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hP hAB (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have t2 : |P₂ * ((A₁ - A₂) - (B₁ - B₂))| ≤ 2 * (2 * E * D + 2 * E * D) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hP₂]
      have hs : |(A₁ - A₂) - (B₁ - B₂)| ≤ |A₁ - A₂| + |B₁ - B₂| := abs_sub _ _
      exact mul_le_mul hP₂2 (le_trans hs (add_le_add hA hB)) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    calc _ ≤ |(P₁ - P₂) * (A₁ - B₁)| + |P₂ * ((A₁ - A₂) - (B₁ - B₂))| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ 8 * D * E + 2 * (2 * E * D + 2 * E * D) := add_le_add t1 t2
      _ = 16 * E * D := by ring
  
  obtain ⟨Pf, hPf⟩ : ∃ Pf : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ, ∀ w,
      Pf w = (1 - Real.exp (2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y) - 2 * κ))⁻¹ :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Af, hAf⟩ : ∃ Af : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ w x,
      Af w x = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y)) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Bf, hBf⟩ : ∃ Bf : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ w x,
      Bf w x = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in x..(x + s), w y)) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hrepr : ∀ w x, wfieldTclamp κ ρ w x = 8 * κ ^ 5 * (Pf w * (Af w x - Bf w x)) := by
    intro w x
    unfold wfieldTclamp
    rw [← hPf w, ← hAf w x, ← hBf w x]
    ring
  have datum : ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < Pf w ∧ Pf w ≤ 2 ∧
      0 ≤ Af w x ∧ Af w x ≤ Real.exp (2 * ρ) ∧ 0 ≤ Bf w x ∧ Bf w x ≤ Real.exp (2 * ρ) := by
    intro w hw x
    have hc := cl_le (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y)
    have hp := pre (2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y) - 2 * κ)
      (2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y) - 2 * κ) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hgL : Continuous fun s => wclamp ρ (∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) :=
      clcont (fun s => ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) (innercont w hw x).1
    have hgR : Continuous fun s => wclamp ρ (∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) :=
      clcont (fun s => ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) (innercont w hw x).2
    have hA := intest 0 _ _ hgL hgL (fun s => cl_le _) (fun s => cl_le _) (fun s _ => by simp)
    have hB := intest 0 _ _ hgR hgR (fun s => cl_le _) (fun s => cl_le _) (fun s _ => by simp)
    rw [hPf, hAf, hBf]
    exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, hA.1, hA.2.1, hB.1, hB.2.1⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w hw x
    obtain ⟨p, p', a, a', b, b'⟩ := datum w hw x
    rw [hrepr, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h8, abs_mul, abs_of_pos p]
    have hAB : |Af w x - Bf w x| ≤ Real.exp (2 * ρ) := abs_sub_le_iff.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hm := mul_le_mul p' hAB (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    calc 8 * κ ^ 5 * (Pf w * |Af w x - Bf w x|) ≤ 8 * κ ^ 5 * (2 * Real.exp (2 * ρ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm h8
      _ = 16 * κ ^ 5 * Real.exp (2 * ρ) := by ring
  · intro w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ D hD x
    have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hD 0)
    obtain ⟨p1, p1', a1, a1', b1, b1'⟩ := datum w₁ hw₁ x
    obtain ⟨p2, p2', -, -, -, -⟩ := datum w₂ hw₂ x
    have hc := cl_lip (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ y) (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w₂ y)
    have h01 := gen w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ D hD 0 1 (by norm_num)
    have hPP : |Pf w₁ - Pf w₂| ≤ 8 * D := by
      rw [hPf, hPf]
      have hq := (pre (2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ y) - 2 * κ)
        (2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w₂ y) - 2 * κ)
        (by linarith [cl_le (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ y)])
        (by linarith [cl_le (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w₂ y)])).2.2
      have e : 2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ y) - 2 * κ -
          (2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w₂ y) - 2 * κ) =
          2 * (wclamp ρ (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w₁ y) - wclamp ρ (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w₂ y)) := by ring
      rw [e, abs_mul, abs_two] at hq
      linarith
    have hAA : |Af w₁ x - Af w₂ x| ≤ 2 * Real.exp (2 * ρ) * D := by
      rw [hAf, hAf]
      exact (intest D _ _ (clcont _ (innercont w₁ hw₁ x).1) (clcont _ (innercont w₂ hw₂ x).1)
        (fun s => cl_le _) (fun s => cl_le _)
        (fun s hs => le_trans (cl_lip _ _) (gen w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ D hD (x - s) x
          (abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [hs.1, hs.2], by linarith [hs.1, hs.2]⟩)))).2.2
    have hBB : |Bf w₁ x - Bf w₂ x| ≤ 2 * Real.exp (2 * ρ) * D := by
      rw [hBf, hBf]
      exact (intest D _ _ (clcont _ (innercont w₁ hw₁ x).2) (clcont _ (innercont w₂ hw₂ x).2)
        (fun s => cl_le _) (fun s => cl_le _)
        (fun s hs => le_trans (cl_lip _ _) (gen w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ D hD x (x + s)
          (abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [hs.1, hs.2], by linarith [hs.1, hs.2]⟩)))).2.2
    have key := comb (Pf w₁) (Pf w₂) (Af w₁ x) (Af w₂ x) (Bf w₁ x) (Bf w₂ x)
      (Real.exp (2 * ρ)) D hD0 p1 p1' p2 p2' a1 a1' b1 b1' hPP hAA hBB
    rw [hrepr, hrepr, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h8]
    calc 8 * κ ^ 5 * |Pf w₁ * (Af w₁ x - Bf w₁ x) - Pf w₂ * (Af w₂ x - Bf w₂ x)|
        ≤ 8 * κ ^ 5 * (16 * Real.exp (2 * ρ) * D) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key h8
      _ = 128 * κ ^ 5 * Real.exp (2 * ρ) * D := by ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (κ ρ : ℝ), 0 ≤ ρ → ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → Function.Periodic w 1 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ≤ ρ ^ 2 → ∀ x, wfieldTclamp κ ρ w x = wfieldT κ w x

signature.name: wfieldTclamp_eq_wfieldT
signature.statement: ∀ (κ ρ : ℝ), 0 ≤ ρ → ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → Function.Periodic w 1 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ≤ ρ ^ 2 → ∀ x, wfieldTclamp κ ρ w x = wfieldT κ w x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ ρ hρ w hw hp hE x
  have hg : Continuous (fun y => |w y|) := continuous_abs.comp hw
  have hgp : Function.Periodic (fun y => |w y|) 1 := fun y => by simp only [hp y]
  set m := ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |w y| with hm
  
  have hvar : m ^ 2 ≤ ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y ^ 2 := by
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, (|w y| - m) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun y _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hfun : (fun y => (|w y| - m) ^ 2) = fun y => (w y ^ 2 - (2 * m) * |w y|) + m ^ 2 := by
      funext y
      rw [sub_sq, sq_abs]
      ring
    have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun y => w y ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (hw.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun y => (2 * m) * |w y|) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (continuous_const.mul hg).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    have hi3 : IntervalIntegrable (fun y => w y ^ 2 - (2 * m) * |w y|) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      hi1.sub hi2
    have hcalc : (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, (|w y| - m) ^ 2) = (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y ^ 2) - m ^ 2 := by
      rw [hfun, intervalIntegral.integral_add hi3 intervalIntegrable_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub hi1 hi2, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const]
      simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
      rw [← hm]
      ring
    linarith
  have hmρ : m ≤ ρ := (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' (le_trans hvar hE) hρ).2
  
  have hwin : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → b ≤ a + 1 → |∫ y in a..b, w y| ≤ ρ := by
    intro a b hab hb
    have h1 : |∫ y in a..b, w y| ≤ ∫ y in a..b, |w y| :=
      intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs hab
    have h2 : (∫ y in a..b, |w y|) ≤ ∫ y in a..(a + 1), |w y| :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_interval (le_refl a) hab hb
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => abs_nonneg (w y))) (hg.intervalIntegrable _ _)
    have h3 : (∫ y in a..(a + 1), |w y|) = m := by
      rw [hgp.intervalIntegral_add_eq a 0, zero_add]
    linarith
  have hcl : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ ρ → wclamp ρ t = t := by
    intro t ht
    have h := abs_le.1 ht
    unfold wclamp
    rw [min_eq_left h.2, max_eq_right h.1]
  have hmean : wclamp ρ (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y) = ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y :=
    hcl _ (hwin 0 1 zero_le_one (by norm_num))
  have hleft : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y))) =
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
    obtain ⟨hs0, hs1⟩ := hs
    simp only
    rw [hcl _ (hwin (x - s) x (by linarith) (by linarith))]
  have hright : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp ρ (∫ y in x..(x + s), w y))) =
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
    obtain ⟨hs0, hs1⟩ := hs
    simp only
    rw [hcl _ (hwin x (x + s) (by linarith) (by linarith))]
  unfold wfieldTclamp wfieldT rgreenT rgreenRT
  rw [hmean, hleft, hright]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → Function.Periodic w 1 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * wfieldT κ w x) = 0

signature.name: wfieldT_energy_orthogonal
signature.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → Function.Periodic w 1 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * wfieldT κ w x) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ w hw hp
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, P = fun u => ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..u, w y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPd : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt P (w u) u := by
    intro u; rw [hPdef]; exact (hw.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 u).hasDerivAt
  have hPc : Continuous P := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun u => (hPd u).continuousAt
  have hwin : ∀ a b : ℝ, ∫ y in a..b, w y = P b - P a := by
    intro a b
    rw [hPdef]
    exact (intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 b)
      (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 a)).symm
  have hP0 : P 0 = 0 := by rw [hPdef]; simp
  have hPper : ∀ z : ℝ, P (z + 1) = P z + P 1 := by
    intro z
    have h1 := hp.intervalIntegral_add_eq z 0
    rw [hwin, hwin, zero_add] at h1
    linarith
  
  have hslice : ∀ c s : ℝ, (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y)) =
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) := by
    intro c s
    obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ → ℝ, A = fun x => ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hAe : ∀ x, A x = P x - P (x - s) := by intro x; rw [hAdef]; exact hwin _ _
    have hBe : ∀ x, (∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) = A (x + s) := by
      intro x; rw [hwin, hAe, add_sub_cancel_right]
    have hAper : Function.Periodic A 1 := by
      intro x
      rw [hAe, hAe, show x + 1 - s = (x - s) + 1 by ring, hPper, hPper]
      ring
    have hAd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt A (w x - w (x - s)) x := by
      intro x
      have e : A = fun x => P x - P (x - s) := funext hAe
      rw [e]
      exact (hPd x).sub ((hPd (x - s)).comp_sub_const x s)
    have hAc : Continuous A := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hAd x).continuousAt
    have hec : Continuous (fun x => Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) :=
      Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul hAc))
    have hc1 : Continuous (fun x => w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) := hw.mul hec
    have hc2 : Continuous (fun x => w (x - s) * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) :=
      (hw.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).mul hec
    have hhd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x => Real.exp (c + 2 * A x))
        (2 * (w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) - 2 * (w (x - s) * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x))) x := by
      intro x
      have := (((hAd x).const_mul 2).const_add c).exp
      convert this using 1
      ring
    have h2c : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => (2:ℝ)) := continuous_const
    have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1)
      (fun x _ => hhd x) (((h2c.mul hc1).sub
        (h2c.mul hc2)).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((h2c.mul hc1).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      ((h2c.mul hc2).intervalIntegrable 0 1), intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hftc
    have hA10 : A 1 = A 0 := by
      have := hAper 0
      rw [zero_add] at this
      exact this
    have key : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) =
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w (x - s) * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x) := by
      simp only [hA10, sub_self] at hftc
      linarith
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ : ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ψ = fun y => w y * Real.exp (c + 2 * A (y + s)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hψper : Function.Periodic ψ 1 := by
      intro y
      rw [hψ]
      simp only
      rw [hp y, show y + 1 + s = (y + s) + 1 by ring, hAper]
    have htr : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w (x - s) * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) =
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ψ x := by
      have e : (fun x => w (x - s) * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) = fun x => ψ (x - s) := by
        funext x; rw [hψ]; simp only [sub_add_cancel]
      rw [e, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_right ψ s]
      have := hψper.intervalIntegral_add_eq (0 - s) 0
      rw [show (0:ℝ) - s + 1 = 1 - s by ring, zero_add] at this
      exact this
    have hL : (fun x => w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y)) =
        fun x => w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x) := by rw [hAdef]
    have hR : (fun x => w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y)) = ψ := by
      rw [hψ]; funext x; rw [hBe]
    rw [hL, hR, key, htr]
  
  have hswap : ∀ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, F x s) = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, F x s := by
    intro F hF
    have hint : Integrable (Function.uncurry F)
        ((volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1)).prod (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1))) := by
      rw [Measure.prod_restrict, ← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
      exact (hF.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)).mono_set
        (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self)
    have := MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap hint
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one]
    exact this
  
  have hcA : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * ∫ y in (p.1 - p.2)..p.1, w y) := by
    have e : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * ∫ y in (p.1 - p.2)..p.1, w y) =
        fun p => 2 * (P p.1 - P (p.1 - p.2)) := by
      funext p; rw [hwin]
    rw [e]
    exact continuous_const.mul
      ((hPc.comp continuous_fst).sub (hPc.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd)))
  have hcB : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * ∫ y in p.1..(p.1 + p.2), w y) := by
    have e : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * ∫ y in p.1..(p.1 + p.2), w y) =
        fun p => 2 * (P (p.1 + p.2) - P p.1) := by
      funext p; rw [hwin]
    rw [e]
    exact continuous_const.mul
      ((hPc.comp (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd)).sub (hPc.comp continuous_fst))
  have hFa : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      w p.1 * Real.exp (-2 * κ * p.2 + 2 * ∫ y in (p.1 - p.2)..p.1, w y)) :=
    (hw.comp continuous_fst).mul
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp ((continuous_const.mul continuous_snd).add hcA))
  have hFb : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      w p.1 * Real.exp (-2 * κ * p.2 + 2 * ∫ y in p.1..(p.1 + p.2), w y)) :=
    (hw.comp continuous_fst).mul
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp ((continuous_const.mul continuous_snd).add hcB))
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ, Q = (1 - Real.exp (2 * (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y) - 2 * κ))⁻¹ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hpt : ∀ x : ℝ, w x * wfieldT κ w x = 8 * κ ^ 5 * Q * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1,
      (w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) -
        w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y)) := by
    intro x
    have ha : Continuous (fun s : ℝ =>
        w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y)) :=
      hFa.comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => (x, s))
    have hb : Continuous (fun s : ℝ =>
        w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y)) :=
      hFb.comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => (x, s))
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (ha.intervalIntegrable 0 1) (hb.intervalIntegrable 0 1),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    simp only [wfieldT, rgreenT, rgreenRT]
    rw [← hQ]
    ring
  have hcalc : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x * wfieldT κ w x) = 8 * κ ^ 5 * Q *
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1,
        (w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) -
          w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y)) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext x
    exact hpt x
  have hs := hswap (fun x s => w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) -
    w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y)) (hFa.sub hFb)
  beta_reduce at hs
  rw [hcalc, hs]
  have hz : ∀ s : ℝ, (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1,
      (w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) -
        w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y))) = 0 := by
    intro s
    have ha : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
        w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y)) :=
      hFa.comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : ℝ => (x, s))
    have hb : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
        w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y)) :=
      hFb.comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : ℝ => (x, s))
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (ha.intervalIntegrable 0 1) (hb.intervalIntegrable 0 1),
      hslice, sub_self]
  simp only [hz, intervalIntegral.integral_zero, mul_zero]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ κ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ u : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (((⊤ : ℕ∞)) : WithTop ℕ∞) u → Function.Periodic u 1 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, u x) < κ → greenT κ (fun x => deriv u x - 2 * κ * u x + u x ^ 2) = rgreenT κ u

signature.name: greenT_eq_rgreenT
signature.statement: ∀ κ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ u : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (((⊤ : ℕ∞)) : WithTop ℕ∞) u → Function.Periodic u 1 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, u x) < κ → greenT κ (fun x => deriv u x - 2 * κ * u x + u x ^ 2) = rgreenT κ u

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ u hu hup hM
  obtain ⟨hg, -, hgp, -, hgpos⟩ := rgreenT_ode_T κ u hu.continuous hup hM
  have hu1 : Differentiable ℝ u := (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.1 hu).1
  have hdu : ContDiff ℝ (((⊤ : ℕ∞)) : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv u) := (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.1 hu).2
  have hdup : Function.Periodic (deriv u) 1 := by
    intro y
    have h1 : (fun z => u (z + 1)) = u := funext fun z => hup z
    rw [← deriv_comp_add_const, h1]
  have hqC : (fun x => deriv u x - 2 * κ * u x + u x ^ 2) ∈ CinfT := by
    refine ⟨(hdu.sub (contDiff_const.mul hu)).add (hu.pow 2), ?_⟩
    intro y
    simp only [hdup y, hup y]
  let qT : CinfT := ⟨fun x => deriv u x - 2 * κ * u x + u x ^ 2, hqC⟩
  have hqT : ∀ x, (qT : ℝ → ℝ) x = deriv u x - 2 * κ * u x + u x ^ 2 := fun x => rfl
  set g := rgreenT κ u with hgdef
  let wm : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => (u y - 2 * κ) + (g y)⁻¹
  have hwmp : Function.Periodic wm 1 := by
    intro y
    simp only [wm, hup y, hgp y]
  have hwp : ∀ x, HasDerivAt u ((qT : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * u x - u x ^ 2) x := by
    intro x
    refine (hu1 x).hasDerivAt.congr_deriv ?_
    rw [hqT]
    ring
  have hwm : ∀ x, HasDerivAt wm ((qT : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x := by
    intro x
    have hG : g x ≠ 0 := (hgpos x).ne'
    have ha : HasDerivAt (fun y => u y - 2 * κ) (deriv u x) x :=
      (hu1 x).hasDerivAt.sub_const (2 * κ)
    have hb : HasDerivAt (fun y => (g y)⁻¹)
        (-(2 * (u x - κ) * g x + 1) / g x ^ 2) x := (hg x).inv hG
    refine (ha.add hb).congr_deriv ?_
    rw [hqT]
    simp only [wm]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hpos : ∀ x, 0 < 2 * κ + wm x - u x := by
    intro x
    have e : 2 * κ + wm x - u x = (g x)⁻¹ := by simp only [wm]; ring
    rw [e]
    exact inv_pos.2 (hgpos x)
  obtain ⟨-, hform⟩ := greenT_eq_of_riccati_pair_T κ qT u wm hup hwmp hwp hwm hpos
  funext x
  have e : 2 * κ + wm x - u x = (g x)⁻¹ := by simp only [wm]; ring
  change greenT κ (qT : ℝ → ℝ) x = g x
  rw [hform x, e, one_div, inv_inv]

subgoal_signatures.name: rgreenT_ode_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w → Function.Periodic w 1 → (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y) < κ → (∀ x, HasDerivAt (rgreenT κ w) (2 * (w x - κ) * rgreenT κ w x + 1) x) ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt (rgreenRT κ w) (2 * (κ - w x) * rgreenRT κ w x - 1) x) ∧ Function.Periodic (rgreenT κ w) 1 ∧ Function.Periodic (rgreenRT κ w) 1 ∧ (∀ x, 0 < rgreenT κ w x)

subgoal_signatures.name: greenT_eq_of_riccati_pair_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (q : CinfT) (wp wm : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic wp 1 → Function.Periodic wm 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, 0 < 2 * κ + wm x - wp x) → IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧ ∀ x, greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ R ≥ (0 : ℝ), ∃ κ₀ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ κ ≥ κ₀, ∀ q : CinfT, ‖ιT q‖ ≤ R → IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧ ∃ wp wm : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) wp ∧ ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) wm ∧ Function.Periodic wp 1 ∧ Function.Periodic wm 1 ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2) x) ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wp x ^ 2) ≤ 2 * WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wm x ^ 2) ≤ 2 * WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ∧ (∀ x, |wm x - wp x| ≤ κ / 2) ∧ ∀ x, greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x)

signature.name: greenT_riccati_region_T
signature.statement: ∀ R ≥ (0 : ℝ), ∃ κ₀ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ κ ≥ κ₀, ∀ q : CinfT, ‖ιT q‖ ≤ R → IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧ ∃ wp wm : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) wp ∧ ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) wm ∧ Function.Periodic wp 1 ∧ Function.Periodic wm 1 ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2) x) ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wp x ^ 2) ≤ 2 * WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wm x ^ 2) ≤ 2 * WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ∧ (∀ x, |wm x - wp x| ≤ κ / 2) ∧ ∀ x, greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro R hR
  refine ⟨max 1 (1024 * R ^ 2), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ0 q hq
  have hκ : 1 ≤ κ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hκ0
  have hκR : 1024 * R ^ 2 ≤ κ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hκ0
  have hWle : WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤ κ / 1024 := by
    have h := (weight_compare_T ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) κ hκ).2.1
    have hn : ‖((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ = ‖ιT q‖ := rfl
    have h2 : ‖ιT q‖ ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hq 2
    rw [hn] at h
    unfold WT
    linarith
  
  have pair : ∃ wp wm : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic wp 1 ∧ Function.Periodic wm 1 ∧
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2) x) ∧
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x) ∧
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wp x ^ 2) ≤ 2 * WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ∧
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wm x ^ 2) ≤ 2 * WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ∧
      ∀ x, |wm x - wp x| ≤ κ / 2 := by
    have hW := hWle
    have hκ0 : (0:ℝ) < κ := by linarith
    have hκne : κ ≠ 0 := hκ0.ne'
    set Q : ℝ → ℝ := (q : ℝ → ℝ) with hQdef
    have hQc : Continuous Q := q.2.1.continuous
    have hQp : Function.Periodic Q 1 := q.2.2
    
    have hcont : ∀ (f F : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ x, HasDerivAt f (F x) x) → Continuous f :=
      fun f F h => continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (h x).continuousAt
    have hreflD : ∀ (f F : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ y, HasDerivAt f (F y) y) → ∀ x,
        HasDerivAt (fun y => -f (-y)) (F (-x)) x := by
      intro f F hf x
      have h1 := ((hf (-x)).comp x (hasDerivAt_neg x)).neg
      refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
      ring
    have hreflP : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic f 1 →
        Function.Periodic (fun y => -f (-y)) 1 := by
      intro f hf x
      have h1 := hf (-(x + 1))
      rw [show -(x + 1) + 1 = -x by ring] at h1
      show -f (-(x + 1)) = -f (-x)
      rw [h1]
    have hR : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic g 1 →
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g (-x)) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g x := by
      intro g hg
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg]
      have h1 := hg.intervalIntegral_add_eq (-1) 0
      norm_num at h1
      simpa using h1
    have hRsq : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic f 1 →
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (-f (-x)) ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2 := by
      intro f hf
      have h2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f (-x) ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2 :=
        hR (fun y => f y ^ 2) (fun x => by show f (x + 1) ^ 2 = f x ^ 2; rw [hf x])
      simp only [neg_sq]
      exact h2
    have hdiff : ∀ (P v w : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v 1 →
        (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + P x) x) → Function.Periodic w 1 →
        (∀ x, HasDerivAt w (P x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) →
        ∀ x, |w x - v x| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y ^ 2 := by
      intro P v w hvP hvD hwP hwD x
      have hwc := hcont w _ hwD
      have hfc : Continuous (fun y => -(w y ^ 2)) := (hwc.pow 2).neg
      have hfp : Function.Periodic (fun y => -(w y ^ 2)) 1 := fun y => by
        show -(w (y + 1) ^ 2) = -(w y ^ 2)
        rw [hwP y]
      have hyP : Function.Periodic (fun y => w y - v y) 1 := fun y => by
        show w (y + 1) - v (y + 1) = w y - v y
        rw [hwP y, hvP y]
      have hyD : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => w y - v y)
          (2 * κ * (w y - v y) + -(w y ^ 2)) y := by
        intro y
        refine ((hwD y).sub (hvD y)).congr_deriv ?_
        ring
      have h : |w x - v x| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |-(w y ^ 2)| :=
        ((periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ _ hfc hfp).2 _ hyP hyD).2.1 x
      have he : (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |-(w y ^ 2)|) = ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, w y ^ 2 := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun y _ => ?_)
        simp only [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (w y))]
      rw [he] at h
      exact h
    
    obtain ⟨vp, hvpP, hvpD⟩ := (periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ Q hQc hQp).1
    have hvpW : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vp x ^ 2) =
        WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) :=
      periodic_resolvent_parseval_T κ hκ q vp hvpP hvpD
    have hWnn : 0 ≤ WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) := by
      rw [← hvpW]
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun x _ => sq_nonneg (vp x))
    have hvp2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vp x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 1024 := by
      rw [hvpW]
      exact hW
    
    obtain ⟨Qr, hQr⟩ : ∃ Qr : ℝ → ℝ, Qr = fun x => Q (-x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hQrx : ∀ x, Qr x = Q (-x) := fun x => by rw [hQr]
    have hQrc : Continuous Qr := by rw [hQr]; exact hQc.comp continuous_neg
    have hQrp : Function.Periodic Qr 1 := by
      intro x
      rw [hQrx, hQrx]
      have h1 := hQp (-(x + 1))
      rw [show -(x + 1) + 1 = -x by ring] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    obtain ⟨vr, hvrP, hvrD⟩ := (periodic_resolvent_T κ hκ Qr hQrc hQrp).1
    obtain ⟨vm, hvm⟩ : ∃ vm : ℝ → ℝ, vm = fun y => -vr (-y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hvmx : ∀ x, vm x = -vr (-x) := fun x => by rw [hvm]
    have hvmP : Function.Periodic vm 1 := by rw [hvm]; exact hreflP vr hvrP
    have hvmD : ∀ x, HasDerivAt vm (Q x - 2 * κ * vm x) x := by
      intro x
      rw [hvm]
      refine (hreflD vr _ hvrD x).congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [hQrx, neg_neg]
      ring
    have hvpc := hcont vp _ hvpD
    have hvmc := hcont vm _ hvmD
    
    have hiso : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vm x ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vp x ^ 2 := by
      have hF : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt
          (fun y => -(1 / (4 * κ)) * ((vm y - vp y) * (vm y - vp y)))
          (vm x ^ 2 - vp x ^ 2) x := by
        intro x _
        have h1 := (((hvmD x).sub (hvpD x)).mul ((hvmD x).sub (hvpD x))).const_mul
          (-(1 / (4 * κ)))
        refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        field_simp
        ring
      have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => vm x ^ 2 - vp x ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
        ((hvmc.pow 2).sub (hvpc.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
      have h2 := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hF hint
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((hvmc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
        ((hvpc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1)] at h2
      have h3 : vm 1 = vm 0 := by simpa using hvmP 0
      have h4 : vp 1 = vp 0 := by simpa using hvpP 0
      rw [h3, h4, sub_self] at h2
      linarith
    have hvmr : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vm x ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vr x ^ 2 := by
      simp only [hvmx]
      exact hRsq vr hvrP
    have hvr2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vr x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 1024 := by linarith
    
    obtain ⟨wp, hwpP, hwpD, -, hwp2'⟩ :=
      periodic_riccati_exists_T κ hκ Q vp hQc hQp hvpP hvpD hvp2
    obtain ⟨wr, hwrP, hwrD, -, hwr2'⟩ :=
      periodic_riccati_exists_T κ hκ Qr vr hQrc hQrp hvrP hvrD hvr2
    obtain ⟨wm, hwm⟩ : ∃ wm : ℝ → ℝ, wm = fun y => -wr (-y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hwmx : ∀ x, wm x = -wr (-x) := fun x => by rw [hwm]
    have hwmP : Function.Periodic wm 1 := by rw [hwm]; exact hreflP wr hwrP
    have hwmD : ∀ x, HasDerivAt wm (Q x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x := by
      intro x
      rw [hwm]
      refine (hreflD wr _ hwrD x).congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [hQrx, neg_neg]
      ring
    have hwmr : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wm x ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wr x ^ 2 := by
      simp only [hwmx]
      exact hRsq wr hwrP
    have hwpW : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wp x ^ 2) ≤
        2 * WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) := by
      rw [hvpW] at hwp2'
      linarith
    have hvrW : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vr x ^ 2) =
        WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) := by
      rw [← hvmr, hiso, hvpW]
    have hwmW : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wm x ^ 2) ≤
        2 * WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) := by
      rw [hwmr]
      rw [hvrW] at hwr2'
      linarith
    have hwp64 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wp x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 := by linarith
    have hwr64 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wr x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 := by linarith
    
    have hdp : ∀ x, |wp x - vp x| ≤ κ / 32 := by
      intro x
      have h := hdiff Q vp wp hvpP hvpD hwpP hwpD x
      linarith
    have hdm : ∀ x, |wm x - vm x| ≤ κ / 32 := by
      intro x
      have h := hdiff Qr vr wr hvrP hvrD hwrP hwrD (-x)
      rw [hwmx, hvmx, show -wr (-x) - -vr (-x) = -(wr (-x) - vr (-x)) by ring, abs_neg]
      linarith
    
    have hsob : ∀ x, |vm x - vp x| ≤ κ / 4 := by
      intro x
      have hhc : Continuous (fun t => κ * (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm t + vp t) ^ 2) :=
        (continuous_const.mul ((hvmc.sub hvpc).pow 2)).add
          (continuous_const.mul ((hvmc.add hvpc).pow 2))
      have hhp : Function.Periodic
          (fun t => κ * (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm t + vp t) ^ 2) 1 := fun t => by
        simp only [hvmP t, hvpP t]
      have hh0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ κ * (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm t + vp t) ^ 2 := fun t => by
        positivity
      have hDc : Continuous (fun t => -4 * κ * ((vm t - vp t) * (vm t + vp t))) :=
        continuous_const.mul ((hvmc.sub hvpc).mul (hvmc.add hvpc))
      have hu2c : Continuous (fun t => (vm t - vp t) ^ 2) := (hvmc.sub hvpc).pow 2
      have hu2p : Function.Periodic (fun t => (vm t - vp t) ^ 2) 1 := fun t => by
        simp only [hvmP t, hvpP t]
      have hIh : (∫ t in (x - 1)..x, κ * (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm t + vp t) ^ 2) =
          ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, κ * (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm t + vp t) ^ 2 := by
        have h1 := hhp.intervalIntegral_add_eq (x - 1) 0
        rw [show x - 1 + 1 = x by ring, zero_add] at h1
        exact h1
      have hIu : (∫ t in (x - 1)..x, (vm t - vp t) ^ 2) =
          ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 := by
        have h1 := hu2p.intervalIntegral_add_eq (x - 1) 0
        rw [show x - 1 + 1 = x by ring, zero_add] at h1
        exact h1
      set I := ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, κ * (vm t - vp t) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm t + vp t) ^ 2 with hI
      have key : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (x - 1) x, (vm x - vp x) ^ 2 ≤ (vm y - vp y) ^ 2 + I := by
        intro y hy
        have hF : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc y x, HasDerivAt (fun s => (vm s - vp s) * (vm s - vp s))
            (-4 * κ * ((vm t - vp t) * (vm t + vp t))) t := by
          intro t _
          refine (((hvmD t).sub (hvpD t)).mul ((hvmD t).sub (hvpD t))).congr_deriv ?_
          simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
          ring
        have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hF
          (hDc.intervalIntegrable y x)
        have hmon := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hy.2
          (hDc.intervalIntegrable y x)
          (hhc.intervalIntegrable y x) (fun t _ => by
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg hκ0.le (sq_nonneg ((vm t - vp t) + 2 * (vm t + vp t)))])
        have hadd := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
          (hhc.intervalIntegrable (x - 1) y) (hhc.intervalIntegrable y x)
        have hnn := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hy.1
          (fun t _ => hh0 t)
        rw [hIh] at hadd
        nlinarith
      have hmono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        (by linarith : x - 1 ≤ x)
        (f := fun _ => (vm x - vp x) ^ 2) (g := fun y => (vm y - vp y) ^ 2 + I)
        (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((hu2c.add continuous_const).intervalIntegrable _ _) key
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, intervalIntegral.integral_add
        (hu2c.intervalIntegrable _ _) (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const, hIu] at hmono
      simp only [show x - (x - 1) = (1:ℝ) by ring, one_smul] at hmono
      have hA := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) zero_le_one
        (f := fun y => (vm y - vp y) ^ 2 + (κ * (vm y - vp y) ^ 2 + 4 * κ * (vm y + vp y) ^ 2))
        (g := fun y => 12 * κ * (vm y ^ 2 + vp y ^ 2))
        ((hu2c.add hhc).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((continuous_const.mul ((hvmc.pow 2).add (hvpc.pow 2))).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (fun y _ => by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3 * κ - 1) (sq_nonneg (vm y - vp y)),
            mul_nonneg hκ0.le (sq_nonneg (vm y)), mul_nonneg hκ0.le (sq_nonneg (vp y))])
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hu2c.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (hhc.intervalIntegrable _ _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_add
        ((hvmc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _) ((hvpc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _)] at hA
      have hB : 12 * κ * ((∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vm x ^ 2) + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, vp x ^ 2) ≤
          12 * κ * (κ / 1024 + κ / 1024) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have hsq : (vm x - vp x) ^ 2 ≤ (κ / 4) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      exact abs_le_of_sq_le_sq hsq (by positivity)
    refine ⟨wp, wm, hwpP, hwmP, hwpD, hwmD, hwpW, hwmW, fun x => ?_⟩
    have e1 := abs_le.1 (hsob x)
    have e2 := abs_le.1 (hdm x)
    have e3 := abs_le.1 (hdp x)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have boot : ∀ (β : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt w ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + β * w x - w x ^ 2) x) →
      ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) w := by
    intro β w hw
    have hdw : deriv w = fun x => (q : ℝ → ℝ) x + β * w x - w x ^ 2 :=
      funext fun x => (hw x).deriv
    have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ w := fun x => (hw x).differentiableAt
    have hn : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n w := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => exact contDiff_zero.2 hdiff.continuous
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
        refine ⟨hdiff, fun h => absurd h (by simp), ?_⟩
        rw [hdw]
        have hq : ContDiff ℝ n (q : ℝ → ℝ) := contDiff_infty.1 q.2.1 n
        exact (hq.add (contDiff_const.mul ih)).sub (ih.pow 2)
    exact contDiff_infty.2 hn
  obtain ⟨wp, wm, hwpP, hwmP, hwpD, hwmD, hwp2, hwm2, hd⟩ := pair
  have hpos : ∀ x, 0 < 2 * κ + wm x - wp x := by
    intro x
    have h := (abs_le.1 (hd x)).1
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hG, hform⟩ := greenT_eq_of_riccati_pair_T κ q wp wm hwpP hwmP hwpD hwmD hpos
  have hsp := boot (2 * κ) wp hwpD
  have hsm := boot (-(2 * κ)) wm fun x => (hwmD x).congr_deriv (by ring)
  exact ⟨hG, wp, wm, hsp, hsm, hwpP, hwmP, hwpD, hwmD, hwp2, hwm2, hd, hform⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Function.Periodic f 1 → (∃ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 ∧ ∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) ∧ ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) → (∀ x, v x = -(1 - Real.exp (-(2 * κ)))⁻¹ * ∫ y in x..(x + 1), Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (y - x)) * f y) ∧ (∀ x, |v x| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |f y|) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |f x|) ^ 2 / κ

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_parseval_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q : CinfT) (v : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) = ∑' n : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / ((2 * π * n) ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n‖ ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_riccati_exists_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q v : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous q → Function.Periodic q 1 → Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + q x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → ∃ w : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic w 1 ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) ∧ 3 / 4 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, w x ^ 2) ≤ 81 / 64 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: greenT_eq_of_riccati_pair_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (q : CinfT) (wp wm : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic wp 1 → Function.Periodic wm 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, 0 < 2 * κ + wm x - wp x) → IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧ ∀ x, greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x)
