informal_problem.statement: ∀ R ≥ (0 : ℝ), ∃ ϰ₀ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ ϰ ≥ ϰ₀, ∃ L ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∃ U : CinfT → CinfT, ∀ q : CinfT, ‖ιT q‖ ≤ R → (∀ x, (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 1 / (2 * greenT ϰ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) - ϰ) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * ((U q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) ≤ L ^ 2

signature.name: good_unknown_T
signature.statement: ∀ R ≥ (0 : ℝ), ∃ ϰ₀ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ ϰ ≥ ϰ₀, ∃ L ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∃ U : CinfT → CinfT, ∀ q : CinfT, ‖ιT q‖ ≤ R → (∀ x, (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 1 / (2 * greenT ϰ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) - ϰ) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * ((U q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) ≤ L ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro R hR
  obtain ⟨κ₀, hκ₀, hs1⟩ := greenT_riccati_region_T R hR
  refine ⟨κ₀, hκ₀, fun ϰ hϰ => ?_⟩
  have hϰ1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ ϰ := le_trans hκ₀ hϰ
  have hϰpos : (0:ℝ) < ϰ := by linarith
  have hGprop : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (greenT ϰ f) ∧
      Function.Periodic (greenT ϰ f) 1 ∧ ∀ x, 0 < greenT ϰ f x := by
    intro f
    unfold greenT
    split_ifs with h
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩ := Classical.choose_spec h
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    · exact ⟨contDiff_const, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => by positivity⟩
  let U : CinfT → CinfT := fun q => ⟨fun x => 1 / (2 * greenT ϰ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) - ϰ, by
      have hG := hGprop (q : ℝ → ℝ)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (contDiff_const.div (contDiff_const.mul hG.1)
          (fun x => (mul_pos two_pos (hG.2.2 x)).ne')).sub contDiff_const
      · intro x
        simp only [hG.2.1 x]⟩
  refine ⟨1 + (4 * ϰ + 3) * R, ?_, U, fun q hq => ⟨fun x => rfl, ?_⟩⟩
  · have : 0 ≤ (4 * ϰ + 3) * R := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hR
    linarith
  obtain ⟨-, wp, wm, hwpC, hwmC, -, -, hwp', hwm', hIp, hIm, hd, hg⟩ := hs1 ϰ hϰ q hq
  have hUx : ∀ x, (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x = (wm x - wp x) / 2 := by
    intro x
    show 1 / (2 * greenT ϰ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) - ϰ = _
    rw [hg x]
    have hden : 0 < 2 * ϰ + wm x - wp x := by
      have := (abs_le.1 (hd x)).1
      linarith
    have hne : 2 * ϰ + wm x - wp x ≠ 0 := hden.ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  have hUfun : (U q : ℝ → ℝ) = fun x => (wm x - wp x) / 2 := funext hUx
  have hUd : ∀ x, deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x =
      -(ϰ * (wm x + wp x)) + (wp x ^ 2 - wm x ^ 2) / 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [hUfun]
    have h := ((hwm' x).sub (hwp' x)).div_const 2
    exact h.deriv.trans (by ring)
  have hint : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * ((U q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) =
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((-(ϰ * (wm x + wp x)) + (wp x ^ 2 - wm x ^ 2) / 2) ^ 2 +
        4 * ((wm x - wp x) / 2) ^ 2) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x _
    simp only [hUd x, hUx x]
  rw [hint]
  have hwpc := hwpC.continuous
  have hwmc := hwmC.continuous
  have hA : 0 ≤ 25 * ϰ ^ 2 / 8 + 2 := by positivity
  have hpt : ∀ x, ((-(ϰ * (wm x + wp x)) + (wp x ^ 2 - wm x ^ 2) / 2) ^ 2 +
      4 * ((wm x - wp x) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ (25 * ϰ ^ 2 / 8 + 2) * (wp x ^ 2 + wm x ^ 2) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.1 (hd x)
    generalize wp x = a at h1 h2 ⊢
    generalize wm x = b at h1 h2 ⊢
    have hc0 : 0 ≤ ϰ + (b - a) / 2 := by linarith
    have hc1 : ϰ + (b - a) / 2 ≤ 5 * ϰ / 4 := by linarith
    have hcsq : (ϰ + (b - a) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (5 * ϰ / 4) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hc0 hc1 2
    have hfac : (-(ϰ * (b + a)) + (a ^ 2 - b ^ 2) / 2) ^ 2 =
        (a + b) ^ 2 * (ϰ + (b - a) / 2) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hfac]
    have hab : (a + b) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b)]
    have hk : (a + b) ^ 2 * (ϰ + (b - a) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * (5 * ϰ / 4) ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul hab hcsq (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    nlinarith [hk, sq_nonneg (a + b)]
  have hfI : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => (-(ϰ * (wm x + wp x)) + (wp x ^ 2 - wm x ^ 2) / 2) ^ 2 +
      4 * ((wm x - wp x) / 2) ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
    apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
    fun_prop
  have hgI : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => (25 * ϰ ^ 2 / 8 + 2) * (wp x ^ 2 + wm x ^ 2))
      MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
    apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
    fun_prop
  have hWdef : WT ϰ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤
      ‖((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ ^ 2 := by
    set f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) with hfdef
    have hnorm : ‖f‖ ^ 2 = ∑' n, ‖f n‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum (p := 2) (by norm_num) f

      have h := (lp.memℓp f).summable (by norm_num : 0 < (2:ENNReal).toReal)
      simpa using h
    have hle : ∀ n : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / ((2 * π * n) ^ 2 + 4 * ϰ ^ 2)) * ‖f n‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ‖f n‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro n
      have hden : 0 < (2 * π * n) ^ 2 + 4 * ϰ ^ 2 := by positivity
      have hw : (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / ((2 * π * n) ^ 2 + 4 * ϰ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [div_le_one hden]
        nlinarith
      calc _ ≤ 1 * ‖f n‖ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw (sq_nonneg _)

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_pair_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ q : CinfT, WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → ∃ wp wm : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic wp 1 ∧ Function.Periodic wm 1 ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2) x) ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wp x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wm x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 ∧ ∀ x, |wm x - wp x| ≤ κ / 2

subgoal_signatures.name: greenT_eq_of_riccati_pair_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (q : CinfT) (wp wm : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic wp 1 → Function.Periodic wm 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, 0 < 2 * κ + wm x - wp x) → IsGreenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧ ∀ x, greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x = 1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x)

subgoal_signatures.name: good_unknown_jet_ode_T

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_L2_slope_T

subgoal_signatures.name: hm1T_hasDerivAt_of_L2_slopes_T

by
  classical
  
  have hcontOf : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) → Continuous f :=
    fun f f' hf => continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hf x).continuousAt
  
  have hR : ∀ q : CinfT, ∃ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 ∧
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * 1 * v x + (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x) ∧
      ‖ιT q‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2 := by
    intro q
    have hqc : Continuous (q : ℝ → ℝ) := q.2.1.continuous
    obtain ⟨⟨v, hvper, hv⟩, -⟩ := periodic_resolvent_T 1 le_rfl q hqc q.2.2
    refine ⟨v, hvper, hv, ?_⟩
    have hpar := periodic_resolvent_parseval_T 1 le_rfl q v hvper hv
    obtain ⟨-, h1, h2⟩ := weight_compare_T ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) 1 le_rfl
    rw [← hpar, one_pow, one_mul] at h2
    rw [← hpar] at h1

  have hIBP : ∀ (q φ φ' v : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous q → Continuous φ' → Function.Periodic φ 1 →

      (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * 1 * v x + q x) x) →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, φ x * q x) + ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (φ' x + 2 * φ x) * v x = 0 := by
    intro q φ φ' v hq hφ' hφp hvp hφ hv

    have hvc := hcontOf v _ hv

      ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun x => 2 * 1 * v x + q x).intervalIntegrable 0 1)

    have e2 : v 1 = v 0 := by simpa using hvp 0
    rw [e1, e2] at hparts

      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
        (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)]

      ring

    intro q φ φ' hφ' hφp hφ
    obtain ⟨v, hvp, hv, hnorm⟩ := hR q
    have hqc : Continuous (q : ℝ → ℝ) := q.2.1.continuous
    have hφc := hcontOf φ φ' hφ
    have hvc := hcontOf v _ hv
    have h1 := hIBP q φ φ' v hqc hφ' hφp hvp hφ hv

      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by linarith)
        (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
        (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)

      have hs0 : 0 ≤ t - x + 1 := by linarith
      have hs1 : t - x + 1 ≤ 1 := by linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (f t - (t - x + 1) * f' t),
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hs1) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + (t - x + 1)))
          (sq_nonneg (f' t)), sq_nonneg (f t)]
    have hgp : Function.Periodic (fun t => f' t ^ 2 + 4 * f t ^ 2) 1 := by
      intro t
      simp only [hfp t, hf'p t]
    have hshift := hgp.intervalIntegral_add_eq (x - 1) 0
    simp only [sub_add_cancel, zero_add] at hshift
    rw [hkey]
    linarith
  
  intro a h p hp
  obtain ⟨N, hNdef⟩ : ∃ N : ℝ,
      N = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * ((a : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hNdef]
  
  have hadiff : Differentiable ℝ (a : ℝ → ℝ) := a.2.1.differentiable (by simp)
  have ha : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (a : ℝ → ℝ) (deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) x) x :=
    fun x => (hadiff x).hasDerivAt
  have ha'c : Continuous (deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ)) := a.2.1.continuous_deriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hac : Continuous (a : ℝ → ℝ) := a.2.1.continuous
  have ha'p : Function.Periodic (deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 := by
    intro x
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => (a : ℝ → ℝ) (y + 1)) (deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) (x + 1)) x :=
      (ha (x + 1)).comp_add_const x 1
    have hfun : (fun y => (a : ℝ → ℝ) (y + 1)) = (a : ℝ → ℝ) := funext a.2.2
    rw [hfun] at h1
    exact h1.unique (ha x)
  have hasq : ∀ x, (a : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2 ≤ N := by
    intro x
    rw [hNdef]
    exact hAg _ _ ha'c a.2.2 ha'p ha x
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ N := le_trans (sq_nonneg _) (hasq 0)
  
  obtain ⟨v, hvp, hv, hX⟩ := hR p
  have hpc : Continuous (p : ℝ → ℝ) := p.2.1.continuous
  have hhc : Continuous (h : ℝ → ℝ) := h.2.1.continuous
  have hvc := hcontOf v _ hv
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : ℝ, V = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hVdef] at hX
  have hvrc : Continuous (fun y => v (-y)) := by fun_prop
  have hvrp : Function.Periodic (fun y => v (-y)) 1 := by
    intro y
    show v (-(y + 1)) = v (-y)
    rw [show -(y + 1) = -y - 1 by ring]
    exact hvp.sub_eq (-y)
  obtain ⟨⟨χ, hχp, hχ⟩, -⟩ := periodic_resolvent_T 1 le_rfl (fun y => v (-y)) hvrc hvrp
  obtain ⟨φ, hφdef⟩ : ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, φ = fun x => χ (-x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hφx : ∀ x, φ x = χ (-x) := by intro x; rw [hφdef]
  have hφd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (-2 * φ x - v x) x := by
    intro x
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => χ (-y)) ((2 * 1 * χ (-x) + v (-(-x))) * (-1)) x :=
      (hχ (-x)).comp x (hasDerivAt_neg x)
    rw [hφx x, hφdef]
    convert h1 using 1
    rw [neg_neg]
    ring
  have hφc := hcontOf φ _ hφd
  have hφp : Function.Periodic φ 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [hφx, hφx, show -(x + 1) = -x - 1 by ring]
    exact hχp.sub_eq (-x)
  have hφ'c : Continuous (fun x => -2 * φ x - v x) := by fun_prop
  have hφ'p : Function.Periodic (fun x => -2 * φ x - v x) 1 := by
    intro x
    simp only [hφp x, hvp x]
  
  have hpairV : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, φ x * (p : ℝ → ℝ) x) = V := by
    have h1 := hIBP p φ (fun x => -2 * φ x - v x) v hpc hφ'c hφp hvp hφd hv
    beta_reduce at h1
    have h2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (-2 * φ x - v x + 2 * φ x) * v x) = -V := by
      rw [hVdef, ← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
      congr 1
      funext x
      ring
    linarith
  
  have hN1φ : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (-2 * φ x - v x) ^ 2 + 4 * φ x ^ 2) = V := by
    have h3 := hE φ (fun x => -2 * φ x - v x) hφ'c hφp hφd
    beta_reduce at h3
    have h4 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (-2 * φ x - v x) ^ 2 + 4 * φ x ^ 2) =
        (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) + (-4) * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, φ x * (-2 * φ x - v x) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_add
        (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
        (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)]
      congr 1
      funext x
      ring
    rw [h4, h3, hVdef]
    ring
  have hφsq : ∀ x, φ x ^ 2 ≤ V := by
    intro x
    have := hAg φ (fun x => -2 * φ x - v x) hφ'c hφp hφ'p hφd x
    beta_reduce at this
    rw [hN1φ] at this
    exact this
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ V := le_trans (sq_nonneg _) (hφsq 0)
  
  have hψd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => φ y * (a : ℝ → ℝ) y)
      ((-2 * φ x - v x) * (a : ℝ → ℝ) x + φ x * deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) x) x :=
    fun x => (hφd x).mul (ha x)
  have hψ'c : Continuous (fun x => (-2 * φ x - v x) * (a : ℝ → ℝ) x +
      φ x * deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) x) := by fun_prop
  have hψp : Function.Periodic (fun y => φ y * (a : ℝ → ℝ) y) 1 := by
    intro x
    simp only [hφp x, a.2.2 x]
  have hmove : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, φ x * (p : ℝ → ℝ) x) =
      ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, φ x * (a : ℝ → ℝ) x * (h : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    congr 1
    funext x
    rw [hp x]
    ring
  have hs1 := hpair h (fun y => φ y * (a : ℝ → ℝ) y) _ hψ'c hψp hψd
  beta_reduce at hs1
  rw [← hmove, hpairV] at hs1
  
  have alg : ∀ α α' β β' A B : ℝ, α ^ 2 ≤ A → β ^ 2 ≤ B → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ B →
      (β' * α + β * α') ^ 2 + 4 * (β * α) ^ 2 ≤
        2 * B * (α' ^ 2 + 4 * α ^ 2) + 2 * A * (β' ^ 2 + 4 * β ^ 2) := by
    intro α α' β β' A B hA hB hA0 hB0
    have k1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA (sq_nonneg β')
    have k2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB (sq_nonneg α')
    have k3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA (sq_nonneg β)
    have k4 := mul_nonneg hB0 (sq_nonneg α)
    have k5 := mul_nonneg hA0 (sq_nonneg β)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (β' * α - β * α')]
  have hs4 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((-2 * φ x - v x) * (a : ℝ → ℝ) x + φ x * deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2
      + 4 * (φ x * (a : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) ≤ 4 * N * V := by
    have hmono : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((-2 * φ x - v x) * (a : ℝ → ℝ) x +
        φ x * deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * (φ x * (a : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) ≤
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * V * (deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2 + 4 * (a : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2) +
          2 * N * ((-2 * φ x - v x) ^ 2 + 4 * φ x ^ 2)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one
        (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
        (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
      intro x _
      exact alg _ _ _ _ N V (hasq x) (hφsq x) hN0 hV0
    have heq : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * V * (deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2 + 4 * (a : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2) +
          2 * N * ((-2 * φ x - v x) ^ 2 + 4 * φ x ^ 2))) = 2 * V * N + 2 * N * V := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)
        (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hN1φ, ← hNdef]
    linarith
  
  have hVV : V ^ 2 ≤ 4 * N * V * ‖ιT h‖ ^ 2 :=
    le_trans hs1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs4 (sq_nonneg _))
  have hY0 := norm_nonneg (ιT h)
  have hX0 := norm_nonneg (ιT p)
  have hsN := Real.sq_sqrt hN0
  have hsN0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg N
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hV0 with hV | hV
  · have hX2 : ‖ιT p‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by rw [hX, ← hV]
    have hX' : ‖ιT p‖ = 0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num)).1 hX2
    rw [hX']
    positivity
  · have hle : V ≤ 4 * N * ‖ιT h‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hc : (2 * Real.sqrt N * ‖ιT h‖) ^ 2 = 4 * N * ‖ιT h‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hsN]
      norm_num
    have hsq : ‖ιT p‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt N * ‖ιT h‖) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hX, hc]
      exact hle
    have hfin := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq hX0, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at hfin

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Function.Periodic f 1 → (∃ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 ∧ ∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) ∧ ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) → (∀ x, v x = -(1 - Real.exp (-(2 * κ)))⁻¹ * ∫ y in x..(x + 1), Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (y - x)) * f y) ∧ (∀ x, |v x| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |f y|) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |f x|) ^ 2 / κ

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_parseval_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q : CinfT) (v : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) = ∑' n : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / ((2 * π * n) ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n‖ ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: cauchy_schwarz_unit_interval
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x * g x) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g x ^ 2)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ q p E : CinfT, ∀ h : ℝ, WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → WT κ ((ιT p : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → (∀ x : ℝ, (E : ℝ → ℝ) x = (p : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - h * kdvRHS (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (greenT κ (p : ℝ → ℝ) x - greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - h * (-2 * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x * greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x * deriv (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x)) ^ 2) ≤ (2 * ‖ιT E‖ + 15 * κ * ‖ιT p - ιT q‖ ^ 2) ^ 2

signature.name: green_first_variation_T
signature.statement: ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ q p E : CinfT, ∀ h : ℝ, WT κ ((ιT q : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → WT κ ((ιT p : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) ≤ κ / 1024 → (∀ x : ℝ, (E : ℝ → ℝ) x = (p : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - h * kdvRHS (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (greenT κ (p : ℝ → ℝ) x - greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - h * (-2 * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x * greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x * deriv (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x)) ^ 2) ≤ (2 * ‖ιT E‖ + 15 * κ * ‖ιT p - ιT q‖ ^ 2) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ q p E h hq hp hE
  
  obtain ⟨wp, wm, hwpP, hwmP, hwp, hwm, hwp2, hwm2, hwA⟩ := riccati_pair_T κ hκ q hq
  obtain ⟨up, um, hupP, humP, hup, hum, hup2, hum2, huB⟩ := riccati_pair_T κ hκ p hp
  have cont_of : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) → Continuous f :=
    fun f f' hf => continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hf x).continuousAt
  have hwpc : Continuous wp := cont_of _ _ hwp
  have hwmc : Continuous wm := cont_of _ _ hwm
  have hupc : Continuous up := cont_of _ _ hup
  have humc : Continuous um := cont_of _ _ hum
  
  have hApos : ∀ x, 3 / 2 ≤ 2 * κ + wm x - wp x := fun x => by
    have := (abs_le.1 (hwA x)).1; linarith
  have hBpos : ∀ x, 3 / 2 ≤ 2 * κ + um x - up x := fun x => by
    have := (abs_le.1 (huB x)).1; linarith
  
  have hGq := (greenT_eq_of_riccati_pair_T κ q wp wm hwpP hwmP hwp hwm
    (fun x => by linarith [hApos x])).2
  have hGp := (greenT_eq_of_riccati_pair_T κ p up um hupP humP hup hum
    (fun x => by linarith [hBpos x])).2
  have hGqf : greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) = fun x => 1 / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x) := funext hGq
  
  have hdG : ∀ x, deriv (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x = (wp x + wm x) / (2 * κ + wm x - wp x) := by
    intro x
    have hA : HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * κ + wm y - wp y)
        (((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) - ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2)) x :=
      ((hwm x).const_add (2 * κ)).sub (hwp x)
    have hne : 2 * κ + wm x - wp x ≠ 0 := by linarith [hApos x]
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (greenT κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ((0 * (2 * κ + wm x - wp x) - 1 *
        (((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) - ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp x - wp x ^ 2))) /
        (2 * κ + wm x - wp x) ^ 2) x := by
      rw [hGqf]; exact (hasDerivAt_const x (1:ℝ)).div hA hne
    rw [h1.deriv]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hpd : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic f 1 → Function.Periodic (deriv f) 1 := by
    intro f hf x
    have e1 : (fun y => f (y + 1)) = f := funext hf
    rw [← deriv_comp_add_const, e1]
  have hit2 : iteratedDeriv 2 (q : ℝ → ℝ) = deriv (deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ)) := by
    simp [iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
  
  have hs1 : ∀ (m : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ x, HasDerivAt m (κ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - m x ^ 2) x) → ∀ x,
      HasDerivAt (fun y => -iteratedDeriv 2 (q : ℝ → ℝ) y + 2 * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) y * m y +
        (2 * (q : ℝ → ℝ) y - 4 * κ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ → ℝ) y - m y ^ 2))
      (-2 * m x * (-iteratedDeriv 2 (q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x * m x +
        (2 * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 4 * κ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ → ℝ) x - m x ^ 2)) +
        kdvRHS (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x := by
    intro m hm x
    have hsd : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f →
        ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv f) :=
      fun f hf => (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.1 hf).2
    have hdiff : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → ∀ x,
        HasDerivAt f (deriv f x) x :=
      fun f hf x => ((hf.differentiable (by simp)) x).hasDerivAt
    have hq0 : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (q : ℝ → ℝ) := q.2.1
    have hit3 : iteratedDeriv 3 (q : ℝ → ℝ) = deriv (deriv (deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ))) := by
      simp [iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
    have e1 := hdiff _ hq0 x
    have e2 := hdiff _ (hsd _ hq0) x
    have e3 := hdiff _ (hsd _ (hsd _ hq0)) x
    have hZ := (e3.neg.add ((e2.const_mul 2).mul (hm x))).add
      (((e1.const_mul 2).sub_const (4 * κ ^ 2)).mul
        ((e1.const_add (κ ^ 2)).sub ((hm x).mul (hm x))))
    rw [hit2]
    convert hZ using 1
    · funext y
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.neg_apply]
      ring
    · simp only [kdvRHS, hit3, Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.neg_apply]
      ring
  obtain ⟨Zp, hZpdef⟩ : ∃ Z : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ y, Z y = -iteratedDeriv 2 (q : ℝ → ℝ) y +
      2 * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) y * (wp y - κ) +
      (2 * (q : ℝ → ℝ) y - 4 * κ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ → ℝ) y - (wp y - κ) ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, fun y => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Zm, hZmdef⟩ : ∃ Z : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ y, Z y = -iteratedDeriv 2 (q : ℝ → ℝ) y +
      2 * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) y * (wm y + κ) +
      (2 * (q : ℝ → ℝ) y - 4 * κ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ → ℝ) y - (wm y + κ) ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, fun y => rfl⟩
  have hZp : ∀ x, HasDerivAt Zp ((2 * κ - 2 * wp x) * Zp x + kdvRHS (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x := by
    intro x
    have hm : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => wp y - κ) (κ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ → ℝ) y - (wp y - κ) ^ 2) y :=
      fun y => ((hwp y).sub_const κ).congr_deriv (by ring)
    have h1 := hs1 (fun y => wp y - κ) hm x
    have hfun : Zp = fun y => -iteratedDeriv 2 (q : ℝ → ℝ) y +
        2 * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) y * (wp y - κ) +
        (2 * (q : ℝ → ℝ) y - 4 * κ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ → ℝ) y - (wp y - κ) ^ 2) :=
      funext hZpdef
    have h2 : HasDerivAt Zp (-2 * (wp x - κ) * Zp x + kdvRHS (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x := by
      rw [hfun]; exact h1
    exact h2.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hZm : ∀ x, HasDerivAt Zm ((-2 * κ - 2 * wm x) * Zm x + kdvRHS (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x := by
    intro x
    have hm : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => wm y + κ) (κ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ → ℝ) y - (wm y + κ) ^ 2) y :=
      fun y => ((hwm y).add_const κ).congr_deriv (by ring)
    have h1 := hs1 (fun y => wm y + κ) hm x
    have hfun : Zm = fun y => -iteratedDeriv 2 (q : ℝ → ℝ) y +
        2 * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) y * (wm y + κ) +
        (2 * (q : ℝ → ℝ) y - 4 * κ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ → ℝ) y - (wm y + κ) ^ 2) :=
      funext hZmdef
    have h2 : HasDerivAt Zm (-2 * (wm x + κ) * Zm x + kdvRHS (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) x := by
      rw [hfun]; exact h1
    exact h2.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hZpP : Function.Periodic Zp 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [hZpdef, hZpdef, hit2, hpd _ (hpd _ q.2.2) x, hpd _ q.2.2 x, q.2.2 x, hwpP x]
  have hZmP : Function.Periodic Zm 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [hZmdef, hZmdef, hit2, hpd _ (hpd _ q.2.2) x, hpd _ q.2.2 x, q.2.2 x, hwmP x]
  have hZpc : Continuous Zp := cont_of _ _ hZp
  have hZmc : Continuous Zm := cont_of _ _ hZm
  
  have hyp := riccati_variation_bound_plus_T κ hκ q p E h wp up Zp hwpP hupP hZpP hwp hup hZp
    hwp2 hup2 hE
  have hym := riccati_variation_bound_minus_T κ hκ q p E h wm um Zm hwmP humP hZmP hwm hum hZm
    hwm2 hum2 hE
  have hsup := riccati_pair_diff_sup_T κ hκ q p wp wm up um hwpP hwmP hupP humP hwp hwm hup hum
    hwp2 hwm2 hup2 hum2

subgoal_signatures.name: periodic_resolvent_T
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Function.Periodic f 1 → (∃ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 ∧ ∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) ∧ ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic v 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt v (2 * κ * v x + f x) x) → (∀ x, v x = -(1 - Real.exp (-(2 * κ)))⁻¹ * ∫ y in x..(x + 1), Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (y - x)) * f y) ∧ (∀ x, |v x| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, |f y|) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, f x ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, v x ^ 2) ≤ (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, |f x|) ^ 2 / κ

informal_problem.statement: ∀ U : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) U → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => kdvRHS (fun y => U (p.1, y)) p.2) ∧ ∀ t x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => kdvRHS (fun y => U (s, y)) x) (-(iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => fderiv ℝ U (t, y) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) x) + 6 * deriv (fun y => U (t, y) * fderiv ℝ U (t, y) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) x) t

signature.name: kdvRHS_jointly_smooth_T
signature.statement: ∀ U : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) U → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => kdvRHS (fun y => U (p.1, y)) p.2) ∧ ∀ t x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => kdvRHS (fun y => U (s, y)) x) (-(iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => fderiv ℝ U (t, y) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) x) + 6 * deriv (fun y => U (t, y) * fderiv ℝ U (t, y) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) x) t

proof.tactics:
by
  intro U hU
  have hpart : ∀ V : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) V → ∀ w : ℝ × ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p => fderiv ℝ V p w) := fun V hV w =>
    (hV.fderiv_right (by exact_mod_cast le_rfl)).clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hlineT : ∀ V : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) V → ∀ ρ x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => V (σ, x)) (fderiv ℝ V (ρ, x) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) ρ := by
    intro V hV ρ x
    have hd : Differentiable ℝ V := hV.differentiable (by simp)
    exact (hd (ρ, x)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt ρ
      ((hasDerivAt_id' ρ).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const ρ x))
  have hlineX : ∀ V : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) V → ∀ ρ x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => V (ρ, y)) (fderiv ℝ V (ρ, x) ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) x := by
    intro V hV ρ x
    have hd : Differentiable ℝ V := hV.differentiable (by simp)
    exact (hd (ρ, x)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt x
      ((hasDerivAt_const x ρ).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' x))
  have hsymm : ∀ W : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) W → ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ,
      fderiv ℝ (fun q => fderiv ℝ W q ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ))) p ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun q => fderiv ℝ W q ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) p ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) := by
    intro W hW p
    have hc : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fderiv ℝ W) :=
      hW.fderiv_right (by exact_mod_cast le_rfl)
    have hcd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ W) p := (hc.differentiable (by simp)) p
    have key : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ, fderiv ℝ (fun q => fderiv ℝ W q v) p =
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ W) p).flip v := by
      intro v
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hcd (differentiableAt_const v)]
      simp
    rw [key, key, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
    have hs : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ W p := hW.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
    exact hs _ _
  have hit3 : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, iteratedDeriv 3 f = deriv (deriv (deriv f)) := fun f => by
    simp [iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
  set V1 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ U p ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) with hV1def
  set V2 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ V1 p ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) with hV2def
  set V3 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ V2 p ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) with hV3def
  set K : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ U p ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) with hKdef
  set W1 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ K p ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) with hW1def
  set W2 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ W1 p ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) with hW2def
  set W3 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ W2 p ((0:ℝ), (1:ℝ)) with hW3def
  have hV1s : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) V1 := hpart U hU _
  have hV2s : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) V2 := hpart V1 hV1s _
  have hV3s : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) V3 := hpart V2 hV2s _
  have hKs : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) K := hpart U hU _
  have hW1s : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) W1 := hpart K hKs _
  have hW2s : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) W2 := hpart W1 hW1s _
  have hform : ∀ t x : ℝ, kdvRHS (fun y => U (t, y)) x =
      -(V3 (t, x)) + 6 * U (t, x) * V1 (t, x) := by
    intro t x
    have d1 : deriv (fun y => U (t, y)) = fun y => V1 (t, y) :=
      funext fun y => (hlineX U hU t y).deriv
    have d2 : deriv (fun y => V1 (t, y)) = fun y => V2 (t, y) :=
      funext fun y => (hlineX V1 hV1s t y).deriv
    have d3 : deriv (fun y => V2 (t, y)) = fun y => V3 (t, y) :=
      funext fun y => (hlineX V2 hV2s t y).deriv
    unfold kdvRHS
    rw [hit3, d1, d2, d3]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have e : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => kdvRHS (fun y => U (p.1, y)) p.2) =
        fun p => -(V3 p) + 6 * U p * V1 p := by
      funext p
      exact hform p.1 p.2
    rw [e]
    exact hV3s.neg.add ((contDiff_const.mul hU).mul hV1s)
  · intro t x
    have hc1 : ∀ p, fderiv ℝ V1 p ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) = W1 p := fun p => hsymm U hU p
    have hc1f : (fun p => fderiv ℝ V1 p ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) = W1 := funext hc1
    have hc2 : ∀ p, fderiv ℝ V2 p ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) = W2 p := by
      intro p
      have h := hsymm V1 hV1s p
      rw [hc1f] at h
      exact h
    have hc2f : (fun p => fderiv ℝ V2 p ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) = W2 := funext hc2
    have hc3 : ∀ p, fderiv ℝ V3 p ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) = W3 p := by
      intro p
      have h := hsymm V2 hV2s p
      rw [hc2f] at h
      exact h
    have hT3 := hlineT V3 hV3s t x
    have hTU := hlineT U hU t x
    have hT1 := hlineT V1 hV1s t x
    have hd := hT3.neg.add ((hTU.const_mul 6).mul hT1)
    have e : (fun s => kdvRHS (fun y => U (s, y)) x) =
        fun s => -(V3 (s, x)) + 6 * U (s, x) * V1 (s, x) := funext fun s => hform s x
    have i3 : iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => fderiv ℝ U (t, y) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) x = W3 (t, x) := by
      have d1 : deriv (fun y => K (t, y)) = fun y => W1 (t, y) :=
        funext fun y => (hlineX K hKs t y).deriv
      have d2 : deriv (fun y => W1 (t, y)) = fun y => W2 (t, y) :=
        funext fun y => (hlineX W1 hW1s t y).deriv
      have d3 : deriv (fun y => W2 (t, y)) = fun y => W3 (t, y) :=
        funext fun y => (hlineX W2 hW2s t y).deriv
      rw [hit3]
      show deriv (deriv (deriv (fun y => K (t, y)))) x = W3 (t, x)
      rw [d1, d2, d3]
    have dUK : deriv (fun y => U (t, y) * fderiv ℝ U (t, y) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ))) x =
        V1 (t, x) * K (t, x) + U (t, x) * W1 (t, x) :=
      ((hlineX U hU t x).mul (hlineX K hKs t x)).deriv
    rw [e, i3, dUK]
    refine hd.congr_deriv ?_
    rw [hc1 (t, x), hc3 (t, x)]
    show -(W3 (t, x)) + (6 * fderiv ℝ U (t, x) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) * V1 (t, x) + 6 * U (t, x) * W1 (t, x)) =
      -(W3 (t, x)) + 6 * (V1 (t, x) * fderiv ℝ U (t, x) ((1:ℝ), (0:ℝ)) + U (t, x) * W1 (t, x))
    ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (q g : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) q → IsGreenT κ q g → ∀ x : ℝ, -(iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => 16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv g y + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv q y) x) + 6 * deriv (fun y => q y * (16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv g y + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv q y)) x = 16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (fun y => -2 * deriv q y * g y + 2 * q y * deriv g y - 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv g y) x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (kdvRHS q) x

signature.name: green_kdv_commutator_T
signature.statement: ∀ (κ : ℝ) (q g : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) q → IsGreenT κ q g → ∀ x : ℝ, -(iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => 16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv g y + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv q y) x) + 6 * deriv (fun y => q y * (16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv g y + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv q y)) x = 16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (fun y => -2 * deriv q y * g y + 2 * q y * deriv g y - 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv g y) x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (kdvRHS q) x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ q g hq hG x
  obtain ⟨hg, -, hpos, hFI⟩ := hG
  have hD : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f →
      Differentiable ℝ f ∧ ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv f) :=
    fun f hf => contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.1 hf
  obtain ⟨dg0, hg1⟩ := hD g hg
  obtain ⟨dg1, hg2⟩ := hD _ hg1
  obtain ⟨dg2, hg3⟩ := hD _ hg2
  obtain ⟨dg3, -⟩ := hD _ hg3
  obtain ⟨dq0, hq1⟩ := hD q hq
  obtain ⟨dq1, hq2⟩ := hD _ hq1
  obtain ⟨dq2, hq3⟩ := hD _ hq2
  obtain ⟨dq3, -⟩ := hD _ hq3
  have i2 : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, iteratedDeriv 2 f = deriv (deriv f) := fun f => by
    simp [iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
  have i3 : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, iteratedDeriv 3 f = deriv (deriv (deriv f)) := fun f => by
    simp [iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
  
  have s1 : ∀ y, deriv (deriv (deriv g)) y =
      2 * deriv q y * g y + 4 * (κ ^ 2 + q y) * deriv g y := by
    intro y
    have hΦ : HasDerivAt (fun y => deriv g y ^ 2 - 2 * g y * deriv (deriv g) y +
        4 * (κ ^ 2 + q y) * g y ^ 2) 0 y := by
      have e : (fun y => deriv g y ^ 2 - 2 * g y * deriv (deriv g) y +
          4 * (κ ^ 2 + q y) * g y ^ 2) = fun _ => (1:ℝ) := by
        funext z
        rw [← i2]
        exact hFI z
      rw [e]
      exact hasDerivAt_const _ _
    have a0 := (dg0 y).hasDerivAt
    have a1 := (dg1 y).hasDerivAt
    have a2 := (dg2 y).hasDerivAt
    have b0 := (dq0 y).hasDerivAt
    have hΦ' := ((a1.pow 2).sub ((a0.const_mul 2).mul a2)).add
      ((((hasDerivAt_const y (κ ^ 2)).add b0).const_mul 4).mul (a0.pow 2))
    have hu := hΦ.unique hΦ'
    norm_num at hu
    have hgy := hpos y
    have h2 : (2 * g y) * deriv (deriv (deriv g)) y =
        (2 * g y) * (2 * deriv q y * g y + 4 * (κ ^ 2 + q y) * deriv g y) := by
      linear_combination hu
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by positivity) h2
  
  have s1f : deriv (deriv (deriv g)) =
      fun y => 2 * deriv q y * g y + 4 * (κ ^ 2 + q y) * deriv g y := funext s1
  have e2 : deriv (deriv (deriv (deriv g))) x = 2 * deriv (deriv q) x * g x +
      6 * deriv q x * deriv g x + 4 * (κ ^ 2 + q x) * deriv (deriv g) x := by
    rw [s1f]
    refine ((((dq1 x).hasDerivAt.const_mul 2).mul (dg0 x).hasDerivAt).add
      ((((hasDerivAt_const x (κ ^ 2)).add (dq0 x).hasDerivAt).const_mul 4).mul
        (dg1 x).hasDerivAt)).deriv.trans ?_
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    ring
  
  have kf : kdvRHS q = fun y => -(deriv (deriv (deriv q)) y) + 6 * q y * deriv q y := by
    funext y
    unfold kdvRHS
    rw [i3]
  have e3 : deriv (kdvRHS q) x = -(deriv (deriv (deriv (deriv q))) x) +
      6 * deriv q x ^ 2 + 6 * q x * deriv (deriv q) x := by
    rw [kf]
    refine ((dq3 x).hasDerivAt.neg.add
      (((dq0 x).hasDerivAt.const_mul 6).mul (dq1 x).hasDerivAt)).deriv.trans ?_
    ring
  
  have lin : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ), Differentiable ℝ f₁ → Differentiable ℝ f₂ →
      deriv (fun y => a * f₁ y + b * f₂ y) = fun y => a * deriv f₁ y + b * deriv f₂ y := by
    intro a b f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂
    funext y
    exact (((h₁ y).hasDerivAt.const_mul a).add ((h₂ y).hasDerivAt.const_mul b)).deriv
  have e4 : iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => 16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv g y + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv q y) x =
      16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (deriv (deriv (deriv g))) x +
        4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (deriv (deriv q))) x := by
    rw [i3, lin (16 * κ ^ 5) (4 * κ ^ 2) _ _ dg1 dq1, lin (16 * κ ^ 5) (4 * κ ^ 2) _ _ dg2 dq2,
      lin (16 * κ ^ 5) (4 * κ ^ 2) _ _ dg3 dq3]
  
  have eP : deriv (fun y => q y * (16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv g y + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv q y)) x =
      deriv q x * (16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv g x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv q x) +
        q x * (16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (deriv g) x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (deriv q) x) := by
    refine ((dq0 x).hasDerivAt.mul (((dg1 x).hasDerivAt.const_mul (16 * κ ^ 5)).add
      ((dq1 x).hasDerivAt.const_mul (4 * κ ^ 2)))).deriv.trans ?_
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  have eZ : deriv (fun y => -2 * deriv q y * g y + 2 * q y * deriv g y -
      4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv g y) x =
      -2 * deriv (deriv q) x * g x + -2 * deriv q x * deriv g x +
        (2 * deriv q x * deriv g x + 2 * q x * deriv (deriv g) x) -
          4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (deriv g) x := by
    refine (((((dq1 x).hasDerivAt.const_mul (-2)).mul (dg0 x).hasDerivAt).add
      (((dq0 x).hasDerivAt.const_mul 2).mul (dg1 x).hasDerivAt)).sub
        ((dg1 x).hasDerivAt.const_mul (4 * κ ^ 2))).deriv.trans ?_
    ring
  
  rw [e4, eP, eZ, e3, e2]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (q qh : CinfT) (h : ℝ), (∀ x, (qh : ℝ → ℝ) x = (q : ℝ → ℝ) (x + h)) → (∀ n : ℤ, toHm1T qh n = Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) * toHm1T q n) ∧ ‖ιT qh - ιT q‖ ^ 2 = translateDiffSqT (toHm1T q) h

signature.name: toHm1T_translate_T
signature.statement: ∀ (q qh : CinfT) (h : ℝ), (∀ x, (qh : ℝ → ℝ) x = (q : ℝ → ℝ) (x + h)) → (∀ n : ℤ, toHm1T qh n = Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) * toHm1T q n) ∧ ‖ιT qh - ιT q‖ ^ 2 = translateDiffSqT (toHm1T q) h

proof.tactics:
by
  intro q qh h hqh
  have hqper : Function.Periodic (q : ℝ → ℝ) 1 := q.2.2
  have hF : ∀ n : ℤ, fourierCircle (qh : ℝ → ℝ) n =
      Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) * fourierCircle (q : ℝ → ℝ) n := by
    intro n
    set E := Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) with hE
    set g : ℝ → ℂ := fun y =>
      Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) * ((q : ℝ → ℝ) y : ℂ) with hgdef
    have hg : Function.Periodic g 1 := by
      intro y
      simp only [hgdef]
      rw [hqper y]
      congr 1
      have harg : -(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((y + 1 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) * I =
          -(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I + ((-n : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * π * I) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [harg, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
    have hpt : ∀ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) *
        ((qh : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ) = E * g (x + h) := by
      intro x
      simp only [hgdef, hE]
      rw [hqh x, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 2
      push_cast; ring
    have hL : fourierCircle (qh : ℝ → ℝ) n = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, E * g (x + h) := by
      unfold fourierCircle
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => hpt x)
    have hR : fourierCircle (q : ℝ → ℝ) n = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, g x := rfl
    rw [hL, hR, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right g h,
      zero_add, add_comm 1 h, hg.intervalIntegral_add_eq h 0, zero_add]
  have hE1 : ∀ n : ℤ, ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I)‖ = 1 := by
    intro n
    rw [show ((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I = (((2 * π * n * h : ℝ)) : ℂ) * I by
      push_cast; ring]
    exact Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I _
  have hprof : ∀ n : ℤ, hm1ProfileT (qh : ℝ → ℝ) n =
      Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) * hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ) n := by
    intro n
    unfold hm1ProfileT
    rw [hF n]
    ring
  have hnorm : ∀ n : ℤ, ‖hm1ProfileT (qh : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ = ‖hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ := by
    intro n
    rw [hprof n, norm_mul, hE1 n, one_mul]
  have h2pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ENNReal).toReal := by norm_num
  have hmem : Memℓp (hm1ProfileT (qh : ℝ → ℝ)) 2 ↔ Memℓp (hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ)) 2 := by
    rw [memℓp_gen_iff h2pos, memℓp_gen_iff h2pos]
    simp only [hnorm]
  have hA : ∀ n : ℤ, toHm1T qh n =
      Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) * toHm1T q n := by
    intro n
    unfold toHm1T
    by_cases hm : Memℓp (hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ)) 2
    · rw [dif_pos hm, dif_pos (hmem.2 hm)]
      exact hprof n
    · rw [dif_neg hm, dif_neg (fun h' => hm (hmem.1 h'))]
      simp
  refine ⟨hA, ?_⟩
  have hnorm2 : ∀ f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, ‖f‖ ^ 2 = ∑' n : ℤ, ‖f n‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro f
    have := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum h2pos f
    simpa [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two] using this
  have hco : ‖ιT qh - ιT q‖ = ‖toHm1T qh - toHm1T q‖ := rfl
  rw [hco, hnorm2]
  unfold translateDiffSqT
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  rw [lp.coeFn_sub, Pi.sub_apply, hA n]
  congr 2
  ring

signature.statement: ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ q p : CinfT, ∀ wp₁ wm₁ wp₂ wm₂ : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic wp₁ 1 → Function.Periodic wm₁ 1 → Function.Periodic wp₂ 1 → Function.Periodic wm₂ 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp₁ ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp₁ x - wp₁ x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm₁ ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm₁ x - wm₁ x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp₂ ((p : ℝ → ℝ) x + 2 * κ * wp₂ x - wp₂ x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm₂ ((p : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * κ * wm₂ x - wm₂ x ^ 2) x) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wp₁ x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wm₁ x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wp₂ x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, wm₂ x ^ 2) ≤ κ / 64 → (∀ x, |wm₁ x - wp₁ x| ≤ κ / 2) → ∀ d : CinfT, (∀ x, (d : ℝ → ℝ) x = ((wm₁ x - wp₁ x) - (wm₂ x - wp₂ x)) / 2) → (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (deriv (d : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * ((d : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) ≤ 64 * κ ^ 2 * ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ q p wp₁ wm₁ wp₂ wm₂ hpp₁ hpm₁ hpp₂ hpm₂ hdp₁ hdm₁ hdp₂ hdm₂ hip₁ him₁ hip₂ him₂
    hb d hd
  have hκ0 : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκne : κ ≠ 0 := hκ0.ne'
  
  have hsq : ∀ a b : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous a → Continuous b →
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (a x + b x) ^ 2) ≤
        2 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, a x ^ 2) + 2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, b x ^ 2 := by
    intro a b ha hb'
    have h1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (a x + b x) ^ 2) ≤
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * a x ^ 2 + 2 * b x ^ 2) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one
      · exact ((ha.add hb').pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
      · exact ((continuous_const.mul (ha.pow 2)).add
          (continuous_const.mul (hb'.pow 2))).intervalIntegrable _ _
      · intro x _
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a x - b x)]
    have h2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2 * a x ^ 2 + 2 * b x ^ 2)) =
        2 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, a x ^ 2) + 2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, b x ^ 2 := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      · exact (continuous_const.mul (ha.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable _ _
      · exact (continuous_const.mul (hb'.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable _ _
    linarith
  
  have hagmon : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic f 1 → Function.Periodic f' 1 →
      Continuous f' → (∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x : ℝ,
      f x ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / t) * (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, f y ^ 2) + t * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, f' y ^ 2 := by
    intro f f' hf hf' hc hder t ht x
    have hfc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun y => (hder y).continuousAt
    obtain ⟨x₀, _, hx₀min⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn
      (Set.nonempty_Icc.2 (zero_le_one' ℝ)) (hfc.pow 2).continuousOn
    have hmin : f x₀ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, f y ^ 2 := by
      have h : (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, f x₀ ^ 2) ≤ ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, f y ^ 2 := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one
        · exact intervalIntegrable_const
        · exact (hfc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
        · intro y hy
          exact isMinOn_iff.1 hx₀min y hy
      simpa using h
    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ : ∃ x', x' = x₀ + Int.fract (x - x₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hx'1 : x₀ ≤ x' := by have := Int.fract_nonneg (x - x₀); linarith
    have hx'2 : x' ≤ x₀ + 1 := by have := Int.fract_lt_one (x - x₀); linarith
    have hfx : f x' = f x := by
      have e : x' = x - (⌊x - x₀⌋ : ℝ) * 1 := by
        rw [hx']; unfold Int.fract; ring
      rw [e, hf.sub_int_mul_eq]
    have hg : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => f y ^ 2) (2 * f y * f' y) y := by
      intro y
      have h := (hder y).pow 2
      convert h using 1
      norm_num
    have hcont2 : Continuous (fun y => 2 * f y * f' y) := (continuous_const.mul hfc).mul hc
    have hftc : (∫ y in x₀..x', 2 * f y * f' y) = f x' ^ 2 - f x₀ ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun y _ => hg y)
        (hcont2.intervalIntegrable _ _)
    have hcont_h : Continuous (fun y => f y ^ 2 / t + t * f' y ^ 2) :=
      ((hfc.pow 2).div_const t).add (continuous_const.mul (hc.pow 2))
    have hyoung : (∫ y in x₀..x', 2 * f y * f' y) ≤
        ∫ y in x₀..x', (f y ^ 2 / t + t * f' y ^ 2) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hx'1 (hcont2.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (hcont_h.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      intro y _
      have key : f y ^ 2 / t + t * f' y ^ 2 - 2 * f y * f' y = (f y - t * f' y) ^ 2 / t := by
        field_simp
        ring
      have : 0 ≤ (f y - t * f' y) ^ 2 / t := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) ht.le
      linarith
    have henl : (∫ y in x₀..x', (f y ^ 2 / t + t * f' y ^ 2)) ≤
        ∫ y in x₀..(x₀ + 1), (f y ^ 2 / t + t * f' y ^ 2) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_interval le_rfl hx'1 hx'2
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y =>
          add_nonneg (div_nonneg (sq_nonneg (f y)) ht.le) (mul_nonneg ht.le (sq_nonneg (f' y))))
      · exact hcont_h.intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hper_h : Function.Periodic (fun y => f y ^ 2 / t + t * f' y ^ 2) 1 := by
      intro y
      simp only [hf y, hf' y]
    have hshift : (∫ y in x₀..(x₀ + 1), (f y ^ 2 / t + t * f' y ^ 2)) =
        ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, (f y ^ 2 / t + t * f' y ^ 2) := by
      have h := hper_h.intervalIntegral_add_eq x₀ 0
      rw [zero_add] at h
      exact h
    have hsplit : (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, (f y ^ 2 / t + t * f' y ^ 2)) =
        (1 / t) * (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, f y ^ 2) + t * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, f' y ^ 2 := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (((hfc.pow 2).div_const t).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((continuous_const.mul (hc.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable _ _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_div, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      ring
    rw [← hfx]
    have e : (1 + 1 / t) * (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, f y ^ 2) + t * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, f' y ^ 2 =
        (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, f y ^ 2) +
          ((1 / t) * (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, f y ^ 2) + t * ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..1, f' y ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith
  
  have cont : ∀ w g : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, HasDerivAt w (g x) x) → Continuous w :=
    fun w g h => continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (h x).continuousAt
  have cp₁ : Continuous wp₁ := cont _ _ hdp₁
  have cm₁ : Continuous wm₁ := cont _ _ hdm₁
  have cp₂ : Continuous wp₂ := cont _ _ hdp₂
  have cm₂ : Continuous wm₂ := cont _ _ hdm₂
  have cd : Continuous (d : ℝ → ℝ) := d.2.1.continuous
  have pd : Function.Periodic (d : ℝ → ℝ) 1 := d.2.2
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ x, D x = -(1 / 2) * ((wm₁ x - wm₂ x) + (wp₁ x - wp₂ x)) *
      (2 * κ + wm₁ x - wp₁ x) - (wm₂ x + wp₂ x) * (d : ℝ → ℝ) x := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hDfun : D = fun x => -(1 / 2) * ((wm₁ x - wm₂ x) + (wp₁ x - wp₂ x)) *
      (2 * κ + wm₁ x - wp₁ x) - (wm₂ x + wp₂ x) * (d : ℝ → ℝ) x := funext hD
  have cD : Continuous D := by rw [hDfun]; fun_prop
  have pD : Function.Periodic D 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [hD, hD, hpp₁ x, hpm₁ x, hpp₂ x, hpm₂ x, pd x]
  
  have hdfun : (d : ℝ → ℝ) = fun y => ((wm₁ y - wp₁ y) - (wm₂ y - wp₂ y)) / 2 := funext hd
  have hdD : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (d : ℝ → ℝ) (D x) x := by
    intro x
    have h := (((hdm₁ x).sub (hdp₁ x)).sub ((hdm₂ x).sub (hdp₂ x))).div_const 2
    rw [hdfun]
    convert h using 1
    rw [hD x, hd x]
    ring
  have hderiv : ∀ x, deriv (d : ℝ → ℝ) x = D x := fun x => (hdD x).deriv
  have hDb : ∀ x, D x ^ 2 ≤ 25 * κ ^ 2 / 8 * ((wm₁ x - wm₂ x) + (wp₁ x - wp₂ x)) ^ 2 +
      2 * ((wm₂ x + wp₂ x) ^ 2 * (d : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2) := by
    intro x
    rw [hD x]
    have h1 := abs_le.1 (hb x)
    have hA1 : 0 ≤ 2 * κ + wm₁ x - wp₁ x := by linarith [h1.1]
    have hA2 : 2 * κ + wm₁ x - wp₁ x ≤ 5 * κ / 2 := by linarith [h1.2]
    have hA : (2 * κ + wm₁ x - wp₁ x) ^ 2 ≤ 25 * κ ^ 2 / 4 := by nlinarith
    have hS := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA (sq_nonneg ((wm₁ x - wm₂ x) + (wp₁ x - wp₂ x)))
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (-(1 / 2) * ((wm₁ x - wm₂ x) + (wp₁ x - wp₂ x)) *
      (2 * κ + wm₁ x - wp₁ x) + (wm₂ x + wp₂ x) * (d : ℝ → ℝ) x)]
  
  have hLp := riccati_L2_lipschitz_plus_T κ hκ q p wp₁ wp₂ hpp₁ hpp₂ hdp₁ hdp₂ hip₁ hip₂
  have hLm := riccati_L2_lipschitz_minus_T κ hκ q p wm₁ wm₂ hpm₁ hpm₂ hdm₁ hdm₂ him₁ him₂
  obtain ⟨δ2, hδ2⟩ : ∃ δ2, δ2 = ‖ιT q - ιT p‖ ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hδ2] at hLp hLm ⊢
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ2 := by rw [hδ2]; positivity
  
  have hSg : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((wm₁ x - wm₂ x) + (wp₁ x - wp₂ x)) ^ 2) ≤ 8 * δ2 := by
    have := hsq (fun x => wm₁ x - wm₂ x) (fun x => wp₁ x - wp₂ x) (cm₁.sub cm₂) (cp₁.sub cp₂)
    linarith
  have hY : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (d : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2) ≤ 2 * δ2 := by
    have e1 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (d : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2) =
        (1 / 4) * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((wm₁ x - wm₂ x) + (-(wp₁ x - wp₂ x))) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x _
      simp only [hd x]
      ring
    have e2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (-(wp₁ x - wp₂ x)) ^ 2) =
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (wp₁ x - wp₂ x) ^ 2 := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x _
      simp only [neg_sq]
    have := hsq (fun x => wm₁ x - wm₂ x) (fun x => -(wp₁ x - wp₂ x)) (cm₁.sub cm₂)
      (cp₁.sub cp₂).neg
    linarith
  have hs : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (wm₂ x + wp₂ x) ^ 2) ≤ κ / 16 := by
    have := hsq wm₂ wp₂ cm₂ cp₂
    linarith
  have hY0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (d : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2 :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X, X = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, D x ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Y, hYd⟩ : ∃ Y, Y = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (d : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hsd⟩ : ∃ s, s = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (wm₂ x + wp₂ x) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hYd] at hY hY0
  rw [← hsd] at hs
  
  have hX1 : X ≤ 25 * κ ^ 2 / 8 * (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((wm₁ x - wm₂ x) + (wp₁ x - wp₂ x)) ^ 2) +
      2 * ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (wm₂ x + wp₂ x) ^ 2 * (d : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2 := by
    rw [hX, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_add]
    · apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one
      · exact (cD.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
      · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop
      · intro x _; exact hDb x
    · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop
    · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop
  
  have hag := hagmon (d : ℝ → ℝ) D pd pD cD hdD (4 / κ) (by positivity)
  have hk4 : 1 / (4 / κ) = κ / 4 := by field_simp
  rw [hk4, ← hYd, ← hX] at hag
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M, M = (1 + κ / 4) * Y + 4 / κ * X := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by rw [hM]; exact le_trans (sq_nonneg _) (hag 0)
  have hI : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (wm₂ x + wp₂ x) ^ 2 * (d : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2) ≤ M * s := by
    rw [hsd, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one
    · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop
    · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop
    · intro x _
      show (wm₂ x + wp₂ x) ^ 2 * (d : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2 ≤ M * (wm₂ x + wp₂ x) ^ 2
      have h1 := hag x
      rw [← hM] at h1
      have h2 : 0 ≤ (wm₂ x + wp₂ x) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      nlinarith
  
  have hMs : M * s ≤ M * (κ / 16) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hM0
  have hMk : M * (κ / 16) = (κ / 16 + κ ^ 2 / 64) * Y + X / 4 := by
    rw [hM]; field_simp; ring
  have h25 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSg (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 25 * κ ^ 2 / 8)
  have hX2 : X ≤ 50 * κ ^ 2 * δ2 + (κ / 4 + κ ^ 2 / 16) * Y := by nlinarith
  have hYm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ κ / 4 + κ ^ 2 / 16)
  have hkk : κ ≤ κ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ κ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hm1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkk hδ0
  have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk1 hδ0
  have hXY : X + 4 * Y ≤ 64 * κ ^ 2 * δ2 := by nlinarith
  
  have hfinal : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (deriv (d : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * ((d : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) =
      X + 4 * Y := by
    have e : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (deriv (d : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * ((d : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) =
        ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (D x ^ 2 + 4 * ((d : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x _
      simp only [hderiv x]
    rw [e, intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hX, hYd]
    · exact (cD.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
    · exact (continuous_const.mul (cd.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  rw [hfinal]
  exact hXY

proof.tactics:
by
  intro K hK c hc0 hc
  have s1 : ∀ ξ h : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 =
      2 - 2 * Real.cos (ξ * h) := by
    intro ξ h
    have e : (ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) = ((ξ * h : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [e, Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
      Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im]
    linear_combination Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (ξ * h)
  have hE : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * K * t)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    have := exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 (b := 2 * K) (by positivity)
    refine this.congr_fun (fun x _ => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi
    show Real.exp (-(2 * K) * x) = Real.exp (-2 * K * x)
    congr 1; ring
  have s3 : ∀ c' : ℝ,
      IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * K * t) * Real.cos (c' * t)) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
      ∫ t in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-2 * K * t) * Real.cos (c' * t) =
        2 * K / (c' ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) := by
    intro c'
    obtain ⟨a, ha_def⟩ : ∃ a : ℂ, a = ((-2 * K : ℝ) : ℂ) + (c' : ℂ) * I := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hare : a.re = -2 * K := by rw [ha_def]; simp
    have haim : a.im = c' := by rw [ha_def]; simp
    have ha : a.re < 0 := by rw [hare]; linarith
    have hpt : ∀ t : ℝ, (Complex.exp (a * t)).re =
        Real.exp (-2 * K * t) * Real.cos (c' * t) := by
      intro t
      have hre : (a * (t : ℂ)).re = -2 * K * t := by
        rw [Complex.mul_re, hare, haim]; simp
      have him : (a * (t : ℂ)).im = c' * t := by
        rw [Complex.mul_im, hare, haim]; simp
      rw [Complex.exp_re, hre, him]
    have hI := integrableOn_exp_mul_complex_Ioi ha 0
    have hfeq : (fun t : ℝ => RCLike.re (Complex.exp (a * t))) =
        fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * K * t) * Real.cos (c' * t) := by
      funext t; rw [RCLike.re_to_complex, hpt]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have := hI.re
      rw [hfeq] at this
      exact this
    · have h1 := integral_re hI
      rw [hfeq, integral_exp_mul_complex_Ioi ha 0] at h1
      rw [h1, RCLike.re_to_complex]
      have hnorm : Complex.normSq a = c' ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2 := by
        rw [Complex.normSq_apply, hare, haim]; ring
      have hpos : 0 < c' ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2 := by positivity
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero]
      rw [Complex.div_re, hnorm, hare, haim]
      simp
  have hEint : ∫ t in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-2 * K * t) = 1 / (2 * K) := by
    rw [integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith) 0]
    simp only [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero]
    field_simp
  
  have mode : ∀ ξ : ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun h : ℝ => 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
      ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
      (∫ h in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
        ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2) = 2 * ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) := by
    intro ξ
    have hfun : (fun h : ℝ => 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
        ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2) =
        fun h : ℝ => (4 * K) * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) -
          (4 * K) * (Real.exp (-2 * K * h) * Real.cos (ξ * h)) := by
      funext h; rw [s1]; ring
    rw [hfun]
    refine ⟨(hE.const_mul _).sub ((s3 ξ).1.const_mul _), ?_⟩
    rw [integral_sub (hE.const_mul _) ((s3 ξ).1.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul, hEint, (s3 ξ).2]
    have hpos : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2 := by positivity
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hφb : ∀ (n : ℤ) (h : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 := by
    intro n h
    have h1 : ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I)‖ = 1 := by
      have e : ((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I = (((2 * π * n) * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [e, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
    have h2 : ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ≤ 2 := by
      calc _ ≤ ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I)‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ :=
            norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = 2 := by rw [h1, norm_one]; norm_num
    have h3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h2 2
    calc _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := h3
      _ = 4 := by norm_num
  have hterm0 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (h : ℝ),
      0 ≤ ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n :=
    fun n h => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hc0 n)
  have htermle : ∀ (n : ℤ) (h : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n ≤ 4 * c n :=
    fun n h => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hφb n h) (hc0 n)
  have hc4 : Summable (fun n : ℤ => 4 * c n) := hc.mul_left 4
  have hScont : Continuous (fun h : ℝ => ∑' n : ℤ,
      ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n) := by
    refine continuous_tsum (f := fun (n : ℤ) (h : ℝ) =>
      ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n)
      (fun n => by fun_prop) hc4 (fun n h => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hterm0 n h)]
    exact htermle n h
  have hSb : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 ≤ (∑' n : ℤ,
      ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n) ∧
      (∑' n : ℤ, ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n) ≤
        4 * ∑' n : ℤ, c n := by
    intro h
    refine ⟨tsum_nonneg (fun n => hterm0 n h), ?_⟩
    have hs : Summable (fun n : ℤ =>
        ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => hterm0 n h) (fun n => htermle n h) hc4
    rw [← tsum_mul_left]
    exact Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun n => htermle n h) hs hc4
  
  have hInt : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun h : ℝ => 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
      ∑' n : ℤ, ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n)
      (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    refine (hE.const_mul (2 * K * (4 * ∑' n : ℤ, c n))).mono' ?_ ?_
    · have hw : Continuous (fun h : ℝ => 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h)) := by fun_prop
      exact (hw.mul hScont).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun h => ?_)
      have hw : 0 ≤ 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) := by positivity
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hw (hSb h).1)]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hSb h).2 hw
      calc _ ≤ 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) * (4 * ∑' n : ℤ, c n) := this
        _ = _ := by ring
  refine ⟨hInt, ?_⟩
  
  have hGint : ∀ n : ℤ, Integrable (fun h : ℝ => 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
      ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n)
      (volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))) :=
    fun n => (mode (2 * π * n)).1.mul_const (c n)
  have hGval : ∀ n : ℤ, (∫ h in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
      ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n) =
      2 * (2 * π * n) ^ 2 / ((2 * π * n) ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * c n := by
    intro n
    rw [integral_mul_const, (mode (2 * π * n)).2]
  have hGnorm : ∀ n : ℤ, (∫ h in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ‖2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
      ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n‖) =
      2 * (2 * π * n) ^ 2 / ((2 * π * n) ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * c n := by
    intro n
    rw [← hGval n]
    congr 1
    funext h
    exact Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hc0 n))
  have hGsum : Summable (fun n : ℤ => ∫ h in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ‖2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
      ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n‖) := by
    rw [funext hGnorm]
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hc0 n))
      (fun n => ?_) (hc.mul_left 2)
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hc0 n)
    have hpos : 0 < (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg K]
  have hswap := MeasureTheory.integral_tsum_of_summable_integral_norm hGint hGsum
  have hpt : ∀ h : ℝ, (∑' n : ℤ, 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
      ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n) =
      2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
        ∑' n : ℤ, ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n := by
    intro h
    rw [← tsum_mul_left]
    congr 1
    funext n
    ring
  calc (∫ h in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
        ∑' n : ℤ, ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n)
      = ∫ h in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ∑' n : ℤ, 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
          ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n := by
        congr 1
        funext h
        exact (hpt h).symm
    _ = ∑' n : ℤ, ∫ h in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), 2 * K * Real.exp (-2 * K * h) *
          ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * c n := hswap.symm
    _ = _ := tsum_congr hGval

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (ϰ κ : ℝ), κ ^ 2 - ϰ ^ 2 ≠ 0 → ∀ (q wp wm g H Zp Zm v : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) q → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) g → Function.Periodic q 1 → Function.Periodic wp 1 → Function.Periodic wm 1 → Function.Periodic g 1 → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wp (q x + 2 * ϰ * wp x - wp x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt wm (q x - 2 * ϰ * wm x - wm x ^ 2) x) → (∀ x, iteratedDeriv 3 g x = 2 * deriv q x * g x + 4 * (κ ^ 2 + q x) * deriv g x) → (∀ x, H x = -2 * deriv q x + (2 * q x - 4 * ϰ ^ 2 - 4 * κ ^ 2) * (wm x + wp x) - (8 * κ ^ 5 / (κ ^ 2 - ϰ ^ 2)) * (deriv g x - g x * (wm x + wp x))) → (∀ x, Zp x = (deriv H x + H x * (2 * ϰ + wm x - wp x)) / 2) → (∀ x, Zm x = (deriv H x - H x * (2 * ϰ + wm x - wp x)) / 2) → (∀ x, v x = -(iteratedDeriv 3 q x) + 6 * q x * deriv q x - (16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv g x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv q x)) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt Zp (2 * ϰ * Zp x + v x - 2 * wp x * Zp x) x) ∧ (∀ x, HasDerivAt Zm (-2 * ϰ * Zm x + v x - 2 * wm x * Zm x) x) ∧ Function.Periodic Zp 1 ∧ Function.Periodic Zm 1
